title.zh: 卷521 列傳三百八 藩部四 喀尔喀土谢图汗部 喀尔喀车臣汗部 喀尔喀赛因诺颜部 喀尔喀札萨克图汗部
title.en: Volume 521 Biographies 308: Frontier Dependencies 4: Ka Er Ka Tu Xie Tu Han Bu, Ka Er Ka Che Chen Han Bu, Ka Er Ka Sai Yin Nuo Yan Bu, Ka Er Ka Zha Sa Ke Tu Han Bu
title.raw: 卷521 列傳三百八 藩部四 喀尔喀土谢图汗部 喀尔喀车臣汗部 喀尔喀赛因诺颜部 喀尔喀札萨克图汗部

sentences.zh: 土謝圖汗部，稱喀爾喀後路，至京師二千八百餘里。

translations.literal: The Tüshiyetu Khan banner, called the Khalkha rear route, is more than 2,800 li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Tüshiyetu Khan banner—designated the Khalkha rear route—lies more than 2,800 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東界肯特山，西界翁吉河，南界瀚海，北界楚庫河。

translations.literal: On the east it borders the Kent Mountains; on the west, the Ongi River; on the south, the Gobi; on the north, the Tchu River.
translations.idiomatic: It is bounded on the east by the Kent Mountains, on the west by the Ongi River, on the south by the Gobi Desert, and on the north by the Tchu River.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十一世孫達延車臣汗，遊牧瀚海北杭愛山界。

translations.literal: Dayan Sechen Khan, eleventh-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, pastured north of the Gobi on the borders of the Khangai Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: Dayan Sechen Khan, an eleventh-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, ranged with his herds north of the Gobi along the Khangai Mountains.

sentences.zh: 子十一，格哷森紮紮賚爾琿台吉其季也。

translations.literal: He had eleven sons; Geresenje Zasaqer Khung-taiji was the youngest.
translations.idiomatic: He had eleven sons; the youngest was Geresenje Zasaqer Khung-taiji.

sentences.zh: 兄圖嚕博羅特、巴爾蘇博羅特、阿爾楚博羅特、鄂齊爾博羅特等，由瀚海南徙近邊，為內扎薩克敖漢、柰曼、巴林、紮嚕特、克什克騰、烏珠穆沁、浩齊特、蘇尼特、鄂爾多斯九部祖，詳各傳。

translations.literal: His elder brothers Tümen Borot, Bars Borot, Alt Borot, Eje Borot, and others moved south of the Gobi toward the frontier and became the ancestors of the nine inner-jasagh banners—Aohan, Naiman, Baarin, Jarud, Keshiketeng, Ujumchin, Khoit, Sunid, and Ordos—as detailed in their respective biographies.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brothers Tümen Borot, Bars Borot, Alt Borot, Eje Borot, and others migrated from south of the Gobi toward the borderlands and became the founding ancestors of the nine inner-jasagh groups—Aohan, Naiman, Baarin, Jarud, Keshiketeng, Ujumchin, Khoit, Sunid, and Ordos—each treated at length in its own biography.

sentences.zh: 獨所部號喀爾喀，留故土，析衆萬餘為七旗，授子七人領之，分左、右翼。

translations.literal: His own division alone was called Khalkha; he remained on the old lands, divided a following of more than ten thousand into seven banners, and assigned them to seven sons to lead, forming left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: Only his own people kept the name Khalkha and stayed on the ancestral pastures; he split a following of more than ten thousand into seven banners for seven sons, organizing them into left and right wings.

sentences.zh: 其掌左翼者，為第三子諾諾和及第五子阿敏都喇勒。

translations.literal: Those who governed the left wing were his third son Nonoqo and his fifth son Emündürel.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing was held by his third son Nonoqo and his fifth son Emündürel.

sentences.zh: 諾諾和號偉徵諾顏，子五：長阿巴岱，號斡齊賴賽因汗；

translations.literal: Nonoqo was styled Wei Zheng Noyan; he had five sons: the eldest, Abadai, was styled Ochir Sayin Khan;
translations.idiomatic: Nonoqo took the title Wei Zheng Noyan. He had five sons; the eldest, Abadai, was known as Ochir Sayin Khan.

sentences.zh: 次阿布瑚，號墨爾根諾顏，徙牧圖拉河界，今土謝圖汗部二十扎薩克皆其裔。

translations.literal: The second, Abuq, was styled Mergen Noyan, moved his pastures to the Tula River region, and all twenty jasaghs of the present Tüshiyetu Khan banner are his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: The second son, Abuq, styled Mergen Noyan, shifted his herds to the Tula River country; the twenty jasaghs of today's Tüshiyetu Khan banner all descend from him.

sentences.zh: 阿巴岱子二：長錫布固泰，號鄂爾齋圖琿台吉，為扎薩克貝子錫布推哈坦巴圖爾、輔國公巴海、台吉車淩紮布、青多爾濟四旗祖；

translations.literal: Abadai had two sons: the eldest, Sibugtai, was styled Erketü Khung-taiji and was ancestor of the four banners of Jasagh Beile Sibutui Khatan Batur, Fuguo Gong Bahai, Taiji Chelengjab, and Qingdorji;
translations.idiomatic: Abadai's two sons were Sibugtai, styled Erketü Khung-taiji, who founded the four banners of Jasagh Beile Sibutui Khatan Batur, Fuguo Gong Bahai, Taiji Chelengjab, and Qingdorji;

sentences.zh: 次額列克，號墨爾根汗，為土謝圖汗察琿多爾濟、扎薩克郡王噶勒丹多爾濟、貝勒西第什哩、車木楚克納木紮勒、輔國公車淩巴勒、三達克多爾濟、台吉巴朗、班珠爾多爾濟、辰丕勒多爾濟、朋素克喇布坦十旗祖。

translations.literal: the second, Ereke, was styled Mergen Khan and was ancestor of the ten banners of Tüshiyetu Khan Caqur Dorji, Jasagh Junwang Galdan Dorji, Beile Sidishi, Chemchük Namjil, Fuguo Gong Chelengbal, Sandak Dorji, Taiji Balang, Banzur Dorji, Chenbil Dorji, and Pünsükrabtan.
translations.idiomatic: and the younger, Ereke, styled Mergen Khan, who founded the ten banners headed by Tüshiyetu Khan Caqur Dorji, Jasagh Junwang Galdan Dorji, Beile Sidishi, Chemchük Namjil, Fuguo Gong Chelengbal, Sandak Dorji, Taiji Balang, Banzur Dorji, Chenbil Dorji, and Pünsükrabtan.

sentences.zh: 阿布瑚子三：長昂噶海，繼墨爾根諾顏號，為扎薩克郡王固嚕什喜，台吉車淩、開木楚克、成袞紮布、遜篤布五旗祖；

translations.literal: Abuq had three sons: the eldest, Angqai, succeeded to the title Mergen Noyan and was ancestor of the five banners of Jasagh Junwang Gülüshi, Taiji Cheleng, Kaimuchuk, Chengunjab, and Sundub;
translations.idiomatic: Abuq had three sons. The eldest, Angqai, inherited the title Mergen Noyan and was forebear of the five banners of Jasagh Junwang Gülüshi, Taiji Cheleng, Kaimuchuk, Chengunjab, and Sundub;

sentences.zh: 次喇瑚里，號達賴諾顏，為扎薩克台吉禮塔爾一旗祖；

translations.literal: the second, Laquri, was styled Dalai Noyan and was ancestor of the single banner of Jasagh Taiji Lital;
translations.idiomatic: the second, Laquri, styled Dalai Noyan, founded the lone banner of Jasagh Taiji Lital;

sentences.zh: 次圖蒙肯，號昆都倫諾顏。

translations.literal: the third, Tümenken, was styled Qundelen Noyan.
translations.idiomatic: and the third, Tümenken, took the title Qundelen Noyan.

sentences.zh: 初喀爾喀無汗號，自阿巴岱赴唐古特謁達賴喇嘛迎經典歸，為眾所服，以汗稱。

translations.literal: At first Khalkha had no khan title; after Abadai went to Tangut to pay homage to the Dalai Lama and brought back the scriptures, the people submitted to him and he was styled khan.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha had no khan title until Abadai traveled to Tibet to visit the Dalai Lama and returned with the scriptures; the people then accepted his leadership and he was called khan.

sentences.zh: 子額列克繼之，號墨爾根汗。

translations.literal: His son Ereke succeeded him and was styled Mergen Khan.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ereke succeeded him as Mergen Khan.

sentences.zh: 額列克子三：長袞布，始號土謝圖汗，與其族車臣汗碩壘、扎薩克圖汗素巴第同時稱「三汗」。

translations.literal: Ereke had three sons: the eldest, Günbo, first took the title Tüshiyetu Khan and, together with his kinsmen Sechen Khan Sholoi and Jasaghtu Khan Subadai, was at the same time called one of the 'Three Khans.'
translations.idiomatic: Ereke had three sons. The eldest, Günbo, was the first to bear the title Tüshiyetu Khan; he and his kinsmen Sechen Khan Sholoi and Jasaghtu Khan Subadai were known together as the 'Three Khans.'

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，袞布偕碩壘上書通好。

translations.literal: In the second year of Chongde, Günbo together with Sholoi sent a letter seeking friendly relations.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Chongde (1637), Günbo and Sholoi wrote to open friendly relations.

sentences.zh: 三年，遣使貢駝、馬、貂皮、雕翎及俄羅斯鳥槍，命喀爾喀三汗歲獻白駝一、白馬八，謂之「九白」之貢，以為常。

translations.literal: In the third year, envoys were sent to present camels, horses, sable furs, eagle feathers, and Russian firelocks; the three Khalkha khans were ordered to present annually one white camel and eight white horses, called the 'Nine Whites' tribute, which became the regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: The next year they sent tribute of camels, horses, sable, eagle feathers, and Russian muskets. The court required the three Khalkha khans to present one white camel and eight white horses each year—the 'Nine Whites' tribute—which thereafter became fixed custom.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，蘇尼特部長騰機思叛逃，豫親王多鐸率師追剿，至紮濟布喇克，袞布遣喇瑚里等以兵二萬援騰機思，為大軍所敗，棄駝馬千餘竄額爾克。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shunzhi, the Sunid chief Tenggis rebelled and fled; Prince Dorgon led troops in pursuit to Zhaqibulaq; Günbo sent Laquri and others with twenty thousand men to aid Tenggis, but they were defeated by the main army, abandoned more than a thousand camels and horses, and fled in disarray to Erke.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Shunzhi (1646), Sunid chief Tenggis rebelled and fled. Prince Dorgon pursued him to Zhaqibulaq. Günbo sent Laquri with twenty thousand men to aid Tenggis, but the Qing army routed them; they abandoned over a thousand camels and horses and fled toward Erke.

sentences.zh: 楚琥爾者袞布族也，復私掠巴林部人畜，詔使責之。

translations.literal: Chughur was of Günbo's clan and again privately plundered people and livestock of the Baarin banner; an edict was sent ordering him reprimanded.
translations.idiomatic: Chughur, a kinsman of Günbo, again raided Baarin for people and livestock, and the court sent orders of reprimand.

sentences.zh: 會所部額爾德尼陀音貢馬至，敕歸諭其汗等擒獻騰機思，並以所掠歸巴林。

translations.literal: When Erdene Toyin of his division came to present horses in tribute, he was ordered on his return to instruct the khans and others to seize and deliver Tenggis and to restore what had been plundered to Baarin.
translations.idiomatic: When Erdene Toyin of his banner arrived with horse tribute, he was sent back with orders for the khans to capture Tenggis and return all plunder to Baarin.

sentences.zh: 五年，騰機思降，袞布等表乞罪，詔各遣子弟來朝，不從。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Tenggis surrendered; Günbo and others memorialized begging pardon; they were ordered each to send sons and younger brothers to court, but they did not comply.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year (1648) Tenggis submitted. Günbo and the others petitioned for pardon, and the court ordered each to send sons and younger kinsmen to the capital; they refused.

sentences.zh: 八年，以其部不歸巴林人畜，僅獻駝十、馬百入謝，嚴諭詰責。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because his banner did not return the people and livestock to Baarin but presented only ten camels and a hundred horses in apology, a stern edict rebuked them.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year (1651), having failed to return Baarin's people and herds, they offered only ten camels and a hundred horses by way of apology, and received a stern rebuke.

sentences.zh: 十年，命侍郎畢哩克圖往察巴林被掠人畜，袞布等匿不盡給。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, Vice-President Biliketu was ordered to investigate the people and livestock plundered from Baarin; Günbo and others concealed them and did not return them in full.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year (1653) Vice-President Biliketu was sent to investigate Baarin's losses; Günbo and his allies withheld victims and property and would not make full restitution.

sentences.zh: 會喇瑚里之子台吉木塔爾攜眾來歸，封扎薩克親王，駐牧張家口外塔嚕渾河，因詭言巴林人畜木塔爾盡攜往，應就彼取，並乞遣木塔爾等還。

translations.literal: When Laquri's son Taiji Muta'er came leading his following to submit, he was enfeoffed Jasagh Qinwang and pastured outside Zhangjiakou on the Talu Hun River; they falsely claimed that Baarin's people and livestock had all been taken away by Muta'er and should be recovered from him, and also begged that Muta'er and others be sent back.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Laquri's son Taiji Muta'er defected with his people, was enfeoffed as Jasagh Qinwang, and was settled outside Zhangjiakou on the Talu Hun River. Günbo's party falsely claimed that all of Baarin's people and herds were with Muta'er and should be recovered from him, and asked that Muta'er be sent back.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「爾等不遵旨遣子弟來朝，不進本年九白常貢，不盡償巴林人畜。

translations.literal: An edict said: 'You have not obeyed the order to send sons and younger brothers to court, have not presented this year's regular Nine Whites tribute, and have not fully compensated Baarin for people and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: The court replied: 'You disobeyed orders to send kinsmen to court, failed to deliver this year's Nine Whites tribute, and have not fully compensated Baarin.

sentences.zh: 冒此三罪，反請遣還來歸之人，是何理耶？

translations.literal: Having committed these three offenses, you instead ask that those who have come to submit be sent back—what sort of reasoning is this?
translations.idiomatic: After these three offenses you ask us to return men who have come over to us—what logic is that?

sentences.zh: 今即各遣子弟來朝，盡償巴林人畜，朕亦弗使木塔爾等還，爾自擇之！」

translations.literal: If you now at once send sons and younger brothers to court and fully compensate Baarin for people and livestock, I likewise will not send Muta'er and others back—choose for yourselves!'
translations.idiomatic: Send your sons and younger kinsmen to court at once and make full restitution to Baarin, and I will not send Muta'er back either. Choose for yourselves!'

sentences.zh: 是年秋，遣使補貢九白，至張家口，詔勿納。

translations.literal: That autumn they sent envoys to make up the Nine Whites tribute; when they reached Zhangjiakou, an edict ordered that it not be accepted.
translations.idiomatic: That autumn they sent envoys with belated Nine Whites tribute to Zhangjiakou, but the court refused to accept it.

sentences.zh: 十二年夏，土謝圖汗察琿多爾濟繼其父袞布為左翼長，約同族墨爾根諾顏、達爾漢諾顏、丹津喇嘛等，表遣子弟來朝。

translations.literal: In the summer of the twelfth year, Tüshiyetu Khan Caqur Dorji succeeded his father Günbo as head of the left wing; together with his kinsmen Mergen Noyan, Dalai Noyan, Danjin Lama, and others, he memorialized offering to send sons and younger brothers to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the summer of the twelfth year (1655), Tüshiyetu Khan Caqur Dorji succeeded his father Günbo as leader of the left wing. With kinsmen Mergen Noyan, Dalai Noyan, Danjin Lama, and others, he petitioned to send sons and younger relatives to court.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「爾等遵旨服罪，朕不咎既往，其應歸巴林人畜缺少之數，悉從寬免。

translations.literal: An edict said: 'You have obeyed the order and submitted to punishment; I do not blame you for the past; the shortfall in people and livestock that should be returned to Baarin is entirely remitted in leniency.
translations.idiomatic: The court replied: 'You have obeyed and submitted; I will not hold the past against you. Whatever Baarin is still owed in people and livestock is entirely forgiven.

sentences.zh: 嗣後逃人至此，當即遣還。」

translations.literal: Henceforth, when fugitives reach you, you must at once send them back.'
translations.idiomatic: From now on, send back any fugitives who reach you at once.'

sentences.zh: 冬，復遣使乞盟，許之，賜盟於宗人府。

translations.literal: In winter they again sent envoys begging to swear alliance; permission was granted, and alliance was bestowed at the Court of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: That winter they again asked to swear alliance; the request was granted and the oath was administered at the Court of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 是年，設喀爾喀八扎薩克，仍分左、右翼，命土謝圖汗及墨爾根諾顏各領左翼扎薩克之一。

translations.literal: That year eight Khalkha jasaghs were established, still divided into left and right wings; the Tüshiyetu Khan and Mergen Noyan were each ordered to head one of the left-wing jasaghs.
translations.idiomatic: That year eight Khalkha jasaghs were set up, still organized in left and right wings; the Tüshiyetu Khan and Mergen Noyan each received one left-wing jasagh to command.

sentences.zh: 十五年，遣大臣齎服物賚之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, a minister was sent bearing robes and gifts to bestow on them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year (1658) a minister was dispatched with robes and gifts.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十三年，以其部與右翼扎薩克圖汗成袞構釁，命阿齊圖格隆偕達賴喇嘛使諭解之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year of Kangxi, because his banner and the right-wing Jasaghtu Khan Chenggün were at feud, Aqitu Gelun was ordered together with the Dalai Lama's envoy to admonish and reconcile them.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 23 (1684), when his banner feuded with the right-wing Jasaghtu Khan Chenggün, Aqitu Gelun was sent with the Dalai Lama's envoy to mediate.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，察琿多爾濟偕車臣汗諾爾布等疏上尊號，諭曰：「爾等恪恭敬順，具見悃忱，但宜仰體朕一視同仁、無分中外至意。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Caqur Dorji together with Sechen Khan Norbu and others memorialized offering an honorific title; an edict said: 'Your respectful obedience shows your sincere devotion, but you should look up to my utmost purpose of treating all alike without distinction between inner and outer.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 26 (1687), Caqur Dorji and Sechen Khan Norbu petitioned to honor the emperor with a lofty title. He replied: 'Your loyalty is plain, but you should heed my purpose of treating all alike, without distinction between Chinese and frontier peoples.

sentences.zh: 自今以後，親睦雍和，毋相侵擾，永享安樂，庶慰朕懷，勝於受尊號也。」

translations.literal: From now on be close, harmonious, and friendly; do not encroach on one another; forever enjoy peace and happiness—thus you may comfort my heart, which is better than my receiving an honorific title.'
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter live in harmony, do not raid one another, and enjoy lasting peace—that will comfort me more than any honorific title.'

sentences.zh: 二十七年，厄魯特噶爾丹掠喀爾喀，察琿多爾濟拒弗勝，偕族弟固嚕什喜等攜屬來歸，詔附牧蘇尼特諸部界，發歸化城倉米贍之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the Oirat Galdan raided Khalkha; Caqur Dorji resisted but could not prevail; together with his clansman Gülüshi and others he brought his following to submit; they were ordered to pasture attached to the borders of the Sunid and other banners, and grain from the Guihuacheng granary was issued to support them.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 27 (1688) the Oirat Galdan overran Khalkha. Caqur Dorji could not hold him off and came in with his clansman Gülüshi and their people. They were settled along the Sunid borders and fed from the Guihuacheng granary.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，復遣內大臣費揚古往賑，諭廷臣曰：「朕聞土謝圖汗屬眾有乏食致斃者，深為軫念。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Inner Minister Fiyanggū was again sent to relieve distress; the emperor told the court: 'I have heard that among the Tüshiyetu Khan's following some have died from lack of food; I am deeply grieved.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 28 (1689) Inner Minister Fiyanggū was sent again with relief. The emperor told his ministers: 'I hear that some of the Tüshiyetu Khan's people have starved to death, and I am deeply troubled.

sentences.zh: 費揚古採買牲畜尚須時日，著速發張家口倉米運往散給，計支一月，牲畜繼之，則眾命可活矣。」

translations.literal: Fiyanggū's purchase of livestock will still take time; order grain from the Zhangjiakou granary rushed there and distributed—enough for one month, with livestock to follow—then the people's lives can be saved.'
translations.idiomatic: Fiyanggū's livestock purchases will take time. Rush grain from the Zhangjiakou granary for a month's ration; livestock can follow afterward, and lives may be saved.'

sentences.zh: 二十九年，詔察所屬貧戶，遣就食張家口。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, an edict ordered investigation of impoverished households under their jurisdiction and that they be sent to obtain food at Zhangjiakou.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 29 (1690) the court surveyed poor households in the banner and sent them to Zhangjiakou for grain.

sentences.zh: 三十年春，上以察琿多爾濟來歸後，車臣汗烏默客、扎薩克圖汗成袞子策旺紮布踵至，喀爾喀全部內附，封爵官制宜更，且降眾數十萬錯處，應示法制俾遵守，將幸多倫諾爾行會閱禮，詔理籓院檄察琿多爾濟等隨四十九旗扎薩克先集以俟。

translations.literal: In the spring of the thirtieth year, because after Caqur Dorji's submission Sechen Khan Ümek and Jasaghtu Khan Chenggün's son Tsewangjab followed, the whole of Khalkha submitted; enfeoffments and offices should be revised; moreover, several hundred thousand who had submitted were scattered and mixed and should be shown regulations to observe; the emperor would proceed to Duolun Nu'er to hold a review assembly; the Court of Colonial Affairs was ordered to instruct Caqur Dorji and others to gather beforehand with the jasaghs of the forty-nine banners and wait.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Kangxi 30 (1691), after Caqur Dorji's submission, Sechen Khan Ümek and Jasaghtu Khan Chenggün's son Tsewangjab followed, bringing all Khalkha under Qing rule. Titles and offices needed revision, and hundreds of thousands of refugees required regulation. The emperor would hold a grand review at Duolun Nu'er and ordered Caqur Dorji and the forty-nine inner jasaghs to assemble there in advance.

sentences.zh: 尚書馬齊奉命往議禮，定賞格九等，坐次七行，以察琿多爾濟為之首。

translations.literal: Minister Ma Qi was ordered to go and deliberate on the rites; nine grades of rewards were fixed and seven rows of seating, with Caqur Dorji at the head.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Ma Qi was sent to arrange the ceremonies: nine grades of rewards and seven rows of seating, with Caqur Dorji in the place of honor.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，駕至，喀爾喀汗、濟農、諾顏、台吉等三十五人以次朝見，諭曰：「爾等以兄弟之親，自相侵奪，啟釁召侮，至全部潰散。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer the imperial carriage arrived; thirty-five Khalkha khans, jinong, noyan, taiji, and others in turn had audience; an edict said: 'You, though close as brothers, seized from one another, provoked strife and invited insult, until the whole was scattered in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the emperor arrived. Thirty-five Khalkha khans, jinong, noyan, and taiji were received in turn. He told them: 'Though you were brothers, you fought among yourselves, provoked war, and invited invasion until your whole people were scattered.

sentences.zh: 其時若令四十九旗扎薩克將爾人眾收取，爾部早已散亡。

translations.literal: At that time, had the jasaghs of the forty-nine banners been ordered to take in your people, your banners would long ago have perished.
translations.idiomatic: Had I let the forty-nine inner jasaghs absorb your people then, your tribes would already have ceased to exist.

sentences.zh: 朕好生之心出於天性，不忍視爾滅亡，給地安置，復屢予牲畜、糗糧以資贍養，用是親臨教誨，普加賞賚。

translations.literal: My heart of cherishing life is inborn; I could not bear to see you perish; I gave you lands to settle on and again and again bestowed livestock and grain for your support; therefore I have come in person to instruct you and broadly bestow rewards.
translations.idiomatic: My nature is to cherish life; I could not watch you perish. I gave you pasture, sent livestock and grain again and again, and have come in person to teach and reward you.

sentences.zh: 會同之時，見爾等傾心感戴，特沛恩施，俾與四十九旗同列，以示一體撫育，罔分中外，爾等其知朕意。」

translations.literal: At this assembly, seeing your wholehearted gratitude, I have specially poured out favor, placing you on the same footing as the forty-nine banners to show one body of nurturing without distinction between inner and outer—know my intent.'
translations.idiomatic: At this assembly I see your gratitude, and I bestow favor so that you stand with the forty-nine banners as one people, without distinction between Chinese and frontier—understand my purpose.'

sentences.zh: 尋命改所部濟農、諾顏舊號，封王、貝勒、台吉有差，各授扎薩克，編佐領，仍留察琿多爾濟汗號統其眾，自是始稱土謝圖汗部。

translations.literal: Soon they were ordered to change the old titles of jinong and noyan in their banner; princes, beile, and taiji were enfeoffed in varying ranks; each was granted jasagh status and organized into zuoling; Caqur Dorji's khan title was retained to command their following—from this time the banner was called the Tüshiyetu Khan division.
translations.idiomatic: They were then given new Qing titles in place of old jinong and noyan ranks; princes, beile, and taiji were enfeoffed at various levels, each made a jasagh and organized into zuoling. Caqur Dorji kept his khan title to lead the people, and from then on the unit was known as the Tüshiyetu Khan banner.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，改喀爾喀左右翼為三路，土謝圖汗稱北路。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the Khalkha left and right wings were changed to three routes; the Tüshiyetu Khan was called the northern route.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 31 (1692) Khalkha was reorganized from two wings into three routes; the Tüshiyetu Khan banner became the northern route.

sentences.zh: 三十五年四月，上親征噶爾丹，所部諸扎薩克奏：「臣等被噶爾丹掠，全部潰，賴聖主天威正其罪，請從征效力。」

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-fifth year, when the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan, the jasaghs of the banner memorialized: 'We were plundered by Galdan and our whole following was scattered; relying on the sage ruler's heavenly might to punish his crime, we beg to follow the campaign and serve.'
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Kangxi 35 (1696), when the emperor marched against Galdan, the banner's jasaghs petitioned: 'Galdan ravaged us and scattered our people. By your majesty's power his crime will be punished; we ask to join the campaign.'

sentences.zh: 諭毋庸盡行隨往。

translations.literal: They were told that there was no need for all to follow.
translations.idiomatic: They were told not all needed to march.

sentences.zh: 五月，大軍既破噶爾丹於昭莫多，凱旋，大賚之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, after the main army had defeated Galdan at Jao Modo and returned in triumph, they were greatly rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, after the main army routed Galdan at Jao Modo and returned in triumph, they received lavish rewards.

sentences.zh: 明年，噶爾丹竄死，朔漠平，詔所部歸圖拉河遊牧。

translations.literal: The next year Galdan died in flight, the northern deserts were pacified, and the banner was ordered to return to pasture on the Tula River.
translations.idiomatic: The next year Galdan died in flight, the northern frontier was pacified, and the banner was ordered back to the Tula River pastures.

sentences.zh: 四十年，賜牧產贍給。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year, pastoral livestock was bestowed for their support.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 40 (1701) livestock was granted for their upkeep.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，以準噶爾策妄阿喇布坦煽眾喀爾喀，命散秩大臣祁裏德率大軍赴推河偵禦。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, because the Dzungar Tsewang Araptan stirred up the Khalkha masses, Attendant Minister Qilide was ordered to lead a great army to the Tui River to reconnoiter and guard.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 54 (1715), when the Dzungar Tsewang Araptan stirred unrest among the Khalkha, Attendant Minister Qilide was sent with a large force to scout and guard the Tui River.

sentences.zh: 廷議屯田鄂爾坤、圖拉裕軍食，詔詢土謝圖汗旺紮勒多爾濟勘奏所部可耕地，因言附近鄂爾坤、圖拉之蘇呼圖喀喇烏蘇、明愛察罕格爾、庫爾奇呼、紮布堪河、察罕廋爾、布拉罕口、烏蘭固木及額爾德尼昭十餘處俱可耕，命公傅爾丹選善耕人往屯種。

translations.literal: The court debated garrison farming at the Orkhon and Tula to provision the army; the Tüshiyetu Khan Wangjal Dorji was ordered to survey and report arable land in his banner; he stated that more than ten places near the Orkhon and Tula—Suhutu Qara Usu, Ming'ai Chaqan Ger, Kurqihu, Zhabkan River, Chaqan Nuur, Bulaghan Pass, Ulan Gumu, and Erdeni Juu—were all cultivable; Duke Furdan was ordered to select skilled farmers to go and farm colonies.
translations.idiomatic: The court debated garrison farming at the Orkhon and Tula to feed the army and asked Tüshiyetu Khan Wangjal Dorji to survey and report arable land in his banner. He named more than ten cultivable sites near the Orkhon and Tula, including Suhutu Qara Usu, Ming'ai Chaqan Ger, Kurqihu, the Zhabkan River, Chaqan Nuur, Bulaghan Pass, Ulan Gumu, and Erdeni Juu, and Duke Furdan was ordered to choose skilled farmers to go there for colony farming.

sentences.zh: 是年，詔簡所部兵駐防阿勒泰。

translations.literal: That year, troops were selected from the banner to garrison Altai.
translations.idiomatic: That year troops from the banner were posted to garrison Altai.

sentences.zh: 六十年，命土謝圖汗旺紮勒多爾濟督理俄羅斯邊境事。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year, Tüshiyetu Khan Wangjal Dorji was ordered to supervise Russian border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 60 (1721) Tüshiyetu Khan Wangjal Dorji was put in charge of affairs along the Russian border.

sentences.zh: 雍正二年，北路軍營移駐察罕廋爾及紮克拜達哩克。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yongzheng, the northern-route army camps were moved to garrison at Chaqan Nuur and Zhaqbai Dalik.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 2 (1724) the northern-route garrisons were shifted to Chaqan Nuur and Zhaqbai Dalik.

sentences.zh: 三年，以增設賽因諾顏部，定所部為喀爾喀後路。

translations.literal: In the third year, because the Sayin Noyan banner was newly established, the banner was fixed as the Khalkha rear route.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3 (1725), with the creation of the Sayin Noyan banner, this unit was designated the Khalkha rear route.

sentences.zh: 四年，旺紮勒多爾濟等因額爾德尼昭乏相宜穀種，遣人購之俄羅斯，並請助屯田兵糧。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Wangjal Dorji and others, because Erdeni Juu lacked suitable grain seed, sent men to purchase it in Russia and also requested aid in grain for the garrison farmers.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 (1726), Wangjal Dorji and others, lacking suitable seed at Erdeni Juu, sent men to buy grain in Russia and asked for rations for the garrison farmers.

sentences.zh: 諭廷臣曰：「前議屯田時，曾有奏言喀爾喀未必踴躍從事者。

translations.literal: The emperor told the court: 'When garrison farming was discussed before, some memorialized that the Khalkha might not eagerly take part.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told his ministers: 'When we first debated garrison farming, some said the Khalkha might not take to it willingly.

sentences.zh: 朕思此舉正為伊等計及久遠，豈有反不樂從之理？

translations.literal: I considered that this measure was precisely for their long-term benefit—how could there be reason for them not to welcome it?
translations.idiomatic: I meant this for their long-term good—why would they refuse?

sentences.zh: 今果感恩抒誠，與朕意相符，殊可嘉尚，交理籓院議敘。」

translations.literal: Now they have indeed shown gratitude and sincerity in accord with my intent—highly praiseworthy; refer the matter to the Court of Colonial Affairs to deliberate rewards.'
translations.idiomatic: They have now shown gratitude and loyalty as I hoped—commendable. Let the Court of Colonial Affairs decide their rewards.'

sentences.zh: 尋各予紀錄，並賚幣有差，詔如議。

translations.literal: Soon each was given a record of merit and bestowed silks in varying amounts, as the edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: Each soon received a merit record and gifts of silk in varying amounts, as ordered.

sentences.zh: 五年，以庫倫及恰克圖為所部與俄羅斯互市地，詔非市朝毋許俄羅斯逾楚庫河界。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Khüree and Kyakhta were made the banner's trading places with Russia; an edict ordered that except on market days Russians were not permitted to cross the Tchu River border.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727) Khüree and Kyakhta were designated as trading posts with Russia, and Russians were forbidden to cross the Tchu River except on market days.

sentences.zh: 是年，賽音諾顏親王額駙與俄羅斯定界。

translations.literal: That year, the Sayin Noyan Qinwang Efu fixed the border with Russia.
translations.idiomatic: That year Sayin Noyan Qinwang Efu demarcated the border with Russia.

sentences.zh: 九年，選兵隨大軍剿噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, troops were selected to follow the main army in suppressing Galdan Tsering.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9 (1731) troops were chosen to join the campaign against Galdan Tsering.

sentences.zh: 十三年，撤大軍還，詔所部兵留駐鄂爾坤及烏里雅蘇臺。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, the main army was withdrawn; the banner's troops were ordered to remain garrisoned at the Ergun and Uliastai.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) the main army withdrew, but banner troops remained at the Ergun and Uliastai.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，復選兵赴鄂爾坤防秋。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qianlong, troops were again selected to go to the Ergun for autumn defense.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 (1736) troops were again sent to the Ergun for autumn defense.

sentences.zh: 六年，命參贊大臣都統塔爾瑪善察閱防秋兵於烏克圖爾濟爾哈朗。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Assistant Minister and Banner Commander Talmašan was ordered to inspect the autumn-defense troops at Uktur Jerhalang.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 6 (1741) Assistant Minister Talmašan inspected the autumn garrison at Uktur Jerhalang.

sentences.zh: 以哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖移居庫倫，命土謝圖汗敦丹多爾濟駐守其地護視之。

translations.literal: Because the Jebzundamba Khutukhtu moved to Khüree, Tüshiyetu Khan Dundendorji was ordered to garrison that place and guard him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jebzundamba Khutukhtu moved to Khüree, Tüshiyetu Khan Dundendorji was stationed there to protect him.

sentences.zh: 十三年，選駝五百運歸化城米赴塔密爾軍營，命土謝圖汗延丕勒多爾濟督理俄羅斯邊境事。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, five hundred camels were selected to transport Guihuacheng grain to the Tamir army camp; Tüshiyetu Khan Yenpil Dorji was ordered to supervise Russian border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 13 (1748) five hundred camels carried Guihuacheng grain to the Tamir camp, and Tüshiyetu Khan Yenpil Dorji was put in charge of the Russian border.

sentences.zh: 十七年，增防鄂爾坤兵。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, Ergun garrison troops were increased.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 17 (1752) the Ergun garrison was reinforced.

sentences.zh: 十九年，移駐鄂爾海喀喇烏蘇。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, the garrison was moved to Erqai Qara Usu.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 19 (1754) the garrison was shifted to Erqai Qara Usu.

sentences.zh: 是部扎薩克親王額琳沁多爾濟授西路參贊大臣。

translations.literal: The banner's Jasagh Qinwang Erenchen Dorji was appointed Western-route Assistant Minister.
translations.idiomatic: The banner's Jasagh Qinwang Erenchen Dorji was made Western-route Assistant Minister.

sentences.zh: 二十年，進剿達瓦齊於伊犁。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, they advanced to suppress Dawachi at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 20 (1755) they marched against Dawachi at Ili.

sentences.zh: 時降酋阿睦爾撒納謀據伊犁，上燭其奸，詔入覲。

translations.literal: At that time the surrendered chief Amursana plotted to seize Ili; the emperor saw through his treachery and ordered him to come to audience.
translations.idiomatic: The surrendered chief Amursana then plotted to hold Ili. The emperor saw through him and ordered him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 定北將軍班第由尼楚袞軍營遣額琳沁多爾濟護之行。

translations.literal: Northern Pacification General Ban Di, from the Nichun army camp, sent Erenchen Dorji to escort him on the journey.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Pacification General Ban Di sent Erenchen Dorji from the Nichun camp to escort him.

sentences.zh: 至烏隆古河，阿睦爾撒納以北路定邊左副將軍印授之，詭稱歸治裝，由額爾齊斯河馳遁。

translations.literal: At the Ulonggol River, Amursana gave him the seal of Northern-route Frontier-pacification Left Vice Commander-in-chief, falsely claiming he was returning to pack, and fled at full speed along the Irtysh.
translations.idiomatic: At the Ulonggol River, Amursana handed him the seal of Northern-route Left Vice Commander and, claiming he was going back to pack, fled down the Irtysh.

sentences.zh: 翌日，額琳沁多爾濟追之弗及，論罪削爵擬斬，諭賜自盡。

translations.literal: The next day Erenchen Dorji pursued but could not overtake him; he was judged guilty, stripped of rank, and sentenced to decapitation; an edict granted him suicide.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Erenchen Dorji pursued but failed to catch him. He was stripped of rank and sentenced to death, then granted suicide by imperial order.

sentences.zh: 多羅貝勒車布登亦以駐防庫克嶺，不力追叛遁之巴朗，降貝子。

translations.literal: Doroi Beile Chebudeng also, for garrisoning Kukeling and not vigorously pursuing the rebel who had fled, Balang, was demoted to beizi.
translations.idiomatic: Doroi Beile Chebudeng, for failing to pursue the fugitive rebel Balang while garrisoning Kukeling, was demoted to beizi.

sentences.zh: 而扎薩克輔國公車登三丕勒以俘青袞咱卜功，扎薩克一等台吉達什旺勒以擒叛遁之和碩特訥默庫功，扎薩克一等台吉班珠爾多爾濟以獲阿睦爾撒納旗纛甲胄功，扎薩克一等台吉三都布多爾濟以赴紮布堪獲阿睦納撒納之孥及班珠爾等，並誅叛賊固爾班和卓輩功，均進爵賚賞有差。

translations.literal: Jasagh Fuguo Gong Ceden Sanbil was advanced for capturing Qinggunjab; Jasagh First-rank Taiji Dashiwangler for seizing the fugitive rebel Khošut Nemeku; Jasagh First-rank Taiji Banzur Dorji for capturing Amursana's banner standard and armor; Jasagh First-rank Taiji Sandub Dorji for going to Zhabkan and capturing Amursana's wives and children together with Banzur and others, and for executing the rebel traitors Gurban Khoja and his fellows—all were promoted in rank and rewarded in varying amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Jasagh Fuguo Gong Ceden Sanbil was promoted for capturing Qinggunjab; Jasagh First-rank Taiji Dashiwangler for seizing the fugitive Khošut Nemeku; Jasagh First-rank Taiji Banzur Dorji for taking Amursana's banner standard and armor; and Jasagh First-rank Taiji Sandub Dorji for capturing Amursana's family and Banzur at Zhabkan and killing the rebel Gurban Khoja and his followers—all received promotions and rewards in varying measure.

sentences.zh: 先是，土謝圖汗部編佐領，積三十七旗。

translations.literal: Previously, the Tüshiyetu Khan banner had been organized into zuoling, accumulating thirty-seven banners.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the Tüshiyetu Khan banner had been organized into thirty-seven zuoling banners.

sentences.zh: 以分置賽因諾顏部，析二十一旗，留十六旗，仍隸土謝圖汗部。

translations.literal: Because the Sayin Noyan banner was separately established, twenty-one banners were split off and sixteen remained, still subordinate to the Tüshiyetu Khan banner.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sayin Noyan banner was set apart, twenty-one banners were detached and sixteen remained under the Tüshiyetu Khan banner.

sentences.zh: 尋增四旗。

translations.literal: Soon four more banners were added.
translations.idiomatic: Four more banners were soon added.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克凡二十，盟於汗阿林，設正副盟長及副將軍、參贊各一。

translations.literal: There were twenty jasaghs in all, leagued at Khan Alin; one chief and deputy league head, one vice general, and one assistant minister were established.
translations.idiomatic: There were twenty jasaghs, leagued at Khan Alin, with one chief and deputy league head, one vice general, and one assistant minister.

sentences.zh: 爵二十有一：土謝圖汗一；

translations.literal: Titles numbered twenty-one: one Tüshiyetu Khan;
translations.idiomatic: Titles totaled twenty-one: one Tüshiyetu Khan;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克和碩親王一，由貝勒晉襲；

translations.literal: one Jasagh Hoshoi Qinwang, advanced from beile;
translations.idiomatic: one Jasagh Hoshoi Qinwang, promoted from beile;

sentences.zh: 附公品級一等台吉一；

translations.literal: one First-rank Taiji with attached ducal rank;
translations.idiomatic: one First-rank Taiji with attached ducal rank;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅郡王二，一由貝勒晉襲；

translations.literal: two Jasagh Doroi Junwang, one advanced from beile;
translations.idiomatic: two Jasagh Doroi Junwang, one promoted from beile;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克固山貝子二，一由郡王降襲，一由扎薩克台吉晉襲；

translations.literal: two Jasagh Gushan Beizi, one demoted from junwang, one advanced from Jasagh Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: two Jasagh Gushan Beizi, one demoted from junwang and one promoted from Jasagh Taiji;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克輔國公六，三由扎薩克台吉晉襲；

translations.literal: six Jasagh Fuguo Gong, three advanced from Jasagh Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: six Jasagh Fuguo Gong, three promoted from Jasagh Taiji;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克一等台吉八，一由貝子降襲。

translations.literal: eight Jasagh First-rank Taiji, one demoted from beizi.
translations.idiomatic: and eight Jasagh First-rank Taiji, one demoted from beizi.

sentences.zh: 是部本為喀爾喀四部之首，內則哲布尊丹巴，住錫庫倫，外則鄰接俄羅斯，有恰克圖互市，形勢特重，號稱雄劇。

translations.literal: This banner was originally foremost among the four Khalkha divisions; within, the Jebzundamba resided at Khüree; without, it bordered Russia and had the Kyakhta market—its strategic position was especially weighty, and it was called powerful and prominent.
translations.idiomatic: This banner had been foremost among the four Khalkha divisions. The Jebzundamba lived at Khüree within, while outside it bordered Russia and held the Kyakhta market—its strategic weight was exceptional, and it was regarded as the most powerful.

sentences.zh: 乾隆二十七年，於是部中旗汗山北之庫倫置辦事大臣，以滿洲大員任之；

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year of Qianlong, at Khüree north of Qihan Mountain within this banner, an administrative commissioner was established, filled by a high Manchu official;
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 (1762) an administrative commissioner was posted at Khüree, north of Qihan Mountain in this banner, filled by a senior Manchu official;

sentences.zh: 別選蒙古汗、王、公、扎薩克一人為辦事大臣，同釐其務。

translations.literal: and separately one Mongol khan, wang, gong, or jasagh was chosen as administrative commissioner to manage affairs together.
translations.idiomatic: and one Mongol khan, prince, or jasagh was chosen as co-commissioner to manage affairs with him.

sentences.zh: 和碩親王多羅額駙桑齋多爾濟以乾隆二十三年赴庫倫協理俄羅斯邊境事。

translations.literal: Hoshoi Qinwang Doroi Efu Sanjai Dorji was sent to Khüree in the twenty-third year of Qianlong to assist in managing Russian border affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 23 (1758), Hoshoi Qinwang Doroi Efu Sanjai Dorji was posted to Khüree to help manage affairs on the Russian frontier.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，停互市。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, the reciprocal market was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 27 (1762), border trade was suspended.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，桑齋多爾濟請增庫倫卡坐，派兵屯田依琫、布林噶勒台等處，不許。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, Sanjai Dorji requested additional Khüree border posts and garrison farming at Yibeng, Bulin Galtai, and other places; it was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 29 (1764), Sanjai Dorji asked to add Kyakhta border posts and station troops for farming at Yibeng, Bulin Galtai, and elsewhere; the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 三十年六月，命阿里袞索琳查辦恰克圖潛通貿易一案，以桑齋多爾濟私聽蒙人仍與俄商貿易，論罪削爵；

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirtieth year, Ari Gün and Suolin were ordered to investigate the case of covert trade at Kyakhta; Sanjai Dorji was found guilty of privately allowing Mongols to continue trading with Russian merchants and was stripped of his title;
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Qianlong 30 (1765), Ari Gün and Suolin were ordered to investigate illicit trade at Kyakhta; Sanjai Dorji was convicted of knowingly letting Mongols trade with Russian merchants and was stripped of his rank;

sentences.zh: 辦事大臣醜達以私市得賄正法。

translations.literal: Administrative Commissioner Chouda was executed for taking bribes in illicit trade.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Chouda was executed for accepting bribes from unauthorized trade.

sentences.zh: 十月，以是盟扎薩克貝子伊達木什布管俄羅斯卡坐。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Jasagh Beizi Idamishib of this league was placed in charge of the Russian border posts.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Jasagh Beizi Idamishib of the league was put in charge of the Russian border posts.

sentences.zh: 三十三年，庫倫辦事大臣慶桂等奏俄羅斯遣使乞開關交易，允之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-third year, Khüree Commissioner Qing Gui and others memorialized that Russia had sent envoys requesting to reopen border trade; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 33 (1768), Khüree Commissioner Qing Gui reported that Russia had sent envoys asking to reopen trade; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 仍申內地商人圖增價值之禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition against inland merchants inflating prices was again proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The ban on inland merchants marking up prices was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 尋命桑齋多爾濟復任。

translations.literal: Soon Sanjai Dorji was ordered to resume his post.
translations.idiomatic: Sanjai Dorji was soon ordered back to his post.

sentences.zh: 四十二年，定庫倫辦事大臣兼轄辦事章京，民、蒙交涉事件均具報辦理例。

translations.literal: In the forty-second year, regulations were fixed whereby the Khüree commissioner also supervised the clerks, and all Han-Mongol contact cases were to be reported and handled.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 42 (1777), rules were set for the Khüree commissioner to oversee the clerks and for all Han-Mongol contact cases to be reported and handled.

sentences.zh: 四十三年，桑齋多爾濟奏俄羅斯人私越邊口賣馬，俄員瑪玉爾不肯前來，暫停貿易，即咨示俄固畢納托爾，上是之。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year, Sanjai Dorji memorialized that Russians were secretly crossing the border to sell horses and that the Russian official Mayuer refused to come; trade was temporarily halted, and the Russian governor-general was immediately notified; the emperor approved.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 43 (1778), Sanjai Dorji reported that Russians were smuggling horses across the border and that the Russian officer Mayuer would not appear; trade was suspended and the Russian governor-general was notified at once; the emperor approved.

sentences.zh: 七月，諭桑齋多爾濟會同辦事大臣博清額，商辦內地商人給還俄羅斯欠貨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Sanjai Dorji was instructed to join Administrative Commissioner Boqing'e in arranging for inland merchants to repay goods owed to Russia.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Sanjai Dorji was ordered to work with Commissioner Boqing'e to settle inland merchants' debts to Russian traders.

sentences.zh: 十一月，桑齋多爾濟卒，命土謝圖汗車登多爾濟往庫倫協同博清額辦事。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Sanjai Dorji died; Tüshiyetu Khan Ceden Dorji was ordered to Khüree to assist Boqing'e in administration.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Sanjai Dorji died; Tüshiyetu Khan Ceden Dorji was sent to Khüree to assist Boqing'e.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，復開市。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year, the market was reopened.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 45 (1780), trade was reopened.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，以車登多爾濟私給乘騎烏拉黃緞照票，罷庫倫辦事大臣，命賽因諾顏親王拉旺多爾濟代之，仍命桑齋多爾濟之子郡王蘊端多爾濟隨同辦事，定喀爾喀四部烏拉章程。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year, because Ceden Dorji had privately issued yellow-satin ula passes, he was dismissed as Khüree commissioner; Sayin Noyan Prince Lawang Dorji was appointed in his stead, and Sanjai Dorji's son Junwang Yunton Dorji was still ordered to assist in administration; regulations for ula across the four Khalkha divisions were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 48 (1783), Ceden Dorji was removed as Khüree commissioner for privately issuing yellow-satin ula passes; Sayin Noyan Prince Lawang Dorji replaced him, while Sanjai Dorji's son Junwang Yunton Dorji continued as co-administrator; regulations governing ula service across the four Khalkha divisions were established.

sentences.zh: 十二月，命蘊端多爾濟列名在辦事大臣勒保之前。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Yunton Dorji was ordered to be listed before Commissioner Lepao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Yunton Dorji was ranked ahead of Commissioner Lepao.

sentences.zh: 四十九年，以俄羅斯屬布里雅特人劫內地往烏梁海貿易商民，賠貨而不交犯，屢檄其國。

translations.literal: In the forty-ninth year, because Buryats under Russian rule had robbed inland merchants trading toward Uriankhai, compensating goods but not surrendering the culprits, notes were repeatedly sent to their country.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 49 (1784), Buryats subject to Russia robbed inland merchants bound for Uriankhai, paid compensation but refused to hand over the offenders, and repeated demands were sent to Russia.

sentences.zh: 五十年春，以俄羅斯覆文支吾推宕，復停恰克圖互市。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fiftieth year, because Russia's reply was evasive and delaying, the Kyakhta market was again suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Qianlong 50 (1785), Russia's evasive reply led to another suspension of trade at Kyakhta.

sentences.zh: 辦事大臣松筠因定沿邊蒙古需用煙茶布疋章程。

translations.literal: Commissioner Songyun accordingly fixed regulations on tobacco, tea, and cloth needed by Mongols along the border.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Songyun then set regulations for tobacco, tea, and cloth supplies needed by border Mongols.

sentences.zh: 五十一年九月，定土、車兩部及賽、紮兩部每年各帶一部人入圍場，土、車兩盟部落人交庫倫辦事王大臣帶領習圍，賽、紮兩盟部落人仍交烏里雅蘇臺將軍大臣帶領習圍，並令部落每年自汗、王至公各揀派一人，台吉內各揀派四人，領職銜較大者二名，微末台吉二名，仍作十名善射赴木蘭圍場例。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the fifty-first year, it was fixed that the Tüshiyetu and Sechen divisions and the Sayin and Jasak divisions would each yearly bring one division's men to the hunting grounds; men of the Tüshiyetu and Sechen leagues were handed over to the Khüree princely commissioner to lead in hunting practice, while men of the Sayin and Jasak leagues remained handed over to the Uliastai general to lead in hunting practice; and each banner was ordered yearly to select one man from khan through gong rank and four taiji—two of higher rank and two lesser taiji—still totaling ten skilled archers to go to the Mulan hunting grounds as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Qianlong 51 (1786), it was ruled that the Tüshiyetu and Sechen divisions and the Sayin and Jasak divisions would each send one division annually to the imperial hunt: Tüshiyetu and Sechen tribesmen were assigned to the Khüree princely commissioner for drill, while Sayin and Jasak tribesmen remained under the Uliastai general. Each banner was to pick one man from khan down to gong rank and four taiji—two senior and two junior—ten skilled archers in all, for Mulan as before.

sentences.zh: 五十四年，俄屬布裏雅特人傷我出卡巡兵，松筠檄俄固畢納托爾捕送置之法。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fourth year, Buryats under Russia wounded our border patrol soldiers; Songyun sent a note to the Russian governor-general demanding capture and delivery for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 54 (1789), Russian Buryats wounded Qing border patrols; Songyun demanded that the Russian governor-general arrest and extradite the offenders.

sentences.zh: 適有自俄歸之土爾扈特喇嘛薩麻林言俄將興兵構釁。

translations.literal: Just then a Torghut lama named Samalin, returned from Russia, reported that Russia intended to raise troops and provoke conflict.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Torghut lama Samalin, recently back from Russia, claimed Russia was preparing to mobilize and pick a fight.

sentences.zh: 廷旨命松筠檄詢。

translations.literal: A court decree ordered Songyun to send a note of inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The court ordered Songyun to send a formal inquiry.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，是部戈壁數旗災，扎薩克台吉烏爾湛紮布報以應收賦及自畜牛羊賑給，並令有力台吉官兵周恤貧者。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, several Gobi banners of this division suffered disaster; Jasagh Taiji Urjanjab reported using collected taxes and his own livestock for relief, and ordered able taiji and soldiers to care for the poor.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 55 (1790), several Gobi banners in this division were hit by famine; Jasagh Taiji Urjanjab used tax receipts and his own herds for relief and ordered wealthy taiji and soldiers to aid the poor.

sentences.zh: 事聞，上嘉之。

translations.literal: When the matter was reported, the emperor praised it.
translations.idiomatic: When this was reported, the emperor commended him.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，松筠奏俄守邊目力辨其誣，詔誅薩麻林，許俄復市。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year, Songyun memorialized that the Russian border official had proven the accusation false; an edict ordered Samalin's execution and permitted Russia to resume trade.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 56 (1791), Songyun reported that the Russian border officer had refuted the charge; Samalin was ordered executed and trade with Russia was allowed to resume.

sentences.zh: 松筠與接任辦事大臣普福、協辦貝子遜都布多爾濟赴恰克圖，曉諭俄固畢納托爾，嗣後如遇會辦事件，應如例迅速完結，命盜案犯，應送恰克圖鞫實正法，彼此約束商販，毋有積欠，因與立約，永為遵守。

translations.literal: Songyun, together with succeeding Commissioner Pufu and assisting Beizi Sundub Dorji, went to Kyakhta and instructed the Russian governor-general that hereafter joint cases should be concluded promptly as prescribed, convicted thieves should be sent to Kyakhta for verified execution, both sides should restrain merchants and avoid outstanding debts, and on this basis a treaty was made to be forever observed.
translations.idiomatic: Songyun, incoming Commissioner Pufu, and assisting Beizi Sundub Dorji went to Kyakhta and told the Russian governor-general that future joint cases must be settled promptly, convicted thieves extradited to Kyakhta for punishment, merchants kept in check and debts cleared—a pact both sides pledged to uphold permanently.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶七年三月，土謝圖汗車登多爾濟等備行圍進哨馬匹，上嘉之。

translations.literal: In the third month of Jiaqing 7, Tüshiyetu Khan Ceden Dorji and others prepared horses for the hunting entourage and border patrol; the emperor commended them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Jiaqing 7 (1802), Tüshiyetu Khan Ceden Dorji and others furnished horses for the hunt and border patrol; the emperor praised them.

sentences.zh: 八月，定土謝圖汗、車臣汗二部事務在庫倫會集，與辦事大臣一同辦理例。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, it was fixed that affairs of the Tüshiyetu Khan and Sechen Khan divisions were to be convened at Khüree and handled together with the commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Tüshiyetu Khan and Sechen Khan affairs were required to be assembled at Khüree and handled jointly with the commissioner.

sentences.zh: 自是土、車二部重大事件，皆由庫倫辦事大臣專奏。

translations.literal: From this time, major affairs of the two divisions were memorialized exclusively by the Khüree commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth major matters of both divisions were reported solely by the Khüree commissioner.

sentences.zh: 允蘊端多爾濟請，每逾十年巡察俄羅斯交界卡倫一次。

translations.literal: Yunton Dorji's request was granted: every ten years the Russian border pickets were to be inspected once.
translations.idiomatic: Yunton Dorji's request was approved: the Russian border pickets would be inspected once every ten years.

sentences.zh: 八年八月，允蘊端多爾濟請，土謝圖汗部扎薩克齊旺多爾濟、齊巴克紮布等旗，及哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖徒眾所屬地方，免驅逐種地民人禁。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the eighth year, Yunton Dorji's request was granted: in the banners of Jasaghs Qiwan Dorji, Qibakjab, and others of the Tüshiyetu Khan division, and in lands belonging to the Jebzundamba Khutuktu's disciples, the prohibition on expelling farming settlers was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Jiaqing 8 (1803), Yunton Dorji's petition was granted: in the banners of Jasaghs Qiwan Dorji, Qibakjab, and others of the Tüshiyetu Khan division, and on lands of the Jebzundamba Khutuktu's followers, the ban on expelling farming settlers was lifted.

sentences.zh: 嗣後另墾地畝，添建房屋，侵佔遊牧，並令從前租種者，按地納租。

translations.literal: Henceforth newly reclaimed fields, added buildings, and encroachments on pastures were forbidden, and those who had previously rented land were ordered to pay rent according to the land.
translations.idiomatic: New reclamation, new construction, and encroachment on pasture were forbidden thereafter, and prior tenants were required to pay rent by acreage.

sentences.zh: 娶蒙女為妻者，身故之後，妻子給該處扎薩克為奴隸。

translations.literal: Those who had taken Mongol women as wives—after their death, wife and children were given to the local jasagh as slaves.
translations.idiomatic: Men who married Mongol women—upon their death, wife and children passed to the local jasagh as bondsmen.

sentences.zh: 呼圖克圖徒眾地方即為其所屬。

translations.literal: The Khutuktu's disciples' lands were considered his domain.
translations.idiomatic: Lands of the Khutuktu's followers were deemed his jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 並定該處居民按人給照，每年由蘊端多爾濟派員檢查，造冊報院；

translations.literal: Regulations were also fixed that residents there were to receive per-person passes; each year Yunton Dorji would dispatch personnel to inspect and compile registers reported to the Lifan Yuan;
translations.idiomatic: Residents there were to receive individual passes; each year Yunton Dorji would send inspectors to compile registers for the Lifan Yuan;

sentences.zh: 及再有無照之民任意棲止，盟長、扎薩克等治罪例。

translations.literal: and if unlicensed persons again settled at will, league heads and jasaghs were subject to punishment.
translations.idiomatic: and league heads and jasaghs would be punished if unlicensed persons settled freely again.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，庫倫遣蒙員同俄員勘明疆界。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Khüree dispatched Mongol personnel together with Russian personnel to survey and fix the border.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 23 (1843), Khüree sent Mongol and Russian personnel jointly to survey the frontier.

sentences.zh: 道光四年三月，以庫倫章京尚安泰查驗伊琫等處種地民人不能核事，致民人等盤踞遊牧，署車淩多爾濟扎薩克印務之台吉貢蘇倫呈報驅逐，又誤毀領照人民房屋，命奪職，蘊端多爾濟等議處。

translations.literal: In the third month of Daoguang 4, because Khüree clerk Shang Antai's inspection of farming settlers at Yibeng and elsewhere failed to verify matters, causing settlers to occupy pastures, Taiji Gunsulen, acting for Jasagh Cheling Dorji, reported expulsion but mistakenly destroyed licensed settlers' houses; he was stripped of office and Yunton Dorji and others were disciplined.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Daoguang 4 (1824), Khüree clerk Shang Antai failed to verify farming settlers at Yibeng and elsewhere, allowing squatting on pasture; Taiji Gunsulen, acting for Jasagh Cheling Dorji, reported expulsion but wrongly demolished licensed houses; he was dismissed and Yunton Dorji and others were censured.

sentences.zh: 仍申各旗容留無票民人之禁。

translations.literal: The prohibition against banners harboring persons without passes was again proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: The ban on banners sheltering persons without passes was reaffirmed.

sentences.zh: 七年，蘊端多爾濟卒，以綸布多爾濟代為庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Yunton Dorji died; Lunbudorji was appointed Khüree commissioner in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 7 (1827), Yunton Dorji died; Lunbudorji became Khüree commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二年，多爾濟拉布坦代之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Dorji Labtan replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 12 (1832), Dorji Labtan succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 十五年，多爾濟拉布坦奏喀爾喀招民墾復拋荒地畝章程，諭不許。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Dorji Labtan memorialized regulations for recruiting settlers to reclaim abandoned Khalkha farmland; an edict forbade it.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 15 (1835), Dorji Labtan proposed rules to recruit settlers for abandoned Khalkha land; the court refused.

sentences.zh: 十二月，命德勒克多爾濟為庫倫學習幫辦大臣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Delek Dorji was appointed Khüree assistant commissioner in training.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Delek Dorji was named Khüree assistant commissioner in training.

sentences.zh: 十八年，多爾濟拉布坦奏管卡倫扎薩克那木濟勒多爾濟擅以奇爾渾卡倫兵丁與明濟卡倫兵丁互相移駐，撤差，仍議處。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, Dorji Labtan memorialized that Jasagh Namjile Dorji, overseer of border pickets, had without authorization transferred soldiers between Chir Khün and Mingji pickets; he was dismissed and still subject to disciplinary action.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 18 (1838), Dorji Labtan reported that picket overseer Jasagh Namjile Dorji had illegally swapped garrisons between Chir Khün and Mingji pickets; he was removed and disciplined.

sentences.zh: 十九年，允哲布尊丹巴往庫倫之北伊魯格河溫泉坐湯，命辦事大臣福英護視。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, permission was granted for the Jebzundamba to take the waters at the hot springs of the Irüg River north of Khüree; Commissioner Fuying was ordered to escort and oversee.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 19 (1839), the Jebzundamba was allowed to bathe at the Irüg River hot springs north of Khüree; Commissioner Fuying was ordered to escort him.

sentences.zh: 四月，多爾濟拉布坦卒，以德勒克多爾濟代為庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Dorji Labtan died; Delek Dorji was appointed Khüree commissioner in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Dorji Labtan died; Delek Dorji replaced him as Khüree commissioner.

sentences.zh: 二十一年六月，俄羅斯薩納特衙門咨理籓院，聞中國嚴禁鴉片入界，已諄飭所屬不得在交界之處互相販帶偷運。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-first year, Russia's Senate notified the Lifan Yuan that, hearing China strictly forbade opium entry, it had earnestly ordered its subjects not to trade or smuggle it at the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Daoguang 21 (1841), Russia's Senate informed the Lifan Yuan that, learning China banned opium, it had strictly ordered its people not to trade or smuggle it at the frontier.

sentences.zh: 諭庫倫辦事大臣嚴禁內地貿易人等在交界處所私行販運煙土，以綏外籓、除積弊。

translations.literal: The Khüree commissioner was instructed strictly to forbid inland traders from privately transporting opium at the border, to reassure outer vassals and eliminate longstanding abuses.
translations.idiomatic: The Khüree commissioner was ordered to stop inland traders from smuggling opium at the border, to calm outer vassals and root out old abuses.

sentences.zh: 二十二年九月，德勒克多爾濟以庫倫地方商民盤踞一案，下部議處。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-second year, Delek Dorji, over the case of merchants squatting in Khüree, was referred to the ministry for disciplinary deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Daoguang 22 (1842), Delek Dorji was referred to the ministry for discipline over the Khüree merchant-squatting case.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年，土謝圖汗、車臣汗兩部汗、王、公、台吉等請捐助軍需，溫旨卻之。

translations.literal: In Xianfeng 4, khans, princes, gong, and taiji of the Tüshiyetu Khan and Sechen Khan divisions requested to donate military supplies; warm edicts declined.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 4 (1854), khans, princes, gong, and taiji of the Tüshiyetu Khan and Sechen Khan divisions offered military donations; gracious edicts declined.

sentences.zh: 八年，允俄羅斯使人由庫倫至張家口入京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, Russian envoys were permitted to travel from Khüree through Zhangjiakou to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 8 (1858), Russian envoys were allowed to go from Khüree via Zhangjiakou to Beijing.

sentences.zh: 十一年，德勒克多爾濟遷，以多爾濟那木凱代為庫倫辦事大臣，尋令車臣汗阿爾塔什達代之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Delek Dorji was transferred; Dorji Namkai was appointed Khüree commissioner, and soon Sechen Khan Altashda was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 11 (1861), Delek Dorji was transferred out; Dorji Namkai became commissioner, and soon Sechen Khan Altashda replaced him.

sentences.zh: 以辦事大臣色克通額帶操演鳥槍兵丁赴恰克圖，命多爾濟那木凱妥辦庫倫事件。

translations.literal: As Commissioner Seketong'e took musket-drill soldiers to Kyakhta, Dorji Namkai was ordered properly to manage Khüree affairs.
translations.idiomatic: While Commissioner Seketong'e took musket-drill troops to Kyakhta, Dorji Namkai was told to manage Khüree affairs properly.

sentences.zh: 四月，色克通額奏俄商欲於庫倫貿易，行文阻止。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Seketong'e memorialized that Russian merchants wished to trade at Khüree; a dispatch was sent to stop them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Seketong'e reported Russian merchants trying to trade at Khüree; a dispatch blocked them.

sentences.zh: 六月，總理各國事務王大臣奏准俄人在庫倫修理公館。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the Prince Minister of Foreign Affairs memorialized approval for Russians to repair their legation at Khüree.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, the Prince Minister of Foreign Affairs approved repairs to the Russian legation at Khüree.

sentences.zh: 十一月，色克通額奏俄商擅往蒙古各旗貿易。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Seketong'e memorialized that Russian merchants were going without authorization to trade in Mongol banners.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Seketong'e reported Russian merchants trading without permission in Mongol banners.

sentences.zh: 諭守約開導，並交總理各國事務衙門照會俄使禁阻。

translations.literal: An edict ordered adherence to treaties and persuasion, and referred the matter to the Zongli Yamen to notify the Russian envoy to forbid and obstruct.
translations.idiomatic: An edict called for treaty compliance and persuasion, and referred the case to the Zongli Yamen to notify the Russian envoy to stop it.

sentences.zh: 十二月，撤恰克圖習槍官兵。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, musket-drill soldiers at Kyakhta were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Kyakhta musket-drill troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，定俄國陸路通商章程條款。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi 1, articles of the Russian overland trade regulations were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 1 (1862), the articles of the Sino-Russian overland trade treaty were set.

sentences.zh: 三年，以新疆回亂，調土謝圖汗、車臣汗兩部蒙兵赴烏魯木齊等處助剿。

translations.literal: In the third year, because of the Muslim rebellion in Xinjiang, Mongol troops of the Tüshiyetu Khan and Sechen Khan divisions were mobilized to Ürümqi and elsewhere to assist in suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3 (1864), with Xinjiang in Muslim revolt, Mongol troops of the Tüshiyetu Khan and Sechen Khan divisions were sent to Ürümqi and elsewhere to help suppress it.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，以土、車兩盟蒙兵潰散回旗，諭文盛等不必再令赴營。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year, because Mongol soldiers of the two leagues had scattered and returned to their banners, Wensheng and others were instructed not to order them to camp again.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Tongzhi 4 (1865), after Tüshiyetu and Sechen troops had broken up and returned home, Wensheng and others were told not to send them back to camp.

sentences.zh: 以圖盟援古城蒙兵逗留，扎薩克達爾瑪僧格嚴議。

translations.literal: Because Tümen league troops aiding Gucheng had lingered, Jasagh Darmasengge was severely disciplined.
translations.idiomatic: Because Tümen-league troops sent to aid Gucheng had stalled, Jasagh Darmasengge was severely punished.

sentences.zh: 五年，命辦喀爾喀四盟捐輸。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, donations from the four Khalkha leagues were ordered managed.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5 (1866), the four Khalkha leagues were ordered to organize contributions.

sentences.zh: 六年，調土、車兩盟兵一千五百名駐防卡倫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, 1,500 soldiers from the two leagues were mobilized to garrison border pickets.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 6 (1867), 1,500 troops from both leagues were posted to garrison border pickets.

sentences.zh: 八年，改訂中俄陸路通商章程，兩國邊界貿易在百里內均不納稅；

translations.literal: In the eighth year, the Sino-Russian overland trade regulations were revised: trade within a hundred li of the border on both sides was tax-free;
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 8 (1869), the overland trade treaty was revised: border trade within a hundred li on either side was duty-free;

sentences.zh: 俄商許往中國所屬設官之蒙古各處，亦不納稅；

translations.literal: Russian merchants were permitted to go to administered Mongol territories under China and likewise paid no tax;
translations.idiomatic: Russian merchants could trade in administered Mongol areas under Qing rule without paying tax;

sentences.zh: 其不設官之蒙古地方，該商欲前往貿易，亦不攔阻，惟該商應有邊界官執照。

translations.literal: in unadministered Mongol lands, if merchants wished to trade they would not be obstructed, provided they held passes from border officials.
translations.idiomatic: in unadministered Mongol regions they would not be blocked if they wished to trade, but required passes from frontier officials.

sentences.zh: 九年二月，回匪東竄，自三音諾顏左翼右旗扎薩克阿巴爾米特遊牧擾是部左翼後旗鎮國公巴勒達爾多爾濟遊牧。

translations.literal: In the second month of the ninth year, Muslim rebels fled eastward; from Sayin Noyan's left-wing right banner Jasagh Abarmit they disturbed the pastures of State Guardian Duke Baledar Dorji of this division's left-wing rear banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tongzhi 9 (1870), Muslim rebels fled east from Sayin Noyan left-wing right-banner Jasagh Abarmit's pastures and raided State Guardian Duke Baledar Dorji's left-wing rear banner in this division.

sentences.zh: 辦事大臣張廷岳等奏：「蒙古地方幅員遼闊，蒙眾皆擇水草旺處遊牧，相距數十里始有氈廬。

translations.literal: Commissioner Zhang Tingyue and others memorialized: "Mongol territory is vast; Mongols choose lush pastures and may be dozens of li apart before one finds a yurt.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Zhang Tingyue memorialized: "Mongol lands are vast; herders camp where grass is best, with yurts often dozens of li apart.

sentences.zh: 且百餘年安享太平，久不知兵。

translations.literal: Moreover, they have enjoyed peace for more than a hundred years and long known nothing of war.
translations.idiomatic: They have lived in peace for over a century and scarcely know war.

sentences.zh: 賊知蒙古易欺，是以百數成群，縱橫肆擾。

translations.literal: The bandits know Mongols are easy prey, and so roam in bands of a hundred or so, plundering at will.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels know Mongols are soft targets and raid in bands of a hundred or more.

sentences.zh: 擬調駐卡倫蒙兵，檄兩部落盟長等帶往西南一帶，與各旗官兵協剿。

translations.literal: It is proposed to mobilize garrison Mongol troops and order league heads of both divisions to lead them to the southwest, jointly suppressing together with banner soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: We propose to move garrison Mongol troops and have league heads lead them southwest to join banner forces in suppression.

sentences.zh: 庫倫地方塔廟甲於各旗，商賈輻輳，人煙稠密。

translations.literal: Khüree's temples surpass those of every banner; merchants gather and the population is dense.
translations.idiomatic: Khüree's monasteries outrank every banner's; merchants throng there and the population is dense.

sentences.zh: 現派桑卓特巴等調集喇嘛、鄂拓克防護廟宇。

translations.literal: Sangzhoteba and others have now been dispatched to assemble lamas and otok to guard the temples.
translations.idiomatic: Sangzhoteba and others have been sent to muster lamas and otok to defend the temples.

sentences.zh: 又令商民辦理保甲，以資守禦。」

translations.literal: Merchants were also ordered to organize baojia for defense.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants were also ordered to form baojia militia for defense."

sentences.zh: 六月，張廷嶽等奏以土盟兵九百名交扎薩克公奈當等防守額爾德尼昭。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Zhang Tingyue and others memorialized that 900 soldiers of the Tüshiyetu league were handed to Jasagh Gong Naidang and others to defend Erdene Zuu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Zhang Tingyue reported assigning 900 Tüshiyetu-league troops to Jasagh Gong Naidang and others to guard Erdene Zuu.

sentences.zh: 七月，俄調馬隊在庫倫操演，諭張廷岳等查察。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, Russia deployed cavalry drilling at Khüree; Zhang Tingyue and others were instructed to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Russian cavalry drilled at Khüree; Zhang Tingyue and others were ordered to investigate.

sentences.zh: 尋以烏裏雅蘇台危急，張廷嶽等奏調土、車兩盟兵會剿。

translations.literal: Soon, because Uliastai was critical, Zhang Tingyue and others memorialized to mobilize soldiers of both leagues for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, with Uliastai in peril, Zhang Tingyue requested troops from both leagues for a joint campaign.

sentences.zh: 十二月，請以賽、紮兩盟協防庫倫官兵二百名歸併賽、紮兩盟，派兵分防要隘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, request that 200 soldiers of the Sayin and Jasak leagues assisting Khüree defense be returned to those leagues, with troops dispatched to guard strategic passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, they asked to return 200 Sayin and Jasak league troops aiding Khüree to their leagues and redeploy men to key passes.

sentences.zh: 十年二月，回匪復竄額哲呢河一帶，圖犯庫倫。

translations.literal: In the second month of the tenth year, Muslim rebels again fled to the Ezheni River region, intending to strike Khüree.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tongzhi 10 (1871), Muslim rebels reappeared along the Ezheni River, threatening Khüree.

sentences.zh: 張廷嶽等奏迅檄達爾濟等軍赴哈爾尼敦西北地方防剿。

translations.literal: Zhang Tingyue and others memorialized urgently dispatching Darji and other forces to the northwest of Kharnidun for defense and suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingyue urgently dispatched Darji's force northwest of Kharnidun to intercept them.

sentences.zh: 十一年，張廷嶽奏：「前調土、車兩盟官兵餉糈，上年由兩盟捐輸支給。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Zhang Tingyue memorialized: "Rations for Tüshiyetu and Sechen troops previously mobilized were paid last year by donations from both leagues.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 11 (1872), Zhang Tingyue reported: "Rations for earlier Tüshiyetu and Sechen detachments were paid last year by league donations.

sentences.zh: 烏城被陷，復奏調內地官兵來庫防剿，檄土、車兩盟及沙畢捐備馬三千匹，資漢兵騎乘，又借雇駝馬數千隻，分赴各台。

translations.literal: After Urga fell, inland troops were again mobilized to Khüree for defense and suppression; both leagues and shabi were ordered to supply 3,000 horses for Han cavalry and to hire thousands of camels for the relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: After Urga fell, inland troops were sent to Khüree; both leagues and shabi were told to furnish 3,000 horses for Han cavalry and hire thousands of camels for relay stations.

sentences.zh: 兩盟官兵自上年遣散，改征作防，應需駝馬三千餘只，亦系各旗攤派。」

translations.literal: Since troops of both leagues were dismissed last year and shifted to garrison duty, more than 3,000 camels were also needed and assessed across the banners.
translations.idiomatic: After last year's demobilization, garrison duty still required over 3,000 camels, levied across the banners."

sentences.zh: 四月，回匪竄是部左翼中旗郡王拉蘇倫巴咱爾遊牧，焚掠府廟，東犯莫霍爾、嘎順等台。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Muslim rebels reached the pastures of Junwang Lasu Lunbazar of this division's left-wing middle banner, burned temples and offices, and struck east toward Mohor, Gashun, and other relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, rebels reached Junwang Lasu Lunbazar's left-wing middle banner, burned temples and offices, and pushed east toward Mohor, Gashun, and other stations.

sentences.zh: 張廷岳遣蒙員劄齊魯克齊、伯克瓦齊爾等追敗之於烏拉特中旗沙巴克烏蘇地方。

translations.literal: Zhang Tingyue sent Mongol officers Jaqiluq and Borqawazir to pursue and defeat them at Shabak Usu in the middle banner of the Urad.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingyue sent Mongol officers Jaqiluq and Borqawazir to pursue and rout them at Shabak Usu in Urad middle banner.

sentences.zh: 六月，副都統杜嘎爾奏回匪於四月由圖盟公巴勒達爾多爾濟遊牧竄出順新地方。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Vice Commander Dugar memorialized that in the fourth month the rebels had fled from Tümen league Gong Baledar Dorji's pastures toward Shunxin.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Vice Commander Dugar reported that in April rebels had fled Tümen league Gong Baledar Dorji's pastures toward Shunxin.

sentences.zh: 五月，竄郡王拉蘇倫巴咱爾遊牧之巴爾圖叟吉地方。

translations.literal: In the fifth month they reached Bartu Sogji on Junwang Lasu Lunbazar's pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In May they reached Bartu Sogji on Junwang Lasu Lunbazar's pastures.

sentences.zh: 派吉爾洪額帶隊改道躡賊。

translations.literal: Jirhong'e was dispatched with a detachment to change route and track the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Jirhong'e was sent with a column to cut across and trail the rebels.

sentences.zh: 時回匪復西竄左翼中左旗扎薩克達爾瑪僧格遊牧，至烏拉特中公旗之布特拉地方。

translations.literal: At that time the rebels again fled west to the pastures of Jasagh Darmasengge of the left-wing middle-left banner, reaching Butra in the Urad middle public banner.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile rebels fled west to Jasagh Darmasengge's left-wing middle-left banner, reaching Butra in Urad middle public banner.

sentences.zh: 吉爾洪額會伯克瓦齊爾進擊，大勝之。

translations.literal: Jirhong'e joined Borqawazir in an advance attack and won a great victory.
translations.idiomatic: Jirhong'e and Borqawazir attacked together and won a decisive victory.

sentences.zh: 八月，回匪復竄是部左翼後旗公巴勒達爾多爾濟遊牧，直趨翁吉河一帶。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Muslim rebels again reached the pastures of Gong Baledar Dorji of this division's left-wing rear banner and headed straight for the Ongi River region.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, rebels again hit Gong Baledar Dorji's left-wing rear banner and drove toward the Ongi River.

sentences.zh: 別股竄哲林等台，賽爾烏蘇西北台路斷。

translations.literal: Another band raided relay stations including Zherin; the northwest route through Saier Usu was cut.
translations.idiomatic: A separate band struck stations including Zherin, severing the Saier Usu northwest route.

sentences.zh: 張廷嶽等奏察哈爾所派達爾濟一軍抵翁吉河之烏勒幹呼秀地方，與是部左翼中左旗公齊莫特多爾濟及伯克瓦齊爾二營相犄角。

translations.literal: Zhang Tingyue and others memorialized that Darji's army dispatched from Chahar had reached Ulgan Khüshü on the Ongi River, forming pincers with two camps under Gong Qimot Dorji of the left-wing middle-left banner and Borqawazir.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Tingyue reported Darji's Chahar detachment at Ulgan Khüshü on the Ongi River, pincering with Gong Qimot Dorji's and Borqawazir's two camps.

sentences.zh: 是月二十一日，伯克瓦齊爾敗賊於察布察爾台之察罕吉哩瑪地方。

translations.literal: On the twenty-first day of that month, Borqawazir defeated the bandits at Chaqan Jirma near Zhabuchaqar station.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-first, Borqawazir beat the rebels at Chaqan Jirma near Zhabuchaqar station.

sentences.zh: 二十六日卯刻，伯克瓦齊爾星夜由間道窮追，繞出東犯庫倫匪前，敗之于阿達哈楚克山額里音華地方。

translations.literal: At the mao hour on the twenty-sixth, Borqawazir pursued by night along a hidden route, circled ahead of the rebels marching east against Khüree, and defeated them at Ada Khachun Mountain, Eriyinhua.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-sixth at dawn, Borqawazir marched by night, got ahead of the column threatening Khüree, and routed them at Ada Khachun Mountain, Eriyinhua.

sentences.zh: 午申刻連再捷，獲駝千餘、馬四百，圍賊于畢留廟，相持六晝夜。

translations.literal: By noon and shen he won again in succession, captured more than a thousand camels and four hundred horses, and besieged the bandits at Bilü Temple for six days and nights.
translations.idiomatic: By midday and evening he won twice more, seized over a thousand camels and four hundred horses, and besieged the rebels at Bilü Temple for six days and nights.

sentences.zh: 九月二日，達爾濟軍至畢留廟西北駐營，匪以投誠誑之，達爾濟遽阻伯克瓦齊爾軍巡邏，匪於是夜輕騎西遁。

translations.literal: On the second day of the ninth month, Darji's army encamped northwest of Bilü Temple; the bandits feigned surrender and deceived him, and Darji abruptly blocked Borqawazir's patrol; that night the rebels fled west with light cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On the second of the ninth month, Darji camped northwest of Bilü Temple; rebels feigned surrender, Darji blocked Borqawazir's pursuit, and that night they escaped west with light horse.

sentences.zh: 十二月，張廷嶽等奏前竄烏、庫兩城回匪，現均返肅州老巢。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Zhang Tingyue and others memorialized that the Muslim rebels who had previously fled to Urga and Khüree had now all returned to their old lairs at Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Zhang Tingyue reported that the rebels who had raided Urga and Khüree had all withdrawn to their old stronghold at Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 宣化、古北口二軍於本年到庫，擇要設防，足資捍衛。

translations.literal: The two armies from Xuanhua and Gubeikou reached Khüree that year; key points were chosen for defense, sufficient to provide protection.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Xuanhua and Gubeikou contingents reached Khüree and took up positions at key points, providing adequate defense.

sentences.zh: 土、車兩盟官兵擬裁半留半，每屆半年，輪換防護官署昭廟，撤沙畢兵。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers of the Tüshiyetu and Sechen Khan leagues were to be halved—half retained, half dismissed—rotating every six months to guard the commissioner offices and temples; shabi troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Tüshiyetu and Sechen Khan league troops were to be cut by half, with the remainder rotating every six months to guard commissioner offices and temples; shabi soldiers were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月，回匪復擾左翼後旗公巴勒達爾多爾濟遊牧，尋遁。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twelfth year, Muslim rebels again disturbed the pastures of State Guardian Duke Baledar Dorji of the left-wing rear banner, then fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tongzhi 12 (1873), rebels again raided State Guardian Duke Baledar Dorji's left-wing rear banner and soon withdrew.

sentences.zh: 三月，張廷嶽等奏：「庫倫事務較繁，請土、車兩盟之協理將軍，飭令每年輪班在庫聽候差委，勿赴烏城。」

translations.literal: In the third month, Zhang Tingyue and others memorialized: "Khüree affairs are comparatively numerous; we request that assistant generals of the Tüshiyetu and Sechen Khan leagues be ordered to take annual rotating duty at Khüree awaiting assignment, and not go to Urga."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Zhang Tingyue memorialized: "Khüree business is heavy; assistant generals of the Tüshiyetu and Sechen Khan leagues should rotate yearly duty at Khüree awaiting orders, not travel to Urga."

sentences.zh: 下金順等會商覆奏。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to Jin Shun and others for joint consultation and reply.
