translations.idiomatic: The memorial was referred to Jin Shun and others for joint consultation and reply.

sentences.zh: 諭催山東於五月前解清庫倫餉銀十萬兩，賚庫倫商民團勇。

translations.literal: An edict urged Shandong to remit 100,000 taels of Khüree pay before the fifth month and bestowed rewards on Khüree merchant militia.
translations.idiomatic: An edict pressed Shandong to deliver 100,000 taels of Khüree funds before the fifth month and rewarded Khüree merchant militia.

sentences.zh: 定變通辦理庫倫軍需章程。

translations.literal: Flexible regulations for managing Khüree military supplies were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Revised regulations for Khüree military logistics were established.

sentences.zh: 十三年九月，庫倫辦事大臣阿爾塔什達卒，以那木濟勒端多布代之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirteenth year, Khüree Commissioner Altashda died; Namjildondob was appointed to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Tongzhi 13 (1874), Commissioner Altashda died and Namjildondob replaced him.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，以庫倫解嚴，撤回直隸古北口練軍。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 1, because Khüree's martial law was lifted, the drill army from Gubeikou in Zhili was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 1 (1875), with Khüree's emergency lifted, the Gubeikou drill troops from Zhili were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月，以庫倫、哈拉河等處游匪尚多，仍撥直隸宣化練軍二百五十名駐之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fourth year, because roaming bandits remained numerous at Khüree, Hara River, and elsewhere, 250 drill soldiers from Xuanhua in Zhili were again assigned to garrison there.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Guangxu 4 (1878), with bandits still active around Khüree and the Hara River, 250 Xuanhua drill troops from Zhili were posted there again.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，以穆圖善奏，諭飭土謝圖汗迅將撤回托裏布拉克、圖固裏克二台幫台官兵駝馬，催令仍回本台。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year, on Mutushan's memorial, an edict ordered the Tüshiyetu Khan to promptly return the soldiers, camels, and horses withdrawn from the Toribulag and Tugulik relay stations and urge them back to their home stations.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangxu 5 (1879), on Mutushan's memorial, the Tüshiyetu Khan was ordered to return relay troops and camels withdrawn from Toribulag and Tugulik stations to their home posts.

sentences.zh: 五月，予捐輸銀兩之土謝圖汗那遜綽克圖等獎。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, rewards were given to Tüshiyetu Khan Nasan Choktu and others who had donated silver.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, Tüshiyetu Khan Nasan Choktu and others who had contributed silver were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 六年正月，以改議俄國歸還伊犁條約，籌備邊防，派土、車二盟兵二千蒙兵駐庫倫，撥軍火及備蒙古包銀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the sixth year, because the revised treaty on Russia's return of Ili was under discussion and border defense was being prepared, 2,000 Mongol soldiers from the two leagues were posted at Khüree, with arms and funds for Mongol tents allocated.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Guangxu 6 (1880), with the revised Ili treaty under negotiation, 2,000 Tüshiyetu and Sechen Khan troops were posted at Khüree with arms and tent allowances.

sentences.zh: 十二月，給庫倫防兵月餉。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, monthly pay was granted to Khüree garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Khüree garrison troops received monthly pay.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，撤駐庫倫蒙兵。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year, the Mongol garrison at Khüree was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangxu 7 (1881), the Mongol garrison at Khüree was withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 四月，以庫倫為俄人來往沖途，調喜昌為庫倫辦事大臣，統新軍千人赴之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, because Khüree lay on the main route of Russian travel, Xichang was transferred as Khüree commissioner, leading a thousand new-style troops there.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, with Khüree on a major Russian transit route, Xichang became commissioner and led a thousand new-style troops there.

sentences.zh: 是年，中俄訂續改陸路通商章程，俄國商民往蒙古貿易者，祗能由章程附清單內。

translations.literal: That year, China and Russia concluded revised overland trade regulations; Russian merchants trading in Mongolia could only use routes listed in the appendix to the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Sino-Russian overland trade treaty was revised: Russian merchants in Mongolia could only use routes on the approved list.

sentences.zh: 卡倫過界，應有本國官所發中、俄兩國文字，並譯出蒙文執照，註明姓名、貨色、包件、牲畜數目，於入中國邊界時，在卡倫呈驗。

translations.literal: When crossing border pickets, they must hold passes in Chinese and Russian issued by their own officials, with Mongol translations, noting names, goods, packages, and numbers of livestock, to be presented for inspection at the picket upon entering Chinese territory.
translations.idiomatic: At border pickets they had to show bilingual Chinese-Russian passes with Mongol translations listing names, goods, packages, and livestock, presented on entry to China.

sentences.zh: 其無執照商民過界，任憑中國官扣留。

translations.literal: Merchants crossing the border without passes might be detained at Chinese officials' discretion.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants crossing without passes could be detained by Chinese officials.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，喜昌奏考察庫倫時勢邊防情形，量議變通。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year, Xichang memorialized on investigating Khüree's current situation and border defense, proposing flexible measures.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Guangxu 8 (1882), Xichang reported on Khüree's situation and border defense and proposed reforms.

sentences.zh: 一、庫倫與恰克圖屯軍分駐。

translations.literal: First: garrison troops at Khüree and Kyakhta to be separately stationed.
translations.idiomatic: First: separate garrisons at Khüree and Kyakhta.

sentences.zh: 一、恰克圖改設道員鎮守邊塞。

translations.literal: Second: establish a circuit intendant at Kyakhta to guard the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Second: appoint a circuit intendant at Kyakhta to guard the frontier.

sentences.zh: 一、庫倫選練土著學試屯墾。

translations.literal: Third: select and drill local inhabitants at Khüree to trial colonization.
translations.idiomatic: Third: train local Khüree people for trial colonization.

sentences.zh: 一、庫倫屬境暨接連鄰省地方酌量屯兵。

translations.literal: Fourth: within Khüree's jurisdiction and adjoining provincial territory, station colonizing troops as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth: post colonizing troops within Khüree's jurisdiction and adjacent provinces as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 下所司議，格。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the relevant offices for deliberation and rejected.
translations.idiomatic: Referred to the ministries for deliberation and rejected.

sentences.zh: 尋以喜昌奏劾土盟盟長車林多爾濟，罷之，並下理籓院，議註銷土、車兩盟王公等駐班烏里雅蘇臺會盟之案。

translations.literal: Soon, on Xichang's impeachment of Tümen league chief Chörindorji, the latter was dismissed; the Lifan Yuan was also instructed to deliberate on canceling the arrangement for princes of the two leagues to attend league assemblies at Urga on rotating duty.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Xichang impeached Tümen league chief Chörindorji, who was dismissed; the Lifan Yuan was told to consider canceling princes' rotating duty at Urga league assemblies.

sentences.zh: 八月，喜昌等奏庫倫近與俄鄰，為漠北第一咽喉。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Xichang and others memorialized that Khüree, adjacent to Russia, was the foremost strategic pass of Outer Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Xichang reported that Khüree, bordering Russia, was Outer Mongolia's chief strategic chokepoint.

sentences.zh: 現駐兵設防，饋運轉輸，舊站繞遠，亟宜變通，改設捷徑。

translations.literal: With troops now garrisoned for defense, supply transport via old relay routes was too circuitous; flexible measures were urgently needed to establish shorter routes.
translations.idiomatic: With troops garrisoned there, supply lines on old relay routes were too long; shorter routes were urgently needed.

sentences.zh: 諭飭烏裏雅蘇台將軍、察哈爾都統迅速妥籌覆奏。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Urga general and Chahar commander to promptly prepare a proper reply.
translations.idiomatic: The Urga general and Chahar commander were ordered to prepare a reply promptly.

sentences.zh: 九年二月，喜昌奏台站遲滯，擬飭運草養駝，以資供應，並陳報災不實等情。

translations.literal: In the second month of the ninth year, Xichang memorialized that relay stations were delayed; he proposed ordering transport of fodder and camel maintenance for supply, and reported false disaster claims and other matters.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangxu 9 (1883), Xichang reported relay delays, proposed fodder and camel support, and cited false disaster claims.

sentences.zh: 諭綏遠城將軍豐紳等按照原奏斟酌妥辦。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Suiyuancheng General Fengshen and others to handle the matter properly according to the original memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Fengshen, Suiyuancheng general, was told to handle it properly per the original memorial.

sentences.zh: 三月，察哈爾都統吉和等奏穆霍爾、噶順等九台之官兵潛逃，詔喜昌等飭各旗竭力供差，不准推卸，仍嚴禁兵丁騷擾台站。

translations.literal: In the third month, Chahar Commander Jihe and others memorialized that soldiers at nine stations including Mukhor and Gasun had deserted secretly; an edict ordered Xichang and others to require every banner to fulfill relay duties without evasion and strictly forbid soldiers harassing stations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Chahar Commander Jihe reported desertions from nine stations including Mukhor and Gasun; Xichang was ordered to make banners fulfill relay duty and forbid harassment of stations.

sentences.zh: 八月，察哈爾都統吉和等奏撫恤災荒，安設台站。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Chahar Commander Jihe and others memorialized on relief for famine and establishing relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Jihe reported on famine relief and relay-station arrangements.

sentences.zh: 喜昌又劾車林多爾濟權勢太重，把持公事，串通各旗虛報災荒，遣撤官兵需用駝只，復為掣肘，各旗派撥幫台，延不到差。

translations.literal: Xichang again impeached Chörindorji for excessive power, monopolizing official business, colluding with banners to report false disasters, obstructing the dispatch and withdrawal of soldiers and camels needed, and delaying relay assignments from assigned banners.
translations.idiomatic: Xichang again impeached Chörindorji for abusing power, rigging false disaster reports, blocking troop and camel movements, and delaying relay assignments.

sentences.zh: 諭新任辦事大臣桂祥密查具覆。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the newly appointed commissioner Guixiang to investigate secretly and report.
translations.idiomatic: New commissioner Guixiang was ordered to investigate secretly and report.

sentences.zh: 時俄勢日盛，諸部王公漸生攜貳。

translations.literal: At that time Russian power grew daily and princes of the various divisions gradually became disloyal.
translations.idiomatic: Russian power was rising and banner princes were growing disloyal.

sentences.zh: 喜昌所議置官、駐軍、屯田、改台諸大端，皆以消患未萌。

translations.literal: The major measures Xichang proposed—establishing officials, garrisoning troops, colonizing land, and reforming relay stations—were all aimed at eliminating trouble before it arose.
translations.idiomatic: Xichang's proposals—officials, garrisons, colonization, relay reform—aimed to prevent trouble before it arose.

sentences.zh: 中朝重更張，致所請無一行者，卒以病去，並撤其軍。

translations.literal: The court emphasized change and innovation, yet none of his requests was implemented; he finally left on grounds of illness, and his army was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The court favored reform in principle, yet none of his proposals was adopted; he eventually left ill and his troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 辛亥之變，實釀於此，識者惜之。

translations.literal: The Xinhai upheaval was in fact brewed from this; the discerning regretted it.
translations.idiomatic: The 1911 revolution had its roots here, observers later lamented.

sentences.zh: 九月，喜昌奏飭圖什業圖汗部未被災各旗暫行幫台。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Xichang memorialized ordering banners of the Tüshiyetu Khan division not affected by disaster temporarily to assist relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Xichang ordered undamaged Tüshiyetu Khan banners to assist relay stations temporarily.

sentences.zh: 尋庫倫辦事大臣那木濟勒端多布免，以土謝圖汗那遜綽克圖代之。

translations.literal: Soon Khüree Commissioner Namjildondob was dismissed; Tüshiyetu Khan Nasan Choktu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Commissioner Namjildondob was dismissed and Tüshiyetu Khan Nasan Choktu replaced him.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，以土謝圖汗部左翼中郡王阿木噶巴扎爾等四旗被災特重，諭桂祥等妥籌減緩差徭，予勸捐賑災之哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖扁額。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year, because four banners including Left-Wing Middle Jasagh King Amagabazar of the Tüshiyetu Khan division suffered exceptionally heavy disaster, Guixiang and others were instructed to arrange reduced and deferred corvée; a plaque was granted to Jebzundamba Khutukhtu for encouraging disaster relief donations.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Guangxu 10 (1884), four banners including Jasagh King Amagabazar's were hit hard; Guixiang was told to reduce corvée and Jebzundamba Khutukhtu received a plaque for relief donations.

sentences.zh: 十二年，桂祥劾哲布尊丹巴之商卓特巴索訥木多爾濟居心巧詐，意構邊釁，革之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Guixiang impeached Jebzundamba's shang zhuoteba Sonamdorji for crafty deceit and intent to provoke border trouble; he was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 12 (1886), Guixiang impeached Jebzundamba's shang zhuoteba Sonamdorji for scheming to provoke border trouble; he was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 十六年八月，庫倫辦事大臣安德等奏庫倫所屬恰克圖等處開辦金礦，華商既無可招，洋商則斷不可招集，陳窒礙難行情形，下所司知之。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the sixteenth year, Khüree Commissioner An De and others memorialized on opening gold mines at Kyakhta and elsewhere under Khüree: Chinese merchants could not be recruited, and foreign merchants must absolutely not be recruited; they stated obstructive difficulties, and the matter was referred to the relevant offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Guangxu 16 (1890), Commissioner An De reported that Kyakhta gold mines could not attract Chinese merchants and foreign merchants must not be recruited; ministries were notified of the difficulties.

sentences.zh: 十二月，御史聯奏庫倫商卓特巴喇嘛達什多爾濟欺朦把持，擅權科斂，下理籓院。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Censor Lian memorialized that Khüree shang zhuoteba Lama Dashdorji deceived and monopolized affairs, arrogating power to levy exactions; the matter was referred to the Lifan Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Censor Lian reported Khüree shang zhuoteba Lama Dashdorji for deception, monopoly, and unauthorized levies; the Lifan Yuan took the case.

sentences.zh: 十八年七月，定聯接中俄陸路電線。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the eighteenth year, the Sino-Russian overland telegraph connection was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Guangxu 18 (1892), the Sino-Russian overland telegraph link was established.

sentences.zh: 哲布尊丹巴所住之廟被火，佛像經卷胥毀。

translations.literal: The temple where Jebzundamba resided caught fire; Buddha images and sutras were all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Jebzundamba's residence temple burned; images and sutras were destroyed.

sentences.zh: 土盟等四盟王公捐助重建，而商卓特巴以此假貸商人，攤派沙畢者遂重。

translations.literal: Princes of the Tümen league and the other four leagues donated for reconstruction, but the shang zhuoteba used this to borrow from merchants, and assessments on shabi became heavier.
translations.idiomatic: Princes of the four Khalkha leagues donated for rebuilding, but the shang zhuoteba borrowed from merchants and shabi assessments grew heavier.

sentences.zh: 二十年九月，安德奏日本變動，民情惶惑，請仍調官兵駐庫倫，諭李鴻章酌度。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twentieth year, An De memorialized that Japan's upheaval had unsettled the populace; he requested troops be posted again at Khüree; Li Hongzhang was instructed to weigh the matter.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Guangxu 20 (1894), An De cited Japan's crisis and public alarm, asked for troops at Khüree again, and Li Hongzhang was told to decide.

sentences.zh: 二十二年六月，庫倫辦事大臣桂斌奏：「哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖屬沙畢一項困苦特甚，流亡過多。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-second year, Khüree Commissioner Guibin memorialized: "Among Jebzundamba Khutukhtu's shabi, hardship is exceptionally severe and exiles are too numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Guangxu 22 (1896), Commissioner Guibin reported: "Jebzundamba Khutukhtu's shabi are in severe distress, with too many refugees.

sentences.zh: 呼圖克圖忠厚存心，用人失當，一任喇嘛等勾通內地商民以及在官人等百方詐取，若罔聞知。

translations.literal: The Khutukhtu is sincere at heart but chooses subordinates poorly, allowing lamas to collude with inland merchants and officials in every sort of fraud as if unaware.
translations.idiomatic: The Khutukhtu is well-intentioned but chooses staff poorly, letting lamas collude with inland merchants and officials in fraud as if unaware.

sentences.zh: 迨用度過窘，不得不加倍苛派，所由欠負累累，上下交困。

translations.literal: When expenses grew tight, doubly harsh levies became unavoidable, hence mounting debts and distress above and below.
translations.idiomatic: When expenses tightened, doubly harsh levies became unavoidable, leaving heavy debts and distress throughout.

sentences.zh: 體訪其屬堪布喇嘛諾們汗巴勒党吹木巴勒為僧俗所仰慕，應責成清理已檄署商卓特巴巴特多爾濟等，凡一切商上應辦事宜，悉心諮商，妥為籌畫。

translations.literal: On inquiry, his subordinate khenpo lama Nomun Khan Baledun Chimbale is admired by clergy and laity; he should be charged with cleanup; acting shang zhuoteba Batdorji and others have been instructed that all commercial affairs should be carefully consulted and properly planned.
translations.idiomatic: Inquiry showed khenpo lama Nomun Khan Baledun Chimbale is respected by clergy and laity; he should oversee cleanup; acting shang zhuoteba Batdorji was told to consult on all commercial affairs.

sentences.zh: 先將沙畢等應派光緒二十二年分攤款，查照十年以前，各按牲畜多寡，秉公勻攤，不准加派，核實酌裁。

translations.literal: First, shabi assessments for Guangxu 22 should follow the practice before the tenth year, apportioned fairly by livestock holdings without extra levies, verified and trimmed as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: First, shabi assessments for Guangxu 22 should follow pre-Guangxu 10 practice, apportioned fairly by livestock without extra levies and trimmed after verification.

sentences.zh: 近年增添浮費，務量所攤撙節動用，俾紓民力。

translations.literal: Recent added expenses must be spent within what is apportioned through economy, to relieve the people's burden.
translations.idiomatic: Recent added expenses must stay within apportioned amounts through economy to relieve the people's burden.

sentences.zh: 並請將東營台市甲首各商，每遇兩大臣節壽酬款項不減不增，按年代哲布尊丹巴歸商欠。」

translations.literal: It is also requested that head merchants of the East Camp market, whenever the two commissioners' birthday gifts are paid, keep amounts unchanged and apply them year by year to Jebzundamba's debts to merchants."
translations.idiomatic: Head merchants at the East Camp market should keep commissioners' birthday gifts unchanged and apply them yearly to Jebzundamba's merchant debts."

sentences.zh: 下所司知之。

translations.literal: The relevant offices were informed.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries were notified.

sentences.zh: 尋又奏定恰克圖規費，化私為公，提滿、蒙大臣經費。

translations.literal: Soon a memorial also fixed Kyakhta customary fees, converting private payments to public ones and allocating funds for Manchu and Mongol commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Kyakhta customary fees were fixed, converting private payments to public funds for Manchu and Mongol commissioners.

sentences.zh: 七月，奏請定庫倫大臣與哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖往還體制是否平行，有曰：「公事之間，備極融洽；

translations.literal: In the seventh month, a memorial requested fixing whether the protocol between the Khüree commissioner and Jebzundamba Khutukhtu should be equal; it stated: "In official business they are extremely harmonious;
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, a memorial asked whether the Khüree commissioner and Jebzundamba Khutukhtu should meet as equals; it noted: "In official business they are harmonious;

sentences.zh: 相見之際，多似參商。

translations.literal: at meetings they often seem to consult as equals.
translations.idiomatic: at meetings they often seem to consult as equals.

sentences.zh: 實則哲布尊丹巴已驕蹇跋扈，與辦事大臣積不相能。」

translations.literal: In fact Jebzundamba had grown arrogant and overbearing and was long incompatible with the commissioner."
translations.idiomatic: In fact Jebzundamba had grown arrogant and was long at odds with the commissioner."

sentences.zh: 十一月，桂斌奏：「土盟所屬西北旗界哈喇河一帶，向有開墾地畝，播種雜糧，曾經奏明不准續墾。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Guibin memorialized: "In the northwest banner borders of the Tümen league along the Hara River, there has long been reclaimed land planted with miscellaneous grains; it was previously memorialized that further reclamation was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Guibin reported: "Along the Hara River in northwest Tümen league banners, reclaimed land planted with grain had been forbidden from further expansion.

sentences.zh: 每屆台市章京更換實任，由庫倫大臣紮委會同扎薩克等前往清查有無續墾。

translations.literal: Whenever the market zhangjing was replaced in actual appointment, the Khüree commissioner dispatched someone jointly with jasaghs to inspect for further reclamation.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the market zhangjing changed, the Khüree commissioner sent someone with jasaghs to inspect for illegal reclamation.

sentences.zh: 茲屆應查之期，照章派委台市章京理籓院員外郎奎顯往查，將所得陋規呈請核辦，約計二千數百兩。

translations.literal: Now at the scheduled inspection period, Market Zhanjing Lifan Yuan Vice Director Kuixian was dispatched per regulations; illicit fees collected were submitted for approval, totaling about 2,000-odd taels.
translations.idiomatic: At the scheduled inspection, Market Zhanjing Kuixian of the Lifan Yuan was dispatched; illicit fees totaling about 2,000 taels were submitted for approval.

sentences.zh: 當將兩大臣此次款費全發商人收還，其餘各項，暫照成案分賚各員，俾資津貼。」

translations.literal: The two commissioners' fees this time should all be paid to merchants for recovery; other items should temporarily follow precedent in distribution to various officers as subsidies."
translations.idiomatic: The two commissioners' fees should go to merchants for debt recovery; other items should follow precedent as officer subsidies."

sentences.zh: 二十三年六月，辦事大臣連順奏哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖與蒙古辦事大臣圖什業圖汗那遜綽克圖兩不相能，請革辦事大臣之任，諭從之，並飭嗣後遇有此等事件，務妥為斟酌，勿聽呼圖克圖一面之詞。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-third year, Commissioner Lianshun memorialized that Jebzundamba Khutukhtu and Mongol Commissioner Tüshiyetu Khan Nasan Choktu were incompatible; he requested dismissal of the commissioner's post; the edict approved, and ordered that hereafter in such cases careful judgment be exercised and the Khutukhtu's one-sided words not be heeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Guangxu 23 (1897), Lianshun reported Jebzundamba and Commissioner Nasan Choktu were at odds and asked to dismiss the commissioner; the court agreed and warned against heeding the Khutukhtu alone in future.

sentences.zh: 以土盟中旗貝子朋楚克車林為庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: Beile Penchik Chörin of the Tümen league middle banner was appointed Khüree commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Beile Penchik Chörin of the Tümen middle banner became Khüree commissioner.

sentences.zh: 連順以：「桂斌所奏歸還哲布尊丹巴商欠辦法，四成實銀，分年帶銷，雖恤蒙情，未恤商情，致該商等虧累太多，不敢與沙畢內外兩倉及鄂拓克交易。

translations.literal: Lianshun stated: "Guibin's plan for repaying Jebzundamba's merchant debts—forty percent in cash, amortized over years—though considerate of Mongol sentiment, was not considerate of merchants; the merchants suffered too much loss and dared not trade with the shabi inner and outer warehouses and otok.
translations.idiomatic: Lianshun argued: "Guibin's debt-repayment plan—forty percent cash, amortized over years—helped Mongols but not merchants, who lost too much and stopped trading with shabi warehouses and otok.

sentences.zh: 而兩倉鄂拓克雖有牲畜，無處易換，市井蕭條，諸貨不能暢銷。

translations.literal: The two warehouses' otok had livestock but nowhere to exchange them; markets were depressed and goods could not sell freely.
translations.idiomatic: Warehouse otok had livestock but no market; trade languished and goods would not move.

sentences.zh: 現呼圖克圖之廟工久竣，應照桂斌所奏，不得苛派，休息蒙眾。

translations.literal: Now the Khutukhtu's temple work is long finished; per Guibin's memorial, harsh levies should cease and Mongols be given rest.
translations.idiomatic: The Khutukhtu's temple work is long done; per Guibin's plan, harsh levies should stop and Mongols be given rest.

sentences.zh: 兩倉所用貨物銀茶及鄂拓克息借之款，應循舊日章程，設法算撥。」

translations.literal: Goods, silver, tea used by the two warehouses and otok loan interest should follow old regulations and be calculated and allocated by appropriate means."
translations.idiomatic: Goods, silver, tea, and otok loan interest should follow old rules and be settled properly."

sentences.zh: 又奏：「據土盟盟長密什克多爾濟轉據各旗呈報，現查各旗呈報，並無未領限票民人種地之事。

translations.literal: He also memorialized: "According to Tümen league chief Mishig Dorji relaying reports from banners, current inspection shows no cases of civilians farming without limit passes.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported: "Per Tümen league chief Mishig Dorji, banners report no civilians farming without limit passes.

sentences.zh: 其由庫倫台市章京衙門請領限票來旗貿易者，均隨來隨往，或搭蓋土房存貨收賬，牛羊並不孳生。

translations.literal: Those obtaining limit passes from the Khüree market zhangjing office to trade in banners all come and go promptly, or build earthen houses to store goods and collect accounts; cattle and sheep do not breed there.
translations.idiomatic: Merchants with limit passes from Khüree come and go promptly, or build storehouses; livestock do not breed there.

sentences.zh: 墾荒民人建房養畜，每年交地租茶數十箱或百箱不等。

translations.literal: Reclaiming civilians who build houses and raise livestock pay land-rent tea of several dozen to a hundred boxes annually.
translations.idiomatic: Reclaiming settlers who build and raise livestock pay dozens to a hundred boxes of tea as land rent yearly.

sentences.zh: 復據商民元順明等七家呈，認種荒地，每年有地租茶，牲畜存廠，每年有草廠茶。

translations.literal: Further, seven merchant households including Yuanshunming petitioned claiming reclaimed wasteland, paying annual land-rent tea; livestock kept at depots pay annual pasture-depot tea.
translations.idiomatic: Seven merchants including Yuanshunming petitioned for reclaimed land, paying annual land-rent and pasture-depot tea.

sentences.zh: 請將認交前大臣桂斌罰款原茶交還。」

translations.literal: They requested return of the original tea paid as fines to former commissioner Guibin."
translations.idiomatic: They asked return of tea paid as fines to former commissioner Guibin."

sentences.zh: 旨均如所請。

translations.literal: The edict approved all requests.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved all requests.

sentences.zh: 並將查地陋規化私為公，裁台市章京查地之差。

translations.literal: Illicit land-inspection fees were also converted from private to public use, and the market zhangjing's land-inspection assignment was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Land-inspection illicit fees were made public and the market zhangjing's inspection duty was abolished.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，勸辦昭信股票。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, Zhaoxin stock subscriptions were promoted.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24 (1898), Zhaoxin stock subscriptions were promoted.

sentences.zh: 連順奏圖什業圖汗、車臣汗兩步落王公及哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖等，情原報效市平銀共二十萬兩。

translations.literal: Lianshun memorialized that princes of the Tüshiyetu Khan and Sechen Khan divisions and Jebzundamba Khutukhtu and others willingly offered a total of 200,000 taels of market-standard silver.
translations.idiomatic: Lianshun reported Tüshiyetu Khan, Sechen Khan, and Jebzundamba princes willing to contribute 200,000 taels of market silver.

sentences.zh: 五月，土、車兩盟王公及哲布尊丹巴沙畢、喇嘛等陳請不原領昭信股票，溫諭嘉之，仍飭一併給獎。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, princes of the two leagues and Jebzundamba's shabi and lamas petitioned not to accept Zhaoxin stock; warm edicts praised them, yet ordered rewards be given all the same.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, league princes and Jebzundamba's shabi and lamas declined Zhaoxin stock; warm edicts praised them but ordered rewards anyway.

sentences.zh: 以設庫倫、恰克圖電線，理籓院奏採伐土盟各旗官山木植。

translations.literal: For the Khüree-Kyakhta telegraph line, the Lifan Yuan memorialized on harvesting timber from official mountains in Tümen league banners.
translations.idiomatic: For the Khüree-Kyakhta telegraph, the Lifan Yuan reported harvesting timber from Tümen league official mountains.

sentences.zh: 先是，庫倫西北各旗至恰克圖一帶內地人民，率以租地墾荒為名，偷挖金砂，俄人亦多越界潛采，查禁驅逐，具文而已。

translations.literal: Previously, inland people from northwest banners to Kyakhta, mostly under the pretext of renting land for reclamation, secretly panned gold; Russians also often crossed the border to mine secretly; prohibition and expulsion were only on paper.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, inland settlers from northwest banners to Kyakhta panned gold under the guise of land reclamation; Russians also mined secretly across the border; bans were paper only.

sentences.zh: 至是連順奏：「土、車兩盟各旗界內庫倫東北六臺地，約合三百四十餘里，西自鄂爾河、哈拉河至額能河，共有金礦三處。

translations.literal: At this point Lianshun memorialized: "Within banners of the two leagues, in the six-station area northeast of Khüree, about 340-odd li, west from the Or River and Hara River to the Eneng River, there are three gold mines.
translations.idiomatic: Lianshun then reported: "In the two leagues northeast of Khüree, about 340 li from the Or and Hara rivers to the Eneng River, there are three gold mines.

sentences.zh: 又西北九臺地，約合五百三十餘里，北自色埒河至伊魯河，共有金礦二處，周圍二百餘里，金苗甚旺，以伊魯河所產為最佳。

translations.literal: Also in the nine-station northwest area, about 530-odd li, north from the Sele River to the Yilu River, there are two gold mines, about 200-odd li in circumference, with very rich deposits; the Yilu River output is finest.
translations.idiomatic: In the northwest nine-station area, about 530 li from the Sele to the Yilu River, two mines span 200 li with rich deposits; Yilu River gold is finest.

sentences.zh: 惟產自河內，水勢頗深，人力掏取，所得有限。

translations.literal: However, because it comes from within rivers where water is quite deep, manual panning yields limited returns.
translations.idiomatic: Because it comes from deep riverbeds, manual panning yields little.

sentences.zh: 必用西法以機器汲水，雇工開挖，其利方厚。

translations.literal: Western methods with machinery to pump water and hired labor for excavation are needed for substantial profit.
translations.idiomatic: Western machinery to pump water and hired labor are needed for real profit.

sentences.zh: 擬招集钜款，延聘礦師，購運機器，相地開採。

translations.literal: It is proposed to raise large capital, hire mining engineers, purchase and transport machinery, and open mines at suitable sites.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed raising capital, hiring engineers, importing machinery, and opening mines at suitable sites.

sentences.zh: 宜同時舉辦，於居中扼要之處，設一總廠。

translations.literal: Operations should begin simultaneously, with a central headquarters at a strategic midpoint.
translations.idiomatic: Operations should begin together with a central headquarters at a strategic midpoint.

sentences.zh: 綜計成本約需銀三百萬兩。」

translations.literal: Total cost is estimated at about 3,000,000 taels of silver."
translations.idiomatic: Total cost was estimated at about three million taels."

sentences.zh: 復據天津稅務司俄人柯樂德利庫西稱蒙古金礦，中國集款興辦時，俄人亦原附股，仍可代為招集，嚴遵中國章程。

translations.literal: Further, according to Russian Koledeleikusi of the Tianjin Customs Service, regarding Mongol gold mines, when China raises capital to operate them, Russians are also willing to buy shares and can still recruit on China's behalf, strictly following Chinese regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Russian customs officer Koledeleikusi said Russians would buy shares when China opened Mongol mines and could recruit investors under Chinese rules.

sentences.zh: 如用俄人，應聽中國官員約束，通盤籌畫。

translations.literal: If Russians are employed, they should obey Chinese officials and follow overall planning.
translations.idiomatic: Any Russians employed must obey Chinese officials and follow overall planning.

sentences.zh: 鄂爾河等五處金礦，擬請招商集款，合力開採，由中國自行舉辦，並准附招俄股，請簡派大員專司督率。

translations.literal: The five gold mines including the Or River are proposed for merchant investment and joint operation, run by China itself, with Russian shares permitted; a high official is requested to supervise exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: The five mines including the Or River should be opened by Chinese merchant investment, with Russian shares permitted, under a specially appointed supervisor.

sentences.zh: 下總理各國事務衙門會同礦務大臣議行。

translations.literal: The matter was referred to the Zongli Yamen jointly with the mining minister for deliberation and implementation.
translations.idiomatic: Referred to the Zongli Yamen and the mining minister for deliberation.

sentences.zh: 尋命連順督辦蒙古鄂爾河等礦。

translations.literal: Soon Lianshun was ordered to supervise Mongol mines including the Or River.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Lianshun was ordered to supervise the Or River and other Mongol mines.

sentences.zh: 是年，李鴻章等奏中俄會訂條約。

translations.literal: That year, Li Hongzhang and others memorialized on the Sino-Russian treaty concluded jointly.
translations.idiomatic: That year Li Hongzhang reported on the newly concluded Sino-Russian treaty.

sentences.zh: 俄國准在中國蒙古地方貿易，其蒙古各處及各盟設官與未設官之處，均准貿易，照舊不納稅。

translations.literal: Russia was permitted to trade in Chinese Mongol territory; all Mongol places and leagues, whether administered or not, were open to trade, tax-free as before.
translations.idiomatic: Russia was permitted to trade throughout Chinese Mongolia, administered or not, tax-free as before.

sentences.zh: 其買賣貨物，或用現錢，或以貨易貨均可。

translations.literal: Goods might be bought and sold for cash or bartered as before.
translations.idiomatic: Goods could be bought for cash or bartered as before.

sentences.zh: 並准俄民以各種貨物抵賬。

translations.literal: Russians were also permitted to settle accounts with various goods.
translations.idiomatic: Russians were also permitted to settle debts with goods.

sentences.zh: 在庫倫設領事，科布多、烏里雅蘇臺俟商務興旺添設。

translations.literal: A consul was established at Khüree; Kobdo and Urga would add consulates when trade flourished.
translations.idiomatic: A consul was posted at Khüree; Kobdo and Urga would add consulates when trade grew.

sentences.zh: 二十五年十月，奏集股開採，以土、車兩盟同時共舉為宜，即集土、車兩盟長切實勸諭，俾知開礦之舉，不特保衛邊疆，且開蒙古生計，報聞。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the twenty-fifth year, a memorial proposed joint-stock mining; simultaneous action by both leagues was deemed best; league chiefs were earnestly urged to understand that mining would not only defend the frontier but open livelihoods for Mongols; report acknowledged.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Guangxu 25, a memorial proposed joint-stock mining by both leagues; chiefs were urged to see mining as frontier defense and a livelihood for Mongols.

sentences.zh: 土盟盟長密什克多爾濟以連順等劾阻撓開礦，罷之。

translations.literal: Tümen league chief Mishig Dorji was dismissed on Lianshun's impeachment for obstructing mining.
translations.idiomatic: Tümen league chief Mishig Dorji was dismissed for obstructing mining, per Lianshun's impeachment.

sentences.zh: 十一月，洛布桑達什面謾哲布尊丹巴，以玩褻黃教議處。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Lobsang Dash was punished for insulting Jebzundamba to his face, on grounds of profaning the Yellow Sect.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Lobsang Dash was punished for insulting Jebzundamba to his face, profaning the Yellow Sect.

sentences.zh: 理籓院奏蒙古王公等請停辦礦務，命昆岡、裕德往查辦，並諭連順緩辦庫倫礦務。

translations.literal: The Lifan Yuan memorialized that Mongol princes requested suspension of mining; Kungang and Yude were ordered to investigate, and Lianshun was told to defer Khüree mining.
translations.idiomatic: The Lifan Yuan reported Mongol princes asking to stop mining; Kungang and Yude were sent to investigate and Lianshun told to defer Khüree mining.

sentences.zh: 十二月，庫倫、恰克圖電線工竣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, the Khüree-Kyakhta telegraph line was completed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, the Khüree-Kyakhta telegraph line was completed.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，昆岡等奏停辦礦務，連順下部議處。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Kungang and others memorialized to stop mining; Lianshun was referred to the ministry for discipline.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26, Kungang reported mining halted; Lianshun was referred for discipline.

sentences.zh: 拳匪事起，命辦事大臣豐升阿等備邊。

translations.literal: When the Boxer affair arose, Commissioner Fengsheng'a and others were ordered to prepare border defense.
translations.idiomatic: When the Boxer crisis broke out, Commissioner Fengsheng'a and others were ordered to prepare the border.

sentences.zh: 二十七年三月，豐升阿、朋楚克車林奏圖什業圖汗部落盟長貝子棟多布等呈，駕幸西安，請捐本年應得俸銀緞疋，並量力捐馬備用，哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖等亦呈捐馬千匹，均允納之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-seventh year, Fengsheng'a and Penchik Chörin memorialized that Tüshiyetu Khan division league chief Beile Dongdob and others petitioned: with the court at Xi'an, they offered this year's salary silk and silver and horses as able; Jebzundamba Khutukhtu and others also offered a thousand horses; all were accepted.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Guangxu 27, Fengsheng'a and Penchik Chörin reported Beile Dongdob and others offering salary and horses while the court was at Xi'an; Jebzundamba offered a thousand horses; all were accepted.

sentences.zh: 六月，豐升阿等奏：「上年內地拳匪肇禍，猝啟兵端，庫倫、恰克圖等處中外各商，紛紛遷徙，互相疑懼。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Fengsheng'a and others memorialized: "Last year inland Boxers caused trouble and war broke out suddenly; Chinese and foreign merchants at Khüree, Kyakhta, and elsewhere moved away in numbers, mutual suspicion and fear.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Fengsheng'a reported: "Last year's Boxer crisis sparked war; merchants at Khüree and Kyakhta fled in fear.

sentences.zh: 當與駐庫俄領事官施什瑪勒福等再三晤商，均能奉約惟謹，力顧邦交。

translations.literal: We met repeatedly with Russian consul Shishmalev stationed at Khüree; all strictly kept treaties and worked to preserve relations.
translations.idiomatic: We met repeatedly with Russian consul Shishmalev at Khüree; all kept treaties and preserved relations.

sentences.zh: 彼時雖有俄兵防守，尤能實力保護中外商民、蒙眾等性命貲財，兩不相擾，請予寶星。」

translations.literal: Though Russian troops were then on guard, they especially protected Chinese and foreign merchants and Mongols in life and property without mutual disturbance; we request the Order of the Double Dragon."
translations.idiomatic: Though Russian troops guarded the city, they protected merchants and Mongols without disturbance; we request the Order of the Double Dragon."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 二十九年二月，以防守邊疆異常出力，予土盟盟長扎薩克敦都布多爾濟雙眼花翎，土盟參贊郡王阿囊達瓦齊爾紫韁，土盟副盟長扎薩克鎮國公察克都爾紮布、土盟副將軍親王杭達多爾濟、總管西卡倫額魯特扎薩克貝子達克丹多爾濟乾清門行走，餘給獎有差。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-ninth year, for exceptional border defense, Tümen league chief Jasagh Dundobdorji received double-peacock plumes; Tümen assistant Jasagh King Anang Dawachir received the purple bridle; Tümen deputy chief Jasagh State Guardian Duke Chakdürjab, Tümen deputy general Prince Hangdadorji, and Oirat Jasagh Beile Dakdan Dorji, warden of the western pickets, received Qianqing Gate access; others received graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangxu 29, for border defense, Jasagh Dundobdorji received double-peacock plumes, Jasagh King Anang Dawachir the purple bridle, and others graded rewards including Qianqing Gate access for Dakdan Dorji.

sentences.zh: 閏五月，土盟王公及哲布尊丹巴等報效修正陽門工程銀，允核給獎敘。

translations.literal: In the intercalary fifth month, Tümen princes and Jebzundamba and others contributed silver for Zhengyang Gate repairs; approval for rewards was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary fifth month, Tümen princes and Jebzundamba contributed silver for Zhengyang Gate repairs; rewards were approved.

sentences.zh: 豐升阿等奏覆改設行省，以外蒙地方與內地邊疆情形不同，一例辦理，多有窒礙。

translations.literal: Fengsheng'a and others replied on establishing provinces: Outer Mongolia differed from inland frontiers; uniform treatment would face many obstacles.
translations.idiomatic: Fengsheng'a replied that Outer Mongolia differed from inland frontiers and uniform provincial rule would face many obstacles.

sentences.zh: 得旨：「是。」

translations.literal: Edict received: "So be it."
translations.idiomatic: Edict: "So be it."

sentences.zh: 下所司知之。

translations.literal: The relevant offices were informed.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries were notified.

sentences.zh: 九月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍連順等奏土、車二盟金礦續議開辦，參酌外蒙等情形，詳訂章程，妥籌佈置。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Urga General Lianshun and others memorialized on reopening gold mines in the two leagues, weighing Outer Mongol conditions, drafting detailed regulations, and proper arrangements.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Urga General Lianshun reported reopening gold mines in both leagues with detailed regulations suited to Outer Mongolia.

sentences.zh: 請准派稅務司洋員柯樂德為總辦，並簡派大員專司督率，下部議。

translations.literal: Approval was requested to appoint customs foreign officer Kolede as general manager and select a high official to supervise exclusively; referred to the ministry.
translations.idiomatic: They asked to appoint customs officer Kolede as general manager with a senior supervisor; referred to the ministry.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以蒙古辦事大臣朋楚克車林自庚子以來，慎固邊圉，輯睦外人，恤商撫蒙，勤勞足錄，予紫韁。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, because Mongol Commissioner Penchik Chörin since Gengzi had carefully secured the border, kept peace with foreigners, cared for merchants and Mongols, and merited record of diligence, the purple bridle was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Commissioner Penchik Chörin received the purple bridle for securing the border, keeping peace with foreigners, and caring for merchants and Mongols since 1900.

sentences.zh: 三十年，辦事大臣德麟奏庫倫後地蒙民租佃，擬設清墾局，以杜與外人私墾，下戶部議。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, Commissioner Delin memorialized on Mongol tenant farming in rear Khüree lands; a land-clearance bureau was proposed to stop private reclamation with foreigners; referred to the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 30, Commissioner Delin proposed a land-clearance bureau for rear Khüree tenant farming to stop private reclamation with foreigners; referred to the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 三月，德麟等奏辦庫倫統捐。

translations.literal: In the third month, Delin and others memorialized on organizing Khüree unified donations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Delin reported on organizing Khüree unified donations.

sentences.zh: 達賴喇嘛以印藏啟釁，避之庫倫，詔延祉迎，令赴西寧。

translations.literal: The Dalai Lama, with trouble arising in Tibet, took refuge at Khüree; an edict ordered Yanzhi to receive him and send him to Xining.
translations.idiomatic: The Dalai Lama fled to Khüree when Tibet erupted; Yanzhi was ordered to receive him and send him to Xining.

sentences.zh: 九月，予駐庫倫直隸練軍官弁獎，以保衛蒙商，防護外人。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, officers of the Zhili drill army garrisoned at Khüree were rewarded for protecting Mongol merchants and safeguarding foreigners.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Zhili drill army officers at Khüree were rewarded for protecting Mongol merchants and foreigners.

sentences.zh: 十月，德麟奏結圖盟左翼中旗扎薩克郡王阿囊塔瓦齊爾債案。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Delin memorialized on closing the debt case of Tümen league left-wing middle-banner Jasagh King Anang Tawachir.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Delin closed the debt case of Jasagh King Anang Tawachir of the Tümen left-wing middle banner.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，辦事大臣朴壽奏創辦釐金，委差官賈得勝等分往頭台暨恰克圖等處帶兵稽查偷漏，分段彈壓。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Commissioner Pushou memorialized on establishing transit duties; deputy Jia Desheng and others were dispatched to the first station and Kyakhta with troops to inspect evasion, enforcing by sections.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31, Commissioner Pushou established transit duties; Jia Desheng and others were sent to the first station and Kyakhta with troops to stop evasion.

sentences.zh: 七月，以理籓院奏，予哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖女徒寮汗達拉額爾德尼車臣名號。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on the Lifan Yuan memorial, Jebzundamba Khutukhtu's disciple Lama Handala was granted the title Erdeni Sechen.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Jebzundamba's disciple Lama Handala received the title Erdeni Sechen, per the Lifan Yuan.

sentences.zh: 十二月，設庫倫巡警兵丁，由蒙人揀選。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Khüree patrol soldiers were established, selected from Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Khüree patrol troops were established, selected from Mongols.

sentences.zh: 三十二年六月，以土盟王公等承購練兵戰馬，依限選齊，予盟長公銜扎薩克一等台吉敦都布多爾濟等獎有差。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirty-second year, because Tümen princes purchased drill cavalry horses and delivered them on schedule, Jasagh First-Class Taiji Dundobdorji, league chief with gong rank, and others received graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Guangxu 32, Tümen princes who delivered drill horses on time were rewarded, including Jasagh First-Class Taiji Dundobdorji.

sentences.zh: 三十三年四月，允開庫倫金礦，定許可權章程。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the thirty-third year, Khüree gold mines were approved for opening; licensing regulations were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Guangxu 33, Khüree gold mines were approved with licensing regulations.

sentences.zh: 以庫倫蒙古辦事大臣朋楚克車林會同延祉督辦礦務。

translations.literal: Khüree Mongol Commissioner Penchik Chörin together with Yanzhi was to supervise mining.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Penchik Chörin and Yanzhi were to supervise mining at Khüree.

sentences.zh: 三十四年二月，辦事大臣延祉以派員勘丈各旗墾地，親王杭達多爾濟旗台吉巴圖巴魯抗不備台，請嚴加議處，允之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the thirty-fourth year, Commissioner Yanzhi, dispatching staff to survey reclaimed land in banners, reported that Prince Hangdadorji's banner taiji Batubalu resisted and failed to supply relay service; severe discipline was requested and granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Guangxu 34, Yanzhi reported taiji Batubalu of Prince Hangdadorji's banner resisted land surveys and failed relay duty; severe discipline was approved.

sentences.zh: 五月，增開依拉裕葛籣南之克勒司。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the Kles mine south of Irügegen was additionally opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the Kles mine south of Irügegen was additionally opened.

sentences.zh: 八月，試辦庫倫土藥統稅。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, unified taxation on Khüree native medicines was trial-implemented.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, unified taxation on Khüree native medicines was trial-implemented.

sentences.zh: 設蒙養學堂，就選土、車兩盟及沙畢幼童，專習滿、蒙、漢語言文字，以興辦新政，蒙古通曉漢文漢語少，易致隔閡。

translations.literal: A Mongol school was established, selecting children from the two leagues and shabi to study Manchu, Mongol, and Chinese languages and scripts for new policies; few Mongols knew Chinese, easily causing barriers.
translations.idiomatic: A Mongol school was set up for children from both leagues and shabi to study Manchu, Mongol, and Chinese for the new policies; few Mongols knew Chinese, causing barriers.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年閏二月，延祉等奏准設庫倫理刑司員。

translations.literal: In the intercalary second month of Xuantong 1, Yanzhi and others memorialized approval to establish Khüree judicial officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary second month of Xuantong 1, Yanzhi won approval to establish Khüree judicial officials.

sentences.zh: 時哲布尊丹巴呼圖克圖之商卓特巴巴特瑪多爾濟捐學堂經費八千兩，延祉為請賞帶膆貂褂。

translations.literal: At that time Jebzundamba's shang zhuoteba Batmadorji donated 8,000 taels for the school; Yanzhi requested the reward of a suri sable jacket.
translations.idiomatic: Jebzundamba's shang zhuoteba Batmadorji donated 8,000 taels for the school; Yanzhi requested a suri sable jacket as reward.

sentences.zh: 得旨，下理籓院核給獎敘。

translations.literal: Edict received; referred to the Lifan Yuan to approve rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Approved; referred to the Lifan Yuan for rewards.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以庫倫各廠所出金砂較往年暢旺，給監辦官等花紅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, because gold output from Khüree mines exceeded previous years, supervising officials received bonuses.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Khüree mine output exceeded previous years and supervising officials received bonuses.

sentences.zh: 二年五月，辦事大臣三多以土、車兩盟沙畢等三處屢報災祲，供億過繁，歷年息借華、俄債款，迭經報官索欠者，約計不下百餘萬兩，竟有估一旗之牲畜不足抵債者。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the second year, Commissioner Sanduo reported that the two leagues' shabi and three other groups repeatedly reported disasters, supplies were excessive, and over years Chinese and Russian loans with interest reported to officials totaled over a million taels; some banners' entire livestock could not cover debts.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of Xuantong 2, Commissioner Sanduo reported repeated disasters, excessive levies, and over a million taels in Chinese and Russian debts—some banners' livestock could not cover them.

sentences.zh: 而自供哲布尊丹巴外，光緒二十九年至宣統元年，庫倫大臣等修理衙署及器具鋪墊等項，已合銀十八萬餘兩，支應馬匹、食羊、柴炭等項尚不在內。

translations.literal: Apart from supplying Jebzundamba, from Guangxu 29 to Xuantong 1, Khüree commissioners' office repairs, furnishings, and bedding already totaled over 180,000 taels; horses, food sheep, and fuel were not included.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from Jebzundamba's supply, commissioners' office repairs from Guangxu 29 to Xuantong 1 already cost over 180,000 taels, excluding horses, sheep, and fuel.

sentences.zh: 因奏核定土、車兩盟沙畢供庫倫大小衙門柴炭、羊數目，及限制各官調任修署添物章程。

translations.literal: A memorial therefore fixed shabi fuel and sheep for Khüree offices and regulations limiting officials' repairs and additions on transfer.
translations.idiomatic: He fixed shabi fuel and sheep for Khüree offices and limited officials' repair spending on transfer.

sentences.zh: 其餘差使，統由各員自為籌備，並以物價昂貴，費用竭蹶，請加各員公費銀一萬二千兩。

translations.literal: Other assignments were to be self-funded; because prices were high and expenses exhausted, 12,000 taels public expense silver per officer was requested.
translations.idiomatic: Other assignments were self-funded; with prices high, he requested 12,000 taels public expense per officer.

sentences.zh: 先侭庫倫外銷公款項下開支，倘有不敷，由庫倫金礦稅款暫撥，仍言金礦逐年漸有起色，蒙困一蘇，商務亦可興旺，稅額自必加增，解部之款，不至較往年為絀，下度支部議行。

translations.literal: First from Khüree external-sale public funds; if insufficient, temporarily from gold-mine tax; it was still stated that as mines improved yearly, Mongol hardship would ease, trade flourish, and taxes increase without remittance falling below past years; referred to the Ministry of Finance.
translations.idiomatic: Funds would come first from Khüree public accounts, then gold-mine tax; as mines improved, Mongol hardship would ease and remittances would not fall; referred to the Ministry of Finance.

sentences.zh: 清中葉後，諸邊將軍、大臣以下俸給過薄，皆倚籓部供應為生計，三多此疏，可以例之。

translations.literal: After the mid-Qing, frontier generals and commissioners below had overly thin salaries and all relied on dependency supplies for livelihood; Sanduo's memorial may be taken as typical.
translations.idiomatic: After the mid-Qing, frontier officials' salaries were thin and they relied on banner supplies; Sanduo's memorial is typical.

sentences.zh: 十月，三多奏喇嘛登曾奪犯拒捕一案，商卓特巴巴特瑪多爾濟迄不交出首要，歷次呈文，無理取鬧，要脅具奏，恐國家法令，官長政權，將難行於蒙地，請予斥革；

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Sanduo memorialized on lama Dengzeng's case of seizing a prisoner and resisting arrest; shang zhuoteba Batmadorji still would not surrender the ringleader, repeatedly petitioned unreasonably and coerced memorials; fearing state law and official authority would be hard to enforce in Mongolia, dismissal was requested;
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Sanduo memorialized on the case of the lama Dengzeng seizing a prisoner and resisting arrest. Shangzhuoteba Batmadorji still refused to surrender the ringleader, repeatedly submitted unreasonable petitions, and tried to coerce memorials; fearing that state law and official authority would become difficult to enforce in Mongol territory, Sanduo requested his dismissal;

sentences.zh: 哲布尊丹巴自二月奉嚴加約束電旨後，庫屬喇嘛安分守法，為近年所未有，請傳旨嘉獎：均允之。

translations.literal: since Jebzundamba received the February telegram ordering strict restraint, Khüree lamas have kept peace as never in recent years; an edict of praise was requested: all approved.
translations.idiomatic: since Jebzundamba was strictly restrained by telegram in February, Khüree lamas had kept peace as never before; praise was requested: all approved.

sentences.zh: 二年四月，是部親王朋楚克車林為資政院欽選議員。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year, this division's Prince Penchik Chörin was an imperially selected member of the Advisory Council.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Xuantong 2, Prince Penchik Chörin of this division was an imperially selected Advisory Council member.

sentences.zh: 三年，設庫倫審判各廳。

translations.literal: In the third year, Khüree judicial offices were established.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3, Khüree judicial offices were established.

sentences.zh: 軍諮府亦於庫倫設陸軍兵備處，派員統兵駐之。

translations.literal: The Army Advisory Council also established an army provisioning office at Khüree, dispatching officers to command garrison troops.
translations.idiomatic: The Army Advisory Council also set up an army provisioning office at Khüree with garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 是年正月，三多奏宣統二年金礦應繳官稅計金砂易銀十九萬三千兩有奇，全數作為庫倫辦軍事的款。

translations.literal: In the first month of that year, Sanduo memorialized that Xuantong 2 gold-mine official tax converted to 193,000-odd taels silver, all allocated for Khüree military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month, Sanduo reported Xuantong 2 gold-mine tax of 193,000-odd taels, all for Khüree military expenses.

sentences.zh: 是月，開圖盟扎薩克那木薩賴旗奎騰河金礦。

translations.literal: That month, the Kuiteng River gold mine in Tümen league Jasagh Namsarai's banner was opened.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Kuiteng River gold mine in Jasagh Namsarai's banner was opened.

sentences.zh: 四月，開雅勒弼克金礦。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, the Yalebike gold mine was opened.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, the Yalebike gold mine was opened.

sentences.zh: 閏六月，已革商卓特巴巴特瑪多爾濟報效辦理新政銀二萬兩，三多請賞還原銜，飭回庫倫署商卓特巴篆務，以是款作為修汽車路之需。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month, dismissed shang zhuoteba Batmadorji contributed 20,000 taels for new policies; Sanduo requested restoration of rank, ordered back to Khüree as acting shang zhuoteba, the funds for automobile road repair.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month, dismissed shang zhuoteba Batmadorji contributed 20,000 taels for new policies; Sanduo asked to restore his rank and post, using the funds for automobile roads.

sentences.zh: 八月，奏：「近來邊事日急，今沿途台站，於來庫倫官員，則多方留難，於遞庫要件，則任意玩忽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, a memorial stated: "Border affairs grow urgent daily; relay stations now obstruct officials coming to Khüree in every way and neglect urgent dispatches.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, a memorial stated: "Border affairs grow urgent; relay stations obstruct officials bound for Khüree and neglect urgent dispatches.

sentences.zh: 請飭該管台站認真整頓。」

translations.literal: We request strict rectification of the stations under jurisdiction."
translations.idiomatic: We request strict rectification of the stations."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 九月，三多等以額爾德尼車臣報效銀一萬兩，奏准用杏黃圍車。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Sanduo and others, because Erdeni Sechen contributed 10,000 taels, memorialized approval for an apricot-yellow enclosed carriage.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Erdeni Sechen's 10,000-tael contribution won approval for an apricot-yellow enclosed carriage.

sentences.zh: 時哲布尊丹巴與三多不協，是部親王杭達多爾濟等以債務素密結俄人，不悅新政。

translations.literal: At that time Jebzundamba and Sanduo were at odds; this division's Prince Hangdadorji and others, long tied to Russians through debt, disliked the new policies.
translations.idiomatic: Jebzundamba and Sanduo were at odds; Prince Hangdadorji and others, indebted to Russians, disliked the new policies.

sentences.zh: 於是俄照會外務部，有不駐兵、不派官、不殖民之要求。

translations.literal: Russia then notified the Ministry of Foreign Affairs with demands of no garrison, no officials, and no colonization.
translations.idiomatic: Russia then notified the Foreign Ministry demanding no garrison, no officials, and no colonization.

sentences.zh: 洎武昌事起，各省鼎沸，杭達多爾濟等遂於十月初九日擁哲布尊丹巴稱尊號，建元立國，置內閣。

translations.literal: When the Wuchang affair arose and provinces seethed, Hangdadorji and others on the ninth day of the tenth month enthroned Jebzundamba with a title, established an era name and state, and set up a cabinet.
translations.idiomatic: When Wuchang rose and provinces seethed, Hangdadorji and others on the ninth of the tenth month enthroned Jebzundamba, declared an era, founded a state, and set up a cabinet.

sentences.zh: 以喀爾喀八十六扎薩克名義通牒中外，指斥清廷，興復元業，驅逐在外蒙之滿清官兵。

translations.literal: In the name of Khalkha's eighty-six jasaghs they addressed China and foreign powers, denouncing the Qing court, restoring the Yuan enterprise, and expelling Qing soldiers from Outer Mongolia.
translations.idiomatic: In the name of Khalkha's eighty-six jasaghs they addressed China and foreign powers, denouncing the Qing, restoring the Yuan legacy, and expelling Qing troops from Outer Mongolia.

sentences.zh: 三多被迫去職，賽爾烏蘇管站站員亦於十二月去職。

translations.literal: Sanduo was forced to leave office; Saier Usu station staff also left in the twelfth month.
translations.idiomatic: Sanduo was forced out; Saier Usu station staff also left in the twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 於是喀爾喀四部舉非清有。

translations.literal: Thus all four Khalkha divisions renounced Qing allegiance.
translations.idiomatic: Thus all four Khalkha divisions renounced Qing rule.

sentences.zh: 是部地兼耕牧，礦產林木，均稱饒富。

translations.literal: This division's land combines farming and herding; minerals and timber are all abundantly rich.
translations.idiomatic: This division combines farming and herding; minerals and timber are abundantly rich.

sentences.zh: 佐領共有四十九。

translations.literal: There are forty-nine company captains in all.
translations.idiomatic: There are forty-nine company captains in all.

sentences.zh: 車臣汗部，稱喀爾喀東路，至京師三千五百里。

translations.literal: The Sechen Khan banner, called the Khalkha eastern route, is 3,500 li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Sechen Khan banner—designated the Khalkha eastern route—lies 3,500 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東界額爾德尼陀羅海，西界察罕齊老圖，南界塔爾袞、柴達木，北界溫都爾罕。

translations.literal: On the east it borders Erdeni Doro Sea; on the west, Chaqan Qilaotu; on the south, Targhun and Qaidam; on the north, Undur Khan.
translations.idiomatic: It is bounded on the east by Erdeni Doro Sea, on the west by Chaqan Qilaotu, on the south by Targhun and Qaidam, and on the north by Undur Khan.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十七世孫阿敏都喇勒有子謨囉貝瑪，駐牧克嚕倫河，生子碩壘，始號車臣汗。

translations.literal: Amin Dorji, seventeenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, had a son Möro Bema who pastured on the Kerulen River; his son Sholoi first took the title Sechen Khan.
translations.idiomatic: Amin Dorji, a seventeenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, had a son Möro Bema on the Kerulen River; his son Sholoi first took the title Sechen Khan.

sentences.zh: 與其族土謝圖汗袞布、扎薩克圖汗素巴第同時稱三汗。

translations.literal: Together with his kinsmen Tüshiyetu Khan Günbo and Jasaghtu Khan Subedei, the three were simultaneously called the Three Khans.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Tüshiyetu Khan Günbo and Jasaghtu Khan Subedei, the three were known as the Three Khans.

sentences.zh: 子十一，今車臣汗部二十三扎薩克皆其裔。

translations.literal: He had eleven sons; today's twenty-three jasaghs of the Sechen Khan division are all his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: He had eleven sons; today's twenty-three Sechen Khan jasaghs are all his descendants.

sentences.zh: 長嘛察哩，號伊勒登土謝圖，為扎薩克貝子達哩、台吉旺紮勒紮布二旗祖；

translations.literal: The eldest Machali, titled Ilden Tüshiyetu, was ancestor of Jasagh Beile Dari's and Taiji Wangjaljab's two banners;
translations.idiomatic: The eldest Machali, titled Ilden Tüshiyetu, founded Jasagh Beile Dari's and Taiji Wangjaljab's two banners;

sentences.zh: 次察布哩，號額爾德尼台吉，為扎薩克台吉吹音珠爾一旗祖；

translations.literal: the second Chaburi, titled Erdeni Taiji, was ancestor of Jasagh Taiji Choyinjuur's one banner;
translations.idiomatic: the second Chaburi, titled Erdeni Taiji, founded Jasagh Taiji Choyinjuur's banner;

sentences.zh: 次拉布哩，號額爾克台吉，為扎薩克台吉色棱達什一旗祖。

translations.literal: the third Laburi, titled Erke Taiji, was ancestor of Jasagh Taiji Seren Dash's one banner.
translations.idiomatic: the third Laburi, titled Erke Taiji, founded Jasagh Taiji Seren Dash's banner.

sentences.zh: 次本巴，號巴圖爾達爾琿台吉，為扎薩克鎮國公車布登一旗祖；

translations.literal: the fourth Bemba, titled Batu Dalai Khung-taiji, was ancestor of Jasagh State Guardian Duke Chobdond's one banner;
translations.idiomatic: the fourth Bemba, titled Batu Dalai Khung-taiji, founded Jasagh State Guardian Duke Chobdond's banner;

sentences.zh: 次巴布，龔父汗號，為車臣汗烏默客，扎薩克郡王納木紮勒、朋素克，台吉韜賚、羅卜藏、垂木紮素、額爾德尼、根敦八旗祖；

translations.literal: the fifth Babu, titled Gongfu Khan, was ancestor of Sechen Khan Umeke, Jasagh Junwang Namjal and Pensik, and Taiji Toloi, Lobzang, Chömjazu, Erdeni, and Gendün's eight banners;
translations.idiomatic: the fifth Babu, titled Gongfu Khan, founded Sechen Khan Umeke's line and eight banners including Jasagh Junwang Namjal and Pensik;

sentences.zh: 次綽斯喜布，號額爾德尼琿台吉，為扎薩克輔國公車淩達什，台吉多爾濟達什、固嚕紮布三旗祖；

translations.literal: the sixth Choshib, titled Erdeni Khung-taiji, was ancestor of Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Chörindashi, Taiji Dorj Dash, and Guljab's three banners;
translations.idiomatic: the sixth Choshib, titled Erdeni Khung-taiji, founded three banners including Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Chörindashi's;

sentences.zh: 次巴特瑪什，號達賚琿台吉，為扎薩克貝勒車布登、輔國公車淩旺布、台吉車淩多嶽特三旗祖；

translations.literal: the seventh Batmash, titled Dalai Khung-taiji, was ancestor of Jasagh Beile Chobdon, Assistant State Guardian Duke Chöriwangbo, and Taiji Chörindoyit's three banners;
translations.idiomatic: the seventh Batmash, titled Dalai Khung-taiji, founded three banners including Jasagh Beile Chobdon's;

sentences.zh: 次車布登，號車臣濟農；

translations.literal: the eighth Chobdon, titled Sechen Jinong;
translations.idiomatic: the eighth Chobdon, titled Sechen Jinong;

sentences.zh: 次阿南達，號達賚濟農；

translations.literal: the ninth Ananda, titled Dalai Jinong;
translations.idiomatic: the ninth Ananda, titled Dalai Jinong;

sentences.zh: 次布達紮布，號額爾德尼濟農：均封扎薩克貝子。

translations.literal: the tenth Budajab, titled Erdeni Jinong: all were enfeoffed as jasagh beile.
translations.idiomatic: the tenth Budajab, titled Erdeni Jinong: all were enfeoffed as jasagh beile.

sentences.zh: 阿南達子貢楚克，授扎薩克台吉，又自為一旗。

translations.literal: Ananda's son Günchok was granted jasagh taiji and formed another banner.
translations.idiomatic: Ananda's son Günchok received jasagh taiji and formed another banner.

sentences.zh: 初，喀爾喀服屬於察哈爾。

translations.literal: Initially Khalkha was subject to Chahar.
translations.idiomatic: Initially Khalkha was subject to Chahar.

sentences.zh: 天聰九年，大軍平察哈爾，車臣汗碩壘偕烏珠穆沁、蘇尼特諸部長上書通好，貢駝馬。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 9, the great army pacified Chahar; Sechen Khan Sholoi with Ujumchin, Sunid, and other chiefs sent letters seeking friendship and tribute camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 9, after the army pacified Chahar, Sechen Khan Sholoi with Ujumchin and Sunid chiefs sent letters of friendship and tribute camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年春，以其部私與明市馬，諭責之曰：「明，朕仇也。

translations.literal: In the spring of Chongde 1, because his division privately traded horses with Ming, an edict rebuked him: "Ming is the emperor's enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Chongde 1, because his division traded horses privately with Ming, an edict rebuked him: "Ming is the emperor's enemy.

sentences.zh: 前者察哈爾林丹汗貪明歲幣，沮朕伐明，且欲助之，朕故移師往征。

translations.literal: Formerly Chahar's Ligdan Khan, greedy for Ming annual payments, obstructed the campaign against Ming and wished to aid it; the emperor therefore moved troops to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Chahar's Ligdan Khan, greedy for Ming payments, obstructed our campaign and wished to aid Ming; we therefore marched against him.

sentences.zh: 天以察哈爾為非，故以其國予朕。

translations.literal: Heaven found Chahar wrong and therefore gave its realm to the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Heaven found Chahar in the wrong and gave its realm to us.

sentences.zh: 今爾與明市馬，是助明也。

translations.literal: Now you trade horses with Ming—that is aiding Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Now you trade horses with Ming—that is aiding Ming.

sentences.zh: 爾當以察哈爾為戒，其改之！」

translations.literal: You should take Chahar as a warning—reform!"
translations.idiomatic: Take Chahar as a warning and reform!"

sentences.zh: 碩壘遣偉徵喇嘛等來朝，請與明絕市，上嘉之，命察罕喇嘛往賚貂服、朝珠、弓、刀、金幣。

translations.literal: Sholoi sent Weizheng Lama and others to court, requesting to break trade with Ming; the emperor praised this and ordered Chaqan Lama to bestow sable robes, court beads, bow, knife, and gold coins.
translations.idiomatic: Sholoi sent Weizheng Lama to court requesting to break trade with Ming; the emperor praised this and sent Chaqan Lama with sable robes, court beads, bow, knife, and gold.

sentences.zh: 二年，獻所產獸曰獺喜。

translations.literal: In the second year, he presented a native animal called taki.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, he presented a native animal called taki.

sentences.zh: 三年，獻馬及甲胄、貂皮、雕翎，俄羅斯鳥槍，回部弓箙、鞍轡，阿爾瑪斯斧、白鼠裘，唐古特玄狐皮。

translations.literal: In the third year, he presented horses, armor, sable fur, eagle feathers, Russian muskets, Muslim bow cases and saddlery, Almas axes, white-rat fur, and Tangut black-fox pelts.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, he presented horses, armor, sable, eagle feathers, Russian muskets, Muslim bow cases and saddlery, Almas axes, white-rat fur, and Tangut black-fox pelts.

sentences.zh: 詔歲貢九白，他物毋入獻。

translations.literal: An edict fixed annual tribute of the Nine Whites; other items were not to be presented.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fixed annual Nine Whites tribute; other items were not to be presented.

sentences.zh: 順治三年，碩壘誘蘇尼特部長騰機思叛，遣子本巴等以兵三萬援，大軍敗之。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 3, Sholoi incited Sunid chief Tenggis to rebel and sent his son Bemba and others with 30,000 troops to aid; the great army defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 3, Sholoi incited Sunid chief Tenggis to rebel and sent his son Bemba with 30,000 troops; the army defeated them.

sentences.zh: 師旋，詔責碩壘曰：「蘇尼特本察哈爾屬部，向化來歸，爾誘之使叛。

translations.literal: On the army's return, an edict rebuked Sholoi: "Sunid was originally a Chahar dependency that submitted; you incited them to rebel.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return, an edict rebuked Sholoi: "Sunid was a Chahar dependency that submitted; you incited them to rebel.

sentences.zh: 朕遣兵追剿時，猶誡勿加兵於爾。

translations.literal: When the emperor sent troops in pursuit, he still warned not to attack you.
translations.idiomatic: When we sent troops in pursuit, we still warned them not to attack you.

sentences.zh: 詎意爾反稱兵抗拒，以致上蒼降譴，立見敗衄。

translations.literal: Who would have thought you would instead raise troops in resistance, causing Heaven's punishment and immediate defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Yet you raised troops in resistance, bringing Heaven's punishment and immediate defeat.

sentences.zh: 儻非朕飭令班師，大兵既壓爾境，何難長驅直入耶？

translations.literal: If the emperor had not ordered withdrawal, once the great army pressed your borders, what difficulty would there be in driving straight in?
translations.idiomatic: Had we not ordered withdrawal, once the army reached your borders, what would have stopped a direct advance?

sentences.zh: 今爾若知自悔，欲贖前愆，其速擒騰機思來獻！」

translations.literal: If you now know repentance and wish to atone for past faults, quickly capture Tenggis and present him!"
translations.idiomatic: If you now repent and wish to atone, quickly capture Tenggis and deliver him!"

sentences.zh: 五年，騰機思乞降，碩壘遣使獻駝百、馬千入謝，詔遣子弟來朝。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, Tenggis begged to surrender; Sholoi sent envoys presenting a hundred camels and a thousand horses in thanks; an edict ordered sons and younger kinsmen to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, Tenggis surrendered; Sholoi sent envoys with a hundred camels and a thousand horses; sons and younger kinsmen were ordered to court.

sentences.zh: 九年，以妄爭歲貢賞，諭責勿貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, for disputing annual tribute rewards, rebuke was ordered and tribute forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, for disputing tribute rewards, they were rebuked and told not to present tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二年，巴布繼其父碩壘為車臣汗，遣子穆彰墨爾根楚琥爾來朝，詔宥前罪，貢九白如初。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Babu succeeded his father Sholoi as Sechen Khan; he sent his son Muzhang Mergen Chuhur to court; an edict pardoned past offenses and restored Nine Whites tribute as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Babu succeeded Sholoi as Sechen Khan; his son Muzhang Mergen Chuhur came to court; past offenses were pardoned and Nine Whites tribute restored.

sentences.zh: 是年，喀爾喀左右翼設八扎薩克，命車臣汗領左翼扎薩克之一。

translations.literal: That year, eight jasaghs were established for Khalkha left and right wings; the Sechen Khan was ordered to lead one of the left-wing jasaghs.
translations.idiomatic: That year, eight Khalkha jasaghs were established; the Sechen Khan was to lead one left-wing jasagh.

sentences.zh: 十五年，遣大臣齎服物諭賚之。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, a minister was dispatched bearing robes to bestow.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, a minister was sent with robes as gifts.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十一年，以所屬巴爾呼人私掠烏珠穆沁部界，議增汛兵，嚴防禦。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 21, because subordinate Barghu people privately raided Ujumchin borders, increased garrison troops and strict defense were deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 21, Barghu raiders hit Ujumchin borders; increased garrisons and strict defense were planned.

sentences.zh: 會貢使至，諭曰：「朕聞爾屬眾與界內蒙古互相竊奪，彼此效尤，恐乖生計。

translations.literal: When tribute envoys arrived, an edict stated: "We hear your people and border Mongols mutually raid and copy one another, fearing harm to livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: When tribute envoys arrived, an edict stated: "We hear your people and border Mongols raid each other, harming livelihoods.

sentences.zh: 朕已飭界內人毋許出境滋擾，爾亦當約束所屬，守分安居。

translations.literal: We have ordered border people not to cross out and disturb; you too must restrain your followers and keep peace in your places.
translations.idiomatic: We have forbidden border people to cross out; you must restrain your followers and keep peace.

sentences.zh: 違者即拘治之，毋稍姑息。」

translations.literal: Violators are to be arrested and punished without leniency."
translations.idiomatic: Violators are to be arrested and punished without leniency."

sentences.zh: 二十二年，詔毋越噶爾拜瀚海遊牧。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, an edict forbade pasturing beyond the Galbai Gobi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, pasturing beyond the Galbai Gobi was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 巴布卒，子諾爾布嗣車臣汗。

translations.literal: Babu died; his son Norbu succeeded as Sechen Khan.
translations.idiomatic: Babu died; his son Norbu succeeded as Sechen Khan.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，偕土謝圖汗察琿多爾濟表上尊號，諭卻之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, together with Tüshiyetu Khan Caqur Dorji he memorialized offering a honorific title; an edict declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, with Tüshiyetu Khan Caqur Dorji he offered an honorific title; the court declined.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹掠喀爾喀至克嚕倫河。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Galdan raided Khalkha to the Kerulen River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, Galdan raided Khalkha to the Kerulen River.

sentences.zh: 時諾爾布及長子伊勒登阿喇布坦相繼卒，孫烏默客幼，台吉納木紮勒等攜之來歸，從眾凡十萬餘戶，詔附牧烏珠穆沁諸部界，烏默客襲汗號如故。

translations.literal: Norbu and his eldest son Ilden Arabtan died in succession; grandson Umeke was young; Taiji Namjal and others brought him to submit, followers totaling over 100,000 households; an edict ordered them to pasture near Ujumchin borders; Umeke inherited the khan title as before.
translations.idiomatic: Norbu and his eldest son Ilden Arabtan died; young grandson Umeke was brought to submit by Taiji Namjal with over 100,000 households; they pastured near Ujumchin; Umeke kept the khan title.

sentences.zh: 尋理籓院奏降眾日多，請授納木紮勒等為扎薩克轄之，報可。

translations.literal: Soon the Lifan Yuan memorialized that surrendered people grew daily and requested appointing Namjal and others as jasaghs to govern them; approved.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Lifan Yuan reported growing numbers of refugees and asked to appoint Namjal and others as jasaghs; approved.

sentences.zh: 命科爾沁親王沙津等往示內地法度，諭曰：「朕因爾等為厄魯特所掠，憐而納之。

translations.literal: Khorchin Prince Shajin and others were ordered to explain inland laws, stating: "Because you were plundered by the Oirats, We took pity and received you.
translations.idiomatic: Khorchin Prince Shajin was sent to explain inland laws: "Because Oirats plundered you, we received you in pity.

sentences.zh: 今觀爾等並無法制約束部曲，恐劫奪不已，離析愈多。

translations.literal: Now We see you have no laws restraining followers; fearing endless raiding and growing fragmentation.
translations.idiomatic: Now we see you have no laws restraining followers; raiding may never stop and fragmentation grow.

sentences.zh: 爰命增置扎薩克，分掌旗隊，禁止盜賊，各謀生業。

translations.literal: We therefore order additional jasaghs to command banners, forbid banditry, and let each seek livelihood.
translations.idiomatic: We therefore appoint jasaghs to command banners, forbid banditry, and let each seek livelihood.

sentences.zh: 爾等果能遵而行之，寇盜不興，禍亂不作，庶副朕撫育歸降、愛養群生之至意。」

translations.literal: If you truly obey, bandits will not arise and turmoil will not occur, fulfilling Our intent to nurture the surrendered and cherish all living beings."
translations.idiomatic: If you obey, bandits will not arise and you will fulfill our intent to nurture the surrendered."

sentences.zh: 二十九年，選所部兵赴圖拉河，隨尚書阿喇尼偵禦噶爾丹。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, division troops were selected for the Tula River, joining Minister Arani in reconnaissance against Galdan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, division troops joined Minister Arani on the Tula River to scout Galdan.

sentences.zh: 三十年，駕幸多倫諾爾會閱，詔封王、貝勒、貝子、台吉有差，各授扎薩克，編所部佐領，而以車臣汗烏默客統其眾。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, at the Dolon Nor review, princes, beile, beile, and taiji were enfeoffed at various ranks, each granted jasagh, companies organized, and Sechen Khan Umeke commanded the whole.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, at the Dolon Nor review, princes and taiji were enfeoffed, jasaghs appointed, companies organized, and Sechen Khan Umeke commanded all.

sentences.zh: 自是始稱車臣汗部。

translations.literal: From this the Sechen Khan division was first so named.
translations.idiomatic: From this it was first called the Sechen Khan division.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，定所部為喀爾喀東路。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the division was fixed as the Khalkha eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, the division was designated the Khalkha eastern route.

sentences.zh: 三十四年，遣官往購駝馬。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fourth year, officials were dispatched to purchase camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fourth year, officials were sent to purchase camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 三十五年，上親征噶爾丹，師次克嚕倫河，烏默客等以兵從。

translations.literal: In the thirty-fifth year, the emperor personally campaigned against Galdan; the army halted at the Kerulen River; Umeke and others followed with troops.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-fifth year, the emperor campaigned against Galdan; at the Kerulen River Umeke and others followed with troops.

sentences.zh: 凱旋，所部沿途慶獻，日億萬計。

translations.literal: On the triumphal return, the division offered celebrations along the route, daily gifts in the tens of millions.
translations.idiomatic: On the triumphal return, the division offered celebrations along the route in vast numbers daily.

sentences.zh: 明年，詔歸克嚕倫河遊牧。

translations.literal: The next year, an edict ordered return to Kerulen River pastures.
translations.idiomatic: The next year, they were ordered back to Kerulen River pastures.

sentences.zh: 五十五年，諭所部選駝六千，以兵五千領之，由郭多里巴勒噶遜運軍糧赴推河。

translations.literal: In the fifty-fifth year, the division was ordered to select six thousand camels led by five thousand soldiers to transport grain from Godiribalegaxun to the Tui River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-fifth year, six thousand camels with five thousand soldiers were to transport grain from Godiribalegaxun to the Tui River.

sentences.zh: 六十年，調兵防護烏梁海降眾於巴顏珠爾克。

translations.literal: In the sixtieth year, troops were mobilized to guard Uriankhai surrendered people at Bayanzhurga.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixtieth year, troops guarded Uriankhai refugees at Bayanzhurga.

sentences.zh: 雍正九年，選兵三千赴察罕廋爾軍營從剿噶爾丹策淩。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 9, three thousand soldiers were selected for the Chaqan Nur camp to join suppression of Galdan Tseren.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 9, three thousand soldiers joined the Chaqan Nur camp against Galdan Tseren.

sentences.zh: 十一年，復詔以所部兵千屯遊牧西界，訓練防守，並追緝巴爾呼逃眾。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, an edict again ordered a thousand division soldiers to garrison the western border pastures for drill and defense, and to pursue fugitive Barghu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, a thousand soldiers garrisoned the western border for drill and to pursue fugitive Barghu.

sentences.zh: 十三年，撤還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，選兵赴鄂爾坤防秋。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 1, soldiers were selected for autumn defense at the Ergün.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1, soldiers were sent for autumn defense at the Ergün.

sentences.zh: 六年，命參贊大臣都統塔爾瑪善察閱防秋兵於塞勒壁口。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Assistant Commissioner Commander Tarmashan was ordered to inspect autumn-defense troops at Sailebi Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Assistant Commissioner Tarmashan inspected autumn-defense troops at Sailebi Pass.

sentences.zh: 十三年，選駝五百運歸化城米赴塔密爾軍營。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, five hundred camels were selected to transport Guihuacheng grain to the Tamir camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, five hundred camels carried Guihuacheng grain to the Tamir camp.

sentences.zh: 十七年，選兵四千駐防巴顏烏蘭。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, four thousand soldiers were selected to garrison Bayan Ulan.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, four thousand soldiers garrisoned Bayan Ulan.

sentences.zh: 二十年，隨大軍剿達瓦齊於伊犁。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, they joined the great army suppressing Dawachi at Ili.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, they joined the army suppressing Dawachi at Ili.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，以所屬齊木齊格特人肆竊，命參贊大臣納穆扎爾等往緝，寘之法。
