translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, because subordinate Chimuqiget people committed theft, Assistant Commissioner Namujar and others were ordered to arrest them and punish by law.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year, Chimuqiget thieves were arrested and punished by Assistant Commissioner Namujar.

sentences.zh: 諭扎薩克等曰：「朕因爾等不善經理遊牧，以致盜賊肆行，特命大臣前往督緝。

translations.literal: Jasaghs were told: "Because you poorly managed pastures, bandits ran rampant; We specially ordered ministers to supervise suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Jasaghs were told: "Because you poorly managed pastures, bandits ran rampant; we ordered ministers to supervise suppression.

sentences.zh: 念皆起於饑寒，復令發帑賑給貧戶，以贍生業。

translations.literal: Considering all arose from hunger and cold, treasury relief was again ordered for poor households to sustain livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: Because poverty drove them, treasury relief was ordered for poor households.

sentences.zh: 爾等遊牧，始皆寧謐。

translations.literal: Your pastures were at first all peaceful.
translations.idiomatic: Your pastures were at first peaceful.

sentences.zh: 爾等習於玩愒，徒知盜賊已除，不復為貧者籌畫生計。

translations.literal: You are accustomed to negligence, knowing only that bandits were removed, no longer planning livelihoods for the poor.
translations.idiomatic: You grew negligent, knowing only that bandits were gone, not planning livelihoods for the poor.

sentences.zh: 又或目前尚知約束，日久漸至廢弛。

translations.literal: Some may still restrain themselves for now, but over time discipline slackens.
translations.idiomatic: Some restrain themselves now, but discipline slackens over time.

sentences.zh: 當各統率所屬，詳察貧困之由，俾謀生有策，不至為非。

translations.literal: Each should lead followers, examine causes of poverty, enable livelihood plans, and prevent wrongdoing.
translations.idiomatic: Each should lead followers, examine poverty's causes, enable livelihoods, and prevent wrongdoing.

sentences.zh: 即有頑悍不悛之徒，亦當嚴加約束，有犯必懲。

translations.literal: Even stubborn unreformed persons must be strictly restrained; offenders must be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Even stubborn offenders must be strictly restrained and punished.

sentences.zh: 務令上下安全，共用升平之福。」

translations.literal: Ensure safety above and below and share the blessings of peace."
translations.idiomatic: Ensure safety throughout and share the blessings of peace."

sentences.zh: 蕩平准部之役，是部扎薩克郡王巴雅爾什第、扎薩克輔國公達爾濟雅均以俘叛賊包沁副總管阿克珠勒等功，巴雅爾什第晉親王，達爾濟雅晉貝子，扎薩克一等台吉成袞紮布多爾濟以察逆賊青袞咱卜造偽符撤汛兵之詐，督兵嚴守各汛，予公品級，而貝勒旺沁紮布以死事伊犁，予優恤。

translations.literal: In the campaign pacifying the Zunghars, this division's Jasagh Junwang Bayarshidi and Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Darjiya both for capturing rebel Baoqin's deputy Akjule were promoted—Bayarshidi to qinwang, Darjiya to beizi; Jasagh First-Class Taiji Chenggunjab Dorji for detecting rebel Qinggunjab's forged orders to withdraw garrison troops, commanding strict defense at all posts, received gong rank; Beile Wangqinjab died at Ili and received generous condolence.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zunghar campaign, Jasagh Junwang Bayarshidi and Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Darjiya were promoted for capturing rebel Baoqin's deputy; Jasagh First-Class Taiji Chenggunjab Dorji received gong rank for exposing a forged garrison withdrawal; Beile Wangqinjab died at Ili and was generously mourned.

sentences.zh: 先是車臣汗部編佐領，置十一旗，後增十二旗。

translations.literal: Previously the Sechen Khan division organized companies and established eleven banners, later adding twelve.
translations.idiomatic: The Sechen Khan division first had eleven banners with companies, later adding twelve.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克二十有三，盟於克嚕倫巴爾河屯，設正副盟長各一，副將軍參贊各一。

translations.literal: There are twenty-three jasaghs, leaguing at Kerulen Bar River post, with one chief and one deputy league head each, and one deputy general and one assistant commissioner each.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-three jasaghs leagued at Kerulen Bar River with chief and deputy league heads, deputy general, and assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 爵二十有六：車臣汗一；

translations.literal: Titles number twenty-six: one Sechen Khan;
translations.idiomatic: Titles number twenty-six: one Sechen Khan;

sentences.zh: 附輔國公一；

translations.literal: one attached Assistant State Guardian Duke;
translations.idiomatic: one attached Assistant State Guardian Duke;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克和碩親王一，由郡王晉襲；

translations.literal: one Jasagh Hoshoi Qinwang, promoted from junwang;
translations.idiomatic: one Jasagh Hoshoi Qinwang, promoted from junwang;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅郡王一；

translations.literal: one Jasagh Duoluo Junwang;
translations.idiomatic: one Jasagh Duoluo Junwang;

sentences.zh: 附多羅貝勒一；

translations.literal: one attached Duoluo Beile;
translations.idiomatic: one attached Duoluo Beile;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅貝勒一；

translations.literal: one Jasagh Duoluo Beile;
translations.idiomatic: one Jasagh Duoluo Beile;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克固山貝子二，一由貝勒降襲；

translations.literal: two Jasagh Gushan Beizi, one demoted from beile;
translations.idiomatic: two Jasagh Gushan Beizi, one demoted from beile;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克鎮國公一；

translations.literal: one Jasagh State Guardian Duke;
translations.idiomatic: one Jasagh State Guardian Duke;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克輔國公二，一由貝子降襲；

translations.literal: two Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Dukes, one demoted from beizi;
translations.idiomatic: two Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Dukes, one demoted from beizi;

sentences.zh: 公品級扎薩克一等台吉一；

translations.literal: one gong-rank Jasagh First-Class Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: one gong-rank Jasagh First-Class Taiji;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克一等台吉十三，一由貝子降襲，二由輔國公降襲；

translations.literal: thirteen Jasagh First-Class Taiji, one demoted from beizi, two from Assistant State Guardian Duke;
translations.idiomatic: thirteen Jasagh First-Class Taiji, one demoted from beizi, two from Assistant State Guardian Duke;

sentences.zh: 附鎮國公一，由貝子降襲。

translations.literal: one attached State Guardian Duke, demoted from beizi.
translations.idiomatic: one attached State Guardian Duke, demoted from beizi.

sentences.zh: 二十五年八月，命車臣汗部落一體與土謝圖汗等三部落充派兵諸差。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year, the Sechen Khan division was ordered together with the Tüshiyetu Khan and other three divisions to fulfill troop assignments and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year, the Sechen Khan division was ordered with the other three Khalkha divisions to fulfill troop and corvée duties.

sentences.zh: 三十年，以是部扎薩克貝子旺沁紮布能約束屬下，捕獲私貿俄羅斯民人、蒙古等，上嘉之。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, because this division's Jasagh Beizi Wangqinjab could restrain followers and capture Russians and Mongols trading privately, the emperor praised him.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, Jasagh Beizi Wangqinjab was praised for restraining followers and capturing illegal Russian and Mongol traders.

sentences.zh: 四十七年，是部郡王桑齋多爾濟旗與黑龍江屬之呼倫貝爾巴爾虎處爭界，謂呼倫貝爾總管將音陳、阿魯布拉克等卡倫私自挪移。

translations.literal: In the forty-seventh year, this division's Junwang Sanjaidorji's banner disputed borders with Hulun Buir Barghu under Heilongjiang, claiming the Hulun Buir commander privately moved pickets including Yinchen and Alubulag.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-seventh year, Junwang Sanjaidorji's banner disputed borders with Hulun Buir Barghu, claiming the commander moved pickets at Yinchen and Alubulag.

sentences.zh: 四十八年，呼倫貝爾總管三保會桑齋多爾濟及貝勒車淩多爾濟帶同耆老斟酌地圖，由界內挖出舊設卡倫所埋記木，貝勒車淩多爾濟將所屬人等全行收回，桑齋多爾濟仍稱阿魯布拉克一卡往外展占五十里。

translations.literal: In the forty-eighth year, Hulun Buir Commander Sanbao met Sanjaidorji and Beile Chörindorji with elders to consult maps, dug up marker posts of old pickets; Beile Chörindorji withdrew all followers; Sanjaidorji still claimed Alubulag picket extended fifty li outward.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-eighth year, Commander Sanbao met Sanjaidorji and Beile Chörindorji, dug up old picket markers; Chörindorji withdrew his people; Sanjaidorji still claimed Alubulag extended fifty li outward.

sentences.zh: 五十年，黑龍江將軍恆秀等查辦是部人等報稱阿魯布拉克卡並未外展占越，桑齋多爾濟坐罰俸。

translations.literal: In the fiftieth year, Heilongjiang General Hengxiu investigated and this division reported Alubulag picket had not extended outward; Sanjaidorji was fined salary.
translations.idiomatic: In the fiftieth year, General Hengxiu found Alubulag had not extended outward; Sanjaidorji was fined.

sentences.zh: 咸豐四年正月，是部車臣汗阿爾罕什達捐銀助軍，受之，卻王公等捐軍需之請。

translations.literal: In the first month of Xianfeng 4, this division's Sechen Khan Arhanshda donated silver for the army; it was accepted, but princes' military donation requests were declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Xianfeng 4, Sechen Khan Arhanshda's silver donation was accepted, but princes' military donation requests were declined.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，是部郡王等旗又與黑龍江巴爾虎爭界，尋命吉林將軍皁保勘之。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi 2, this division's junwang banners again disputed borders with Heilongjiang Barghu; Jilin General Zaobao was soon ordered to survey.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 2, junwang banners again disputed borders with Heilongjiang Barghu; Jilin General Zaobao was ordered to survey.

sentences.zh: 三年。

translations.literal: Third year.
translations.idiomatic: Tongzhi 3.

sentences.zh: 調是部兵援古城，潰歸。

translations.literal: This division's troops were mobilized to aid Gucheng and fled back in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Division troops sent to aid Gucheng fled back in rout.

sentences.zh: 四年，扎薩克車林敦多布以逗留嚴議。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, Jasagh Chörindondob was severely disciplined for stalling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, Jasagh Chörindondob was severely punished for stalling.

sentences.zh: 六年，調車盟兵戍卡倫。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Sechen league troops were mobilized to garrison pickets.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Sechen league troops garrisoned border pickets.

sentences.zh: 九年，回匪東擾圖盟，是部供軍需，增戍役，應捐輸，勞費與圖盟等。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Muslim rebels disturbed the east of the Tümen league; this division supplied military needs, increased garrison duty and donations, labor and expense equal to the Tümen league.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, rebels disturbed eastern Tümen league; this division supplied troops, garrison duty, and donations like the Tümen league.

sentences.zh: 九年十月，庫倫辦事大臣張廷岳以回匪東擾烏裏雅蘇台境，奏派是部貝勒幹丹准車林赴額爾德尼昭會剿。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the ninth year, Khüree Commissioner Zhang Tingyue, because rebels disturbed eastern Urga, memorialized dispatching this division's Beile Gandan Chörin to Erdeni Juu for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the ninth year, Zhang Tingyue dispatched Beile Gandan Chörin to Erdeni Juu for joint suppression.

sentences.zh: 尋撤回。

translations.literal: Soon withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Soon withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 十年六月，以回匪踞圖盟左翼中旗郡王拉蘇倫巴咱爾遊牧，圖犯庫倫，又派幹丹准車林統駐庫蒙兵赴噶爾沁圖里克、托里布拉克二台協剿。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the tenth year, because rebels occupied Tümen league left-wing middle-banner Junwang Lasu Lunbazar's pastures and threatened Khüree, Gandan Chörin was again dispatched commanding Khüree Mongol troops to Galjin Tulik and Toribulag stations for joint suppression.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the tenth year, rebels threatened Khüree from Lasu Lunbazar's pastures; Gandan Chörin led Khüree Mongol troops to Galjin Tulik and Toribulag stations.

sentences.zh: 十一年十二月，以竄烏、庫兩城回匪均回肅州老巢，撤車盟官兵一半。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year, because rebels who had raided Urga and Khüree all returned to Suzhou strongholds, half the Sechen league troops were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the eleventh year, rebels withdrew to Suzhou; half the Sechen league troops were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月，張廷岳以烏里雅蘇臺將軍全順西征，庫倫籌備駝只，張廷嶽派員赴圖、車二盟勸諭各王公等竭力捐助。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twelfth year, because Urga General Quanshun marched west, Khüree prepared camels; Zhang Tingyue dispatched staff to Tümen and Sechen leagues urging princes to donate zealously.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twelfth year, with Urga General Quanshun marching west, Zhang Tingyue urged Tümen and Sechen princes to donate camels.

sentences.zh: 光緒七年，以改議俄約，調車盟兵駐庫倫。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 7, because the Russian treaty was under revision, Sechen league troops were posted at Khüree.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7, Sechen league troops were posted at Khüree during Russian treaty revision.

sentences.zh: 尋以約定撤之。

translations.literal: Soon withdrawn per treaty agreement.
translations.idiomatic: Soon withdrawn per the treaty.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，將軍崇歡以烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣攤車盟規費特重，請禁之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, General Chonghuan because Urga assistant commissioner assessed Sechen league customary fees as especially heavy requested prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 22, General Chonghuan asked to ban heavy Sechen league customary fees assessed by the Urga assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庫倫辦事大臣桂斌以車臣汗阿爾塔什達任參贊大臣作俑，請追款，諭免之。

translations.literal: Khüree Commissioner Guibin, because Sechen Khan Altashda as assistant commissioner started the practice, requested recovery of funds; an edict waived it.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner Guibin asked to recover funds started by Sechen Khan Altashda as assistant commissioner; the court waived it.

sentences.zh: 是年，桂斌奏車盟報應襲台吉已報未襲者有六百餘員，積壓未題者有三次之久。

translations.literal: That year, Guibin memorialized that over six hundred Sechen league taiji reported for succession but not invested, backlog unmemorialized for three rounds.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Guibin reported over six hundred Sechen taiji awaiting succession, backlogged three rounds.

sentences.zh: 諭理籓院迅速核辦，不准積壓。

translations.literal: The Lifan Yuan was ordered to process quickly without backlog.
translations.idiomatic: The Lifan Yuan was ordered to process quickly without backlog.

sentences.zh: 二十五年九月，烏里雅蘇臺將軍連順奏車臣汗德木楚克多爾濟阻撓礦務，與俄人交密，形狀可疑，諭撤去差使。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-fifth year, Urga General Lianshun memorialized Sechen Khan Demchugdorji obstructed mining and consorted closely with Russians, suspicious in appearance; he was ordered removed from assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Guangxu 25, Lianshun reported Sechen Khan Demchugdorji obstructed mining and consorted with Russians; he was removed.

sentences.zh: 十一月，是部王公等又呈理籓院請停辦礦務，命昆岡等往勘緩之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, this division's princes again petitioned the Lifan Yuan to stop mining; Kungang and others were ordered to survey and defer.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, princes again asked to stop mining; Kungang was sent to survey and defer.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪事起，庫倫辦事大臣豐升阿等調是部各旗官兵自備餉項，巡防邊卡。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, when the Boxer affair arose, Khüree Commissioner Fengsheng'a mobilized this division's banner troops with self-provided pay to patrol border pickets.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26, Fengsheng'a mobilized banner troops with self-provided pay to patrol border pickets during the Boxer crisis.

sentences.zh: 洎呼倫貝爾為俄兵所據，巴爾虎諸處避難官民均至是部界內，盟長等防守撫輯，均協所宜。

translations.literal: When Hulun Buir was taken by Russian troops, refugee officials and people from Barghu areas all reached this division's borders; league chiefs defended and pacified, all appropriately coordinated.
translations.idiomatic: When Russians took Hulun Buir, Barghu refugees reached this division; league chiefs defended and pacified them appropriately.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，豐升阿以是部王公異常出力，請予獎勵。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Fengsheng'a because this division's princes exerted exceptional effort requested rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28, Fengsheng'a requested rewards for princes' exceptional effort.

sentences.zh: 於是車盟盟長郡王多爾濟帕拉穆加親王銜，副盟長扎薩克鎮國公車林尼瑪挑御前行走，參贊扎薩克輔國公那爾莽達琥賞雙眼花翎，餘給獎有差。

translations.literal: Thus Sechen league chief Junwang Dorji Param received qinwang rank; deputy chief Jasagh State Guardian Duke Chörinima received imperial attendant selection; assistant Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Narmadahu received double-peacock plumes; others graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Sechen league chief Junwang Dorji Param received qinwang rank; deputy Jasagh State Guardian Duke Chörinima imperial attendant selection; assistant Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Narmadahu double-peacock plumes; others graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年二月，內盟蒙匪托克托等竄擾是部貝子桑薩賴多爾濟旗，三多遣駐庫宣化練軍營官鄭春田等迎擊失利。

translations.literal: In the second month of Xuantong 2, Inner Mongolia bandits Tokto and others raided this division's Beizi Sansaraidorji's banner; Sanduo dispatched Xuanhua drill officer Zheng Chuntian and others to intercept but failed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Xuantong 2, bandit Tokto raided Beizi Sansaraidorji's banner; Sanduo's intercept force under Zheng Chuntian failed.

sentences.zh: 電諭周樹模飭呼倫道汛派兵往接應，而蒙匪竄俄境。

translations.literal: A telegram ordered Zhou Shumo to dispatch Hulun troops to support; the bandits fled into Russian territory.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Shumo was telegraphed to dispatch Hulun troops; the bandits fled into Russia.

sentences.zh: 是年，是部郡王多爾濟帕拉穆為資政院欽選議員。

translations.literal: That year, this division's Junwang Dorji Param was an imperially selected Advisory Council member.
translations.idiomatic: That year, Junwang Dorji Param was an imperially selected Advisory Council member.

sentences.zh: 三年閏六月，是部扎薩克貝子多爾濟車林等報效辦理新政銀兩，獎之。

translations.literal: In the intercalary sixth month of the third year, this division's Jasagh Beizi Dorji Chörin and others contributed silver for new policies; rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary sixth month of Xuantong 3, Jasagh Beizi Dorji Chörin and others contributed silver for new policies and were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 十一月，哲布尊丹巴稱尊號於庫倫，脅是部王、公、扎薩克等附之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Jebzundamba took a title at Khüree and coerced this division's princes and jasaghs to join.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Jebzundamba declared a title at Khüree and coerced princes and jasaghs to join.

sentences.zh: 是部車臣汗阿爾塔什達、車林多爾濟父子皆為烏里雅蘇臺參贊大臣。

translations.literal: This division's Sechen Khan Altashda and his son Chörindorji both served as Urga assistant commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Sechen Khan Altashda and his son Chörindorji both served as Urga assistant commissioners.

sentences.zh: 有礦，有鹽池，有成吉思汗陵。

translations.literal: It has mines, salt lakes, and Genghis Khan's tomb.
translations.idiomatic: It has mines, salt lakes, and Genghis Khan's tomb.

sentences.zh: 佐領共有四十。

translations.literal: There are forty company captains in all.
translations.idiomatic: There are forty company captains in all.

sentences.zh: 賽因諾顏部，稱喀爾喀中路，至京師三千餘里。

translations.literal: The Sayin Noyan division, called the Khalkha middle route, is over 3,000 li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Sayin Noyan division—designated the Khalkha middle route—lies over 3,000 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東界博囉布林哈蘇多歡，西界庫勒薩雅孛郭圖額金嶺，南界齊齊爾里克，北界齊老圖河。

translations.literal: On the east it borders Boroblin Khasu Dohon; on the west, Kule Sayabogdo Ergin Ridge; on the south, Chichirlik; on the north, the Qilaotu River.
translations.idiomatic: It is bounded on the east by Boroblin Khasu Dohon, on the west by Kule Sayabogdo Ergin Ridge, on the south by Chichirlik, and on the north by the Qilaotu River.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十七世孫偉徵諾顏諾諾和有子五：長阿巴和，為土謝圖汗部祖；

translations.literal: Weizheng Noyan Nonoho, seventeenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, had five sons: the eldest Abakhe was ancestor of the Tüshiyetu Khan division;
translations.idiomatic: Weizheng Noyan Nonoho, a seventeenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, had five sons: the eldest Abakhe founded the Tüshiyetu Khan line;

sentences.zh: 次塔爾呢，無嗣；

translations.literal: the second Tarne, no heirs;
translations.idiomatic: the second Tarne left no heirs;

sentences.zh: 次圖蒙肯；

translations.literal: the third Tumunke;
translations.idiomatic: the third Tumunke;

sentences.zh: 次巴賚。

translations.literal: the fourth Bale.
translations.idiomatic: the fourth Bale.

sentences.zh: 今賽因諾顏部二十四扎薩克，自厄魯特二旗外，皆其裔。

translations.literal: Today's twenty-four jasaghs of the Sayin Noyan division, apart from the two Oirat banners, are all his descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Today's twenty-four Sayin Noyan jasaghs, except two Oirat banners, are all his descendants.

sentences.zh: 圖蒙肯子十三：長卓特巴，號車臣諾顏，為扎薩克輔國公托多額爾德尼、諾爾布紮布、台吉圖巴三旗祖；

translations.literal: Tumunke had thirteen sons: the eldest Chotba, titled Sechen Noyan, was ancestor of Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Todo Erdeni, Norbujab, and Taiji Tuba's three banners;
translations.idiomatic: Tumunke had thirteen sons: the eldest Chotba, titled Sechen Noyan, founded three banners including Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Todo Erdeni's;

sentences.zh: 次丹津喇嘛，號諾捫汗，為扎薩克親王善巴、輔國公旺舒克、車淩達什、台吉齊旺多爾濟、素達尼、多爾濟六旗祖；

translations.literal: the second Danjin Lama, titled Nomun Khan, was ancestor of Jasagh Qinwang Shanba, Assistant State Guardian Duke Wangshuk, Chörindashi, Taiji Qiwan Dorji, Sudani, and Dorji's six banners;
translations.idiomatic: the second Danjin Lama, titled Nomun Khan, founded six banners including Jasagh Qinwang Shanba's;

sentences.zh: 次車淩，次羅雅克，皆無嗣；

translations.literal: the third Chörin and fourth Loyak, both without heirs;
translations.idiomatic: the third Chörin and fourth Loyak left no heirs;

sentences.zh: 次濟雅克，號偉徵諾顏，為扎薩克輔國公阿玉什一旗祖；

translations.literal: the fifth Jiyak, titled Weizheng Noyan, was ancestor of Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Ayushi's one banner;
translations.idiomatic: the fifth Jiyak, titled Weizheng Noyan, founded Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Ayushi's banner;

sentences.zh: 次紮木本，其番不列扎薩克；

translations.literal: the sixth Jamuben, his line not listed among jasaghs;
translations.idiomatic: the sixth Jamuben's line is not listed among jasaghs;

sentences.zh: 次察斯喜布，號昆都棱，為扎薩克台吉伊達木、納木紮勒二旗祖；

translations.literal: the seventh Choshib, titled Qondulen, was ancestor of Jasagh Taiji Idam and Namjal's two banners;
translations.idiomatic: the seventh Choshib, titled Qondulen, founded two banners including Jasagh Taiji Idam's;

sentences.zh: 次丹津，號班珠爾，為扎薩克超勇親王策棱子親王成袞紮布、郡王車布登紮布二旗祖；

translations.literal: the eighth Danjin, titled Panchen, was ancestor of Jasagh Chaoyong Qinwang Tsewang's son Qinwang Chenggunjab and Junwang Chobdondjab's two banners;
translations.idiomatic: the eighth Danjin, titled Panchen, founded two banners including Chaoyong Qinwang Tsewang's son Chenggunjab's;

sentences.zh: 次畢瑪裏吉哩諦，號巴圖爾額爾德尼諾顏，為扎薩克台吉丹津額爾德尼一旗祖；

translations.literal: the ninth Bimarijit, titled Batu Erdeni Noyan, was ancestor of Jasagh Taiji Danjin Erdeni's one banner;
translations.idiomatic: the ninth Bimarijit, titled Batu Erdeni Noyan, founded Jasagh Taiji Danjin Erdeni's banner;

sentences.zh: 次錫納喇克薩特，號琿台吉，為扎薩克台吉阿哩雅、薩木濟特二旗祖；

translations.literal: the tenth Shinaraqsat, titled Khung-taiji, was ancestor of Jasagh Taiji Aliya and Samjit's two banners;
translations.idiomatic: the tenth Shinaraqsat, titled Khung-taiji, founded two banners including Jasagh Taiji Aliya's;

sentences.zh: 次桑噶爾紮，號伊勒登和碩齊，為扎薩克台吉沙嚕伊勒都齊一旗祖；

translations.literal: the eleventh Sanggarja, titled Ilden Hoshoi, was ancestor of Jasagh Taiji Shalu Ilduqi's one banner;
translations.idiomatic: the eleventh Sanggarja, titled Ilden Hoshoi, founded Jasagh Taiji Shalu Ilduqi's banner;

sentences.zh: 次扣肯，號巴扎爾，為扎薩克台吉濟納彌達一旗祖；

translations.literal: the twelfth Koken, titled Bajzar, was ancestor of Jasagh Taiji Jinamida's one banner;
translations.idiomatic: the twelfth Koken, titled Bajzar, founded Jasagh Taiji Jinamida's banner;

sentences.zh: 次袞布，號昆都倫博碩克圖，授扎薩克郡王，今襲貝勒，其曾孫額墨根，授扎薩克台吉，又自為一旗。

translations.literal: the thirteenth Günbo, titled Qondulen Boshigt, was granted Jasagh Junwang, now inheriting beile; his great-grandson Emegen was granted Jasagh Taiji and formed another banner.
translations.idiomatic: the thirteenth Günbo, titled Qondulen Boshigt, received jasagh junwang, now inheriting beile; his great-grandson Emegen received jasagh taiji and formed another banner.

sentences.zh: 巴賚子一，曰噶爾瑪，為扎薩克鎮國公素泰伊勒登一旗祖。

translations.literal: Bale had one son, Garma, ancestor of Jasagh State Guardian Duke Sutai Ilden's one banner.
translations.idiomatic: Bale's son Garma founded Jasagh State Guardian Duke Sutai Ilden's banner.

sentences.zh: 初，喀爾喀有所謂紅教者，與黃教爭，圖蒙肯尊黃教，為之護持。

translations.literal: Initially Khalkha had so-called Red Sect followers who contended with the Yellow Sect; Tumunke honored the Yellow Sect and protected it.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha's Red Sect contended with the Yellow Sect; Tumunke honored and protected the Yellow Sect.

sentences.zh: 唐古特達賴喇嘛賢之，授賽因諾顏號，令所部奉之視三汗。

translations.literal: The Tangut Dalai Lama admired this and granted the Sayin Noyan title, ordering his division to honor it like the Three Khans.
translations.idiomatic: The Dalai Lama admired this, granted the Sayin Noyan title, and ordered his division to honor it like the Three Khans.

sentences.zh: 圖蒙肯卒，次子丹津喇嘛復受諾捫汗號於達賴喇嘛。

translations.literal: Tumunke died; his second son Danjin Lama again received the Nomun Khan title from the Dalai Lama.
translations.idiomatic: After Tumunke died, his second son Danjin Lama again received the Nomun Khan title from the Dalai Lama.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，遣使通貢，優賚遣歸。

translations.literal: In Chongde 3, envoys were sent to establish tribute; generous gifts were bestowed and they were sent home.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3, envoys established tribute relations and returned with generous gifts.

sentences.zh: 五年，賜敕獎諭。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an imperial letter of praise was granted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, an imperial letter of praise was granted.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，以偕其旗土謝圖汗袞布等合兵援蘇尼特部叛人騰機思，詰責之。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 4, for joining Tüshiyetu Khan Günbo and others in aiding Sunid rebel Tenggis, rebuke was issued.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4, for joining Tüshiyetu Khan Günbo in aiding Sunid rebel Tenggis, they were rebuked.

sentences.zh: 七年，遣子額爾德尼諾木齊上書乞好，詔偕袞布約誓定議。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, his son Erdeni Nomchi sent a letter seeking friendship; an edict ordered joint oath and agreement with Günbo.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, his son Erdeni Nomchi sought friendship; an edict ordered a joint oath with Günbo.

sentences.zh: 十一年，額爾德尼諾木齊復奉表，諭曰：「爾奏言喀爾喀左翼四旗皆爾統攝，凡有敕諭，罔弗遵行。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Erdeni Nomchi again submitted a memorial; an edict stated: "You report that Khalkha's four left-wing banners are all under your command and all edicts are obeyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Erdeni Nomchi submitted again; an edict stated: "You report that Khalkha's four left-wing banners obey your command and all edicts.

sentences.zh: 今即如所請，可速飭爾部長遣子來歸。

translations.literal: Now as requested, quickly order your chiefs to send sons to submit.
translations.idiomatic: As requested, quickly order your chiefs to send sons to court.

sentences.zh: 有不遵者，即行奏聞。」

translations.literal: Any who disobey, report at once."
translations.idiomatic: Report any who disobey at once."

sentences.zh: 十二年，偕袞布等各遣子弟來朝，詔宥前罪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, together with Günbo and others each sent sons and younger kinsmen to court; an edict pardoned past offenses.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, with Günbo and others they sent sons to court; past offenses were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 尋設八扎薩克，命丹津喇嘛領左翼扎薩克之一，歲貢九白如三汗例。

translations.literal: Soon eight jasaghs were established; Danjin Lama was ordered to lead one left-wing jasagh; annual Nine Whites tribute followed the Three Khans' precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Soon eight jasaghs were established; Danjin Lama led one left-wing jasagh with Nine Whites tribute like the Three Khans.

sentences.zh: 十八年，賜「遵文順義」號，給之印。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, the title "Observant of Culture and Righteous" was granted with a seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, the title "Observant of Culture and Righteous" was granted with a seal.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，詔所屬毋越界遊牧。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 3, an edict forbade followers from pasturing across borders.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3, followers were forbidden from pasturing across borders.

sentences.zh: 丹津喇嘛卒，子塔斯希布襲。

translations.literal: Danjin Lama died; his son Taskhib succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: Danjin Lama died; his son Taskhib succeeded.

sentences.zh: 塔斯希布卒，子善巴襲，賜信順額爾克岱青號。

translations.literal: Taskhib died; his son Shanba succeeded and received the title Xinsun Erke Daiqing.
translations.idiomatic: Taskhib died; his son Shanba succeeded and received the title Xinsun Erke Daiqing.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹掠喀爾喀，善巴率屬來歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Galdan raided Khalkha; Shanba led followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, Galdan raided Khalkha; Shanba led his people to submit.

sentences.zh: 詔附牧烏喇特諸部界。

translations.literal: An edict ordered them to pasture near Urad borders.
translations.idiomatic: They were ordered to pasture near Urad borders.

sentences.zh: 三十年，駕幸多倫諾爾會閱，詔封善巴等王、台吉有差，各授扎薩克，編所屬佐領，隸土謝圖汗部。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, at the Dolon Nor review, Shanba and others were enfeoffed as princes and taiji at various ranks, each granted jasagh, companies organized, subordinate to the Tüshiyetu Khan division.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year, at the Dolon Nor review, Shanba and others were enfeoffed, granted jasagh, companies organized, under the Tüshiyetu Khan division.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，善巴從弟策棱來歸。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Shanba's cousin Tsewang came to submit.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, Shanba's cousin Tsewang came to submit.

sentences.zh: 策棱者，圖蒙肯第八子丹津之孫，台吉納木紮勒之子，後授固倫額駙和碩超勇親王、定邊左副將軍兼稱喀爾喀大扎薩克者也。

translations.literal: Tsewang was the grandson of Tumunke's eighth son Danjin, son of Taiji Namjal; later granted Gurun Efu Hoshoi Chaoyong Qinwang, Frontier Left Deputy General, also called Khalkha Grand Jasagh.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang was grandson of Tumunke's eighth son Danjin and son of Taiji Namjal; later he became Gurun Efu Chaoyong Qinwang, Frontier Left Deputy General, and Khalkha Grand Jasagh.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，詔善巴等各歸舊牧。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, an edict ordered Shanba and others back to old pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, Shanba and others were ordered back to old pastures.

sentences.zh: 五十六年，選兵赴阿爾台軍偵禦策妄阿喇布坦。

translations.literal: In the fifty-sixth year, soldiers were selected for the Altai army to scout Tsewang Arabtan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifty-sixth year, soldiers joined the Altai army scouting Tsewang Arabtan.

sentences.zh: 雍正三年，上以所部系出賽因諾顏，較三汗裔繁衍，而額駙策棱自簡任副將軍，勞績懋著，命率近族親王達什敦多布，貝勒納木紮勒、齊素嚨，貝子策旺諾爾布，輔國公阿努哩敦多布、額琳沁、紮木禪旺紮勒，台吉格木丕勒、齊旺、錫喇劄布、達爾濟雅、根敦、車布登、巴朗、延達博第、呢瑪特、克什、諾爾布紮布，凡十九扎薩克，別為一部，以其祖賽因諾顏號冠之，稱喀爾喀中路，不復隸土謝圖汗部。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 3, because the division descended from Sayin Noyan and was more populous than the Three Khans' lines, and Efu Tsewang since appointment as deputy general had shown outstanding merit, he was ordered to lead nineteen jasaghs including near kin Qinwang Dashdondob, Beile Namjal and Qisuhu, Beizi Tsewang Norbu, Assistant State Guardian Dukes Anulidondob, Erenchen, Jamchen Wangjal, and taiji—forming a separate division crowned with the ancestral Sayin Noyan title, called Khalkha middle route, no longer subordinate to Tüshiyetu Khan.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 3, because the division descended from Sayin Noyan and Efu Tsewang had distinguished himself as deputy general, nineteen jasaghs were separated as the Khalkha middle route under the Sayin Noyan title, no longer under Tüshiyetu Khan.

sentences.zh: 喀爾喀有四部自此始。

translations.literal: Khalkha's four divisions began from this.
translations.idiomatic: Khalkha's four divisions date from this.

sentences.zh: 九年，所部兵隨大軍剿噶爾丹策棱，擊其眾克爾森齊老及額爾德尼昭，大敗之。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, division troops joined the great army against Galdan Tseren, defeating his forces at Kersen Qilaotu and Erdeni Juu.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, division troops joined the army against Galdan Tseren and defeated his forces at Kersen Qilaotu and Erdeni Juu.

sentences.zh: 十三年，撤還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，選兵赴鄂爾坤防秋。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 1, soldiers were selected for autumn defense at the Ergün.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1, soldiers were sent for autumn defense at the Ergün.

sentences.zh: 六年，參贊大臣副都統慶泰察閱防秋兵於桑錦托羅海。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Assistant Commissioner Vice Commander Qingtai inspected autumn-defense troops at Sangjin Tuolohai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Assistant Commissioner Qingtai inspected autumn-defense troops at Sangjin Tuolohai.

sentences.zh: 十三年，選駝五百運歸化城米赴塔密爾軍營。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, five hundred camels were selected to transport Guihuacheng grain to the Tamir camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, five hundred camels carried Guihuacheng grain to the Tamir camp.

sentences.zh: 尋調所部兵二千駐防錫喇烏蘇。

translations.literal: Soon two thousand division soldiers were posted at Xila Usu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon two thousand division soldiers garrisoned Xila Usu.

sentences.zh: 十九年，移塔密爾軍營於是部中前旗之烏裏雅蘇台，以是部兵分駐紮布堪。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, the Tamir camp was moved to Urga in this division's middle-front banner; division troops were posted separately at Zhabkan.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, the Tamir camp moved to Urga in the middle-front banner; division troops were posted at Zhabkan.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，隨大軍剿達瓦齊，平之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, they joined the great army suppressing Dawachi and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year, they joined the army suppressing Dawachi and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，設烏裏雅蘇台至烏魯木齊台站，留侍衛四員，餘撤之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, relay stations from Urga to Ürümqi were established; four bodyguards were retained, the rest withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year, relay stations from Urga to Ürümqi were established; four bodyguards remained, the rest withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 先是喀爾喀分設中路時，但以賽因諾顏名其部，以示別於三汗，未議襲號。

translations.literal: When Khalkha's middle route was first separated, only the Sayin Noyan name was used to distinguish from the Three Khans; inheritable title was not yet deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: When the middle route was first separated, only the Sayin Noyan name distinguished it from the Three Khans; an inheritable title was not yet settled.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，親王成袞紮布奏所部來歸。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, Qinwang Chenggunjab memorialized on his division's submission.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, Qinwang Chenggunjab reported on his division's submission.

sentences.zh: 初，親王善巴為同族長，又世掌丹津喇嘛所遺印，請視三汗例，以善巴曾孫親王諾爾布紮布襲賽因諾顏號。

translations.literal: Initially Qinwang Shanba was clan elder and held Danjin Lama's inherited seal; requesting precedent like the Three Khans, Shanba's great-grandson Qinwang Norbujab was to inherit the Sayin Noyan title.
translations.idiomatic: Qinwang Shanba was clan elder and held Danjin Lama's seal; he asked that great-grandson Qinwang Norbujab inherit the Sayin Noyan title like the Three Khans.

sentences.zh: 詔允其請，俾與土謝圖汗、車臣汗、扎薩克圖汗均世襲罔替。

translations.literal: An edict granted the request, making it hereditary in perpetuity like Tüshiyetu Khan, Sechen Khan, and Jasaghtu Khan.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted, making the title hereditary in perpetuity like the Three Khans.

sentences.zh: 蕩平准部之役，成袞紮布長子額爾克沙喇以剿叛賊巴雅爾功，封輔國公。

translations.literal: In the Zunghar pacification campaign, Chenggunjab's eldest son Erke Shara for suppressing rebel Bayar was enfeoffed Assistant State Guardian Duke.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zunghar campaign, Chenggunjab's son Erke Shara was enfeoffed Assistant State Guardian Duke for suppressing rebel Bayar.

sentences.zh: 策淩次子輔國公車布登紮布積俘准部宰桑庫克辛等、平達瓦齊、誅賊固爾班和卓、征哈薩克功，曆晉貝子、貝勒、郡王至親王品級。

translations.literal: Tsewang's second son Assistant State Guardian Duke Chobdondjab accumulated merits capturing Zunghar zaisang Kukshin, pacifying Dawachi, executing rebel Gulban Khoja, and campaigning against Kazakhs, rising through beizi, beile, junwang to qinwang rank.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewang's son Chobdondjab rose to qinwang through merits capturing Zunghar zaisang, pacifying Dawachi, executing Gulban Khoja, and campaigning against Kazakhs.

sentences.zh: 貝子車木楚克紮布積捕獲烏梁海宰桑、復設台站及招降阿勒泰淖爾烏梁海功，曆晉封至郡王。

translations.literal: Beizi Chemchukjab accumulated merits capturing Uriankhai zaisang, restoring relay stations, and receiving Altai Nuur Uriankhai surrender, rising to junwang.
translations.idiomatic: Beizi Chemchukjab rose to junwang for capturing Uriankhai zaisang, restoring relay stations, and receiving Altai Nuur Uriankhai surrender.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克一等台吉三都克紮布以協濟軍需，復予襲輔國公。

translations.literal: Jasagh First-Class Taiji Sandukjab for aiding military supplies was again granted inheritance of Assistant State Guardian Duke.
translations.idiomatic: Jasagh First-Class Taiji Sandukjab was granted inheritance of Assistant State Guardian Duke for aiding military supplies.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克一等台吉達什額以得叛賊布庫察罕功，予公品級。

translations.literal: Jasagh First-Class Taiji Dash'e for capturing rebel Buku Chahan received gong rank.
translations.idiomatic: Jasagh First-Class Taiji Dash'e received gong rank for capturing rebel Buku Chahan.

sentences.zh: 而貝子羅布藏車鄰以死事烏魯木齊，晉其子貝勒。

translations.literal: Beizi Lobzang Cholin died at Ürümqi; his son was promoted to beile.
translations.idiomatic: Beizi Lobzang Cholin died at Ürümqi; his son was promoted to beile.

sentences.zh: 初，所部十九旗，後增三旗，附額魯特二旗。

translations.literal: Initially nineteen banners, later three added, with two attached Oirat banners.
translations.idiomatic: The division began with nineteen banners, later adding three plus two attached Oirat banners.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克二十有四，盟於齊齊爾里克，設正副盟長各一，副將軍、參贊各一。

translations.literal: Twenty-four jasaghs leagued at Chichirlik, with one chief and one deputy league head, one deputy general and one assistant commissioner each.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-four jasaghs leagued at Chichirlik with chief and deputy league heads, deputy general, and assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 爵三十有三：扎薩克和碩親王二；

translations.literal: Titles number thirty-three: two Jasagh Hoshoi Qinwang;
translations.idiomatic: Titles number thirty-three: two Jasagh Hoshoi Qinwang;

sentences.zh: 附固山貝子一，由貝勒降襲；

translations.literal: one attached Gushan Beizi, demoted from beile;
translations.idiomatic: one attached Gushan Beizi, demoted from beile;

sentences.zh: 鎮國公一，由貝子降襲；

translations.literal: one State Guardian Duke, demoted from beizi;
translations.idiomatic: one State Guardian Duke, demoted from beizi;

sentences.zh: 輔國公二；

translations.literal: two Assistant State Guardian Dukes;
translations.idiomatic: two Assistant State Guardian Dukes;

sentences.zh: 公品級一等台吉一；

translations.literal: one gong-rank First-Class Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: one gong-rank First-Class Taiji;

sentences.zh: 公品級三等台吉一；

translations.literal: one gong-rank Third-Class Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: one gong-rank Third-Class Taiji;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅郡王二，一由鎮國公晉封；

translations.literal: two Jasagh Duoluo Junwang, one promoted from State Guardian Duke;
translations.idiomatic: two Jasagh Duoluo Junwang, one promoted from State Guardian Duke;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克多羅貝勒二，一由郡王降襲，一由鎮國公晉襲；

translations.literal: two Jasagh Duoluo Beile, one demoted from junwang, one promoted from State Guardian Duke;
translations.idiomatic: two Jasagh Duoluo Beile, one demoted from junwang, one promoted from State Guardian Duke;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克鎮國公一，由扎薩克台吉晉襲；

translations.literal: one Jasagh State Guardian Duke, promoted from Jasagh Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: one Jasagh State Guardian Duke, promoted from Jasagh Taiji;

sentences.zh: 附輔國公一；

translations.literal: one attached Assistant State Guardian Duke;
translations.idiomatic: one attached Assistant State Guardian Duke;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克輔國公五，一由扎薩克台吉晉襲；

translations.literal: five Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Dukes, one promoted from Jasagh Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: five Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Dukes, one promoted from Jasagh Taiji;

sentences.zh: 公品級扎薩克一等台吉一；

translations.literal: one gong-rank Jasagh First-Class Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: one gong-rank Jasagh First-Class Taiji;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克一等台吉九；

translations.literal: nine Jasagh First-Class Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: nine Jasagh First-Class Taiji;

sentences.zh: 附輔國公一；

translations.literal: one attached Assistant State Guardian Duke;
translations.idiomatic: one attached Assistant State Guardian Duke;

sentences.zh: 公品級三等台吉一；

translations.literal: one gong-rank Third-Class Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: one gong-rank Third-Class Taiji;

sentences.zh: 厄魯特扎薩克固山貝子二，一由郡王降襲，一由輔國公晉襲。

translations.literal: two Oirat Jasagh Gushan Beizi, one demoted from junwang, one promoted from Assistant State Guardian Duke.
translations.idiomatic: two Oirat Jasagh Gushan Beizi, one demoted from junwang, one promoted from Assistant State Guardian Duke.

sentences.zh: 三十八年九月，以賽盟郡王車布登紮布為烏里雅蘇臺參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the thirty-eighth year, Sayin league Junwang Chobdondjab was appointed Urga assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the thirty-eighth year, Sayin league Junwang Chobdondjab became Urga assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 四十二年十月，賽盟郡王車布登紮布率本部王、公、扎薩克、台吉等進大行皇帝齋醮馬駝，溫諭卻之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the forty-second year, Sayin league Junwang Chobdondjab led division princes, gong, jasaghs, and taiji presenting horses and camels for the late emperor's memorial rites; warm edicts declined.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the forty-second year, Chobdondjab led princes offering horses and camels for the late emperor's rites; warm edicts declined.

sentences.zh: 四十五年六月，以賽音諾顏部落佔據土謝圖汗遊牧，諭博清額查明，毋使侵佔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the forty-fifth year, because the Sayin Noyan division occupied Tüshiyetu Khan pastures, Buoqing'e was ordered to investigate and prevent encroachment.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year, because Sayin Noyan occupied Tüshiyetu Khan pastures, Buoqing'e was told to investigate and stop encroachment.

sentences.zh: 十月，定賽音諾顏、土謝圖汗兩部界址。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, borders between Sayin Noyan and Tüshiyetu Khan divisions were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, borders between Sayin Noyan and Tüshiyetu Khan were fixed.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶四年，是部親王御前大臣拉旺多爾濟等請調集本盟兵馬助剿教匪，溫旨止之，並命理籓院傳知蒙古各盟，停其預備。

translations.literal: In Jiaqing 4, this division's Qinwang imperial attendant Lawang Dorji and others requested mobilizing league troops to aid suppression of sect rebels; warm edicts stopped it and ordered the Lifan Yuan to notify all Mongol leagues to halt preparations.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 4, Qinwang Lawang Dorji's request to mobilize troops against sect rebels was declined; all Mongol leagues were told to halt preparations.

sentences.zh: 七年八月，定喀爾喀賽因諾顏、扎薩克圖汗二部事務在烏里雅蘇臺會集，與定邊左副將軍一同辦理。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the seventh year, Sayin Noyan and Jasaghtu Khan division affairs were fixed to assemble at Urga jointly with the Frontier Left Deputy General.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Jiaqing 7, Sayin Noyan and Jasaghtu Khan affairs were fixed to assemble at Urga with the Frontier Left Deputy General.

sentences.zh: 八年，以是部齊巴克紮布旗容留種地民人，命交烏里雅蘇臺參贊大臣永保辦理。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, because this division's Chibakjab banner harbored farming civilians, the matter was referred to Urga Assistant Commissioner Yongbao.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, because Chibakjab's banner harbored farming civilians, Urga Assistant Commissioner Yongbao took the case.

sentences.zh: 十二年五月，烏里雅蘇臺參贊大臣薩木丕勒多爾濟卒，以綸布多爾濟代之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the twelfth year, Urga Assistant Commissioner Sambeldorji died; Lundorji replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the twelfth year, Assistant Commissioner Sambeldorji died and Lundorji replaced him.

sentences.zh: 道光三年七月，以賽音諾顏盟長德木楚克紮布等於大路搶劫官人財物不能捕緝，詔嚴議。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of Daoguang 3, because Sayin Noyan league chief Demchukjab and others could not capture bandits who robbed officials on the main road, severe discipline was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Daoguang 3, league chief Demchukjab was severely disciplined for failing to capture highway robbers.

sentences.zh: 十月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍果勒豐阿奏：「烏裏雅蘇台地方，請准令商民等每年馱運茶七千餘箱赴古城兌換米麵。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, Urga General Golefeng'a memorialized: "At Urga, merchants should be permitted to transport over seven thousand boxes of tea yearly to Gucheng to exchange for grain and flour.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, Urga General Golefeng'a requested: "Permitting merchants to transport over seven thousand boxes of tea yearly to Gucheng for grain and flour.

sentences.zh: 如不敷，令湊買雜貨，仍照例給發印票，不准另往他處。」

translations.literal: If insufficient, allow purchasing miscellaneous goods, still issuing passes as usual, not permitting travel elsewhere."
translations.idiomatic: If insufficient, allow buying other goods with passes as usual, not permitting travel elsewhere."

sentences.zh: 六年十一月，回疆軍興，賽音諾顏、扎薩克圖汗兩盟王、公、扎薩克等輸駝只助軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the sixth year, with Xinjiang war underway, Sayin Noyan and Jasaghtu Khan leagues' princes and jasaghs contributed camels for the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Daoguang 6, Sayin Noyan and Jasaghtu Khan princes contributed camels for the Xinjiang war.

sentences.zh: 七年十月，綸布多爾濟調庫倫辦事大臣。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the seventh year, Lundorji was transferred as Khüree commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of Daoguang 7, Lundorji became Khüree commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十二月，以車林多爾濟為烏裏雅蘇台參贊大臣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Chörindorji was appointed Urga assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Chörindorji became Urga assistant commissioner.

sentences.zh: 十八年，以哈薩克闌入卡倫，命車林多爾濟統賽、紮兩盟，杜爾伯特等蒙兵逐之。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, because Kazakhs intruded at pickets, Chörindorji was ordered to command Sayin and Jasagh leagues and Dorbed Mongol troops to expel them.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 18, Chörindorji commanded Sayin and Jasaghtu leagues and Dorbed troops to expel intruding Kazakhs.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月，給驅逐哈薩克之賽、紮兩盟蒙古官兵俸賞行裝銀。

translations.literal: In the first month of the nineteenth year, pay, rewards, and travel silver were granted to Sayin and Jasagh league Mongol troops who expelled Kazakhs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Daoguang 19, pay, rewards, and travel silver were granted to troops who expelled Kazakhs.

sentences.zh: 四月，命車林多爾濟調兵驅逐復入烏梁海之哈薩克。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Chörindorji was ordered to mobilize troops to expel Kazakhs re-entering Uriankhai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Chörindorji was ordered to expel Kazakhs re-entering Uriankhai.

sentences.zh: 八月，以驅逐哈薩克妥速，賚車林多爾濟親王俸一年。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, for promptly expelling Kazakhs, Chörindorji was bestowed one year's qinwang salary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Chörindorji received one year's qinwang salary for promptly expelling Kazakhs.

sentences.zh: 二十五年二月，賽盟郡王圖克濟紮布以不赴軍營，革副將軍，阿爾塔什達代之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-fifth year, Sayin league Junwang Tukijab for failing to go to camp was dismissed as deputy general; Altashda replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Daoguang 25, Junwang Tukijab was dismissed as deputy general for failing to go to camp; Altashda replaced him.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，賽、紮兩盟王、公、扎薩克等請捐助軍需，溫旨卻之。

translations.literal: In Xianfeng 3, Sayin and Jasaghtu league princes requested military donations; warm edicts declined.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3, Sayin and Jasaghtu princes offered military donations; warm edicts declined.

sentences.zh: 十一年，阿爾塔什達調庫倫，以車林敦多布代之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year, Altashda was transferred to Khüree; Chörindondob replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 11, Altashda went to Khüree; Chörindondob replaced him.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，回匪陷烏魯木齊各城，調是部兵援古城，竟無功。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi 3, Muslim rebels took Ürümqi cities; this division's troops were sent to aid Gucheng without success.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3, rebels took Ürümqi; division troops sent to aid Gucheng failed.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，李雲麟奏：「與明誼等會商，擬將扎薩克圖汗部、賽音諾顏兩部額兵全行派出，共一千八百名。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year, Li Yunlin memorialized: "With Mingyi and others we propose dispatching all quota troops of Jasaghtu Khan and Sayin Noyan divisions, 1,800 in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Tongzhi 5, Li Yunlin proposed: "Dispatching all 1,800 quota troops of Jasaghtu Khan and Sayin Noyan divisions.

sentences.zh: 其本愛曼操防之兵，徐為佈置。

translations.literal: Troops for home-banner defense would be arranged gradually.
translations.idiomatic: Home-banner defense troops would be arranged gradually.

sentences.zh: 旋因察漢烏蘇卡倫聞警，當與麟興等熟商。

translations.literal: Soon because Chaqan Usu picket reported alarm, consultation with Linxing and others was needed.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Chaqan Usu picket reported alarm; consultation with Linxing was needed.

sentences.zh: 北路既有警報，擬每愛曼仍留五百兵備防本境。

translations.literal: With northern-route alarm, each banner was to retain five hundred soldiers for local defense.
translations.idiomatic: With northern-route alarm, each banner would retain five hundred soldiers for local defense.

sentences.zh: 復商之車林敦多布，轉傳各盟長，將西兩盟額兵以外之壯丁，每盟再挑五百名，於八月派齊，隨後繼發。」

translations.literal: Consulting Chörindondob, league chiefs were told to select five hundred strong men per league beyond quota troops, ready by the eighth month with follow-up dispatch."
translations.idiomatic: Chörindondob was told to have league chiefs select five hundred extra men per league by the eighth month."

sentences.zh: 並謂北路寇至不能禦，差務不暇給，保貝勒晉丕勒多爾濟遇事勇敢，其才為喀爾喀四部王公之冠。

translations.literal: He also recommended Beile Jinbil Dorji as brave in emergencies, the most capable of Khalkha princes.
translations.idiomatic: He recommended Beile Jinbil Dorji as the most capable Khalkha prince.

sentences.zh: 適車林敦多布乞病，詔即以晉丕勒多爾濟代之。

translations.literal: As Chörindondob requested leave for illness, Jinbil Dorji was ordered to replace him.
translations.idiomatic: Chörindondob took sick leave; Jinbil Dorji replaced him.

sentences.zh: 李雲麟尋率賽、紮兩盟兵西進。

translations.literal: Li Yunlin soon led Sayin and Jasaghtu league troops west.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yunlin soon led Sayin and Jasaghtu troops west.

sentences.zh: 十一月，至呼圖古蘭台，紮盟兵變，賽盟兵亦潰，李雲麟自奏回烏城，詔嚴責之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, at Hutugulan station Jasaghtu troops mutinied and Sayin troops also fled; Li Yunlin reported returning to Urga; severe rebuke was ordered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, Jasaghtu troops mutinied at Hutugulan and Sayin troops fled; Li Yunlin withdrew to Urga and was severely rebuked.

sentences.zh: 七年，晉丕勒多爾濟倡捐布倫托海新城經費，偕郡王桑噶西哩等捐銀二萬五千兩有奇。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Jinbil Dorji initiated donation for Burultokhai New City funds; with Junwang Sanggasir and others donated over 25,000 taels.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 7, Jinbil Dorji initiated Burultokhai New City donations; with Junwang Sanggasir he gave over 25,000 taels.

sentences.zh: 予晉丕勒多爾濟王銜，餘給獎有差。

translations.literal: Jinbil Dorji received wang rank; others graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbil Dorji received wang rank; others received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 九年二月，肅州回匪東竄，擾是部推河以西額爾德尼班第達呼圖克圖遊牧，蒙兵潰于哈爾呢敦。

translations.literal: In the second month of the ninth year, Suzhou Muslim rebels fled east, disturbing this division's pastures west of the Tui River where Erdeni Bandida Khutukhtu ranged; Mongol troops fled at Harnidon.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Tongzhi 9, Suzhou rebels fled east and raided Erdeni Bandida Khutukhtu's pastures west of the Tui River; Mongol troops broke at Harnidon.

sentences.zh: 閏十月己巳，庫倫辦事大臣張廷岳等奏：「回匪竄偪烏城，福濟、榮全督蒙兵二百在城防守，參贊大臣晉丕勒多爾濟督索倫、滿、漢兵五百迎擊，駐頭台。

translations.literal: On intercalary tenth month jisi, Khüree Commissioner Zhang Tingyue memorialized: "Rebels threaten Urga; Fujì and Rongquan command two hundred Mongol troops in city defense; Assistant Commissioner Jinbil Dorji commands five hundred Solon, Manchu, and Han troops to intercept, encamped at the first station.
translations.idiomatic: On intercalary tenth month jisi, Zhang Tingyue reported: "Rebels threaten Urga; Fujì and Rongquan held the city with two hundred Mongols; Jinbil Dorji led five hundred Solon, Manchu, and Han troops to intercept at the first station.

sentences.zh: 竄匪三千現已抵二台。」

translations.literal: Three thousand rebels have now reached the second station."
translations.idiomatic: Three thousand rebels had reached the second station."

sentences.zh: 辛未，烏里雅蘇臺將軍福濟等奏：「回匪踞博克多山、推河口、額爾德尼昭等處。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Urga General Fujì memorialized: "Rebels occupy Bokdo Mountain, Tui River mouth, Erdeni Juu, and other places.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Fujì reported: "Rebels occupy Bokdo Mountain, the Tui River mouth, and Erdeni Juu.

sentences.zh: 十月九日，竄至第十一烏特台，文報不通，南台蒙兵聞警先遁。」

translations.literal: On the ninth of the tenth month, rebels reached the eleventh Wute station; dispatches were cut; south-station Mongol troops fled at the alarm."
translations.idiomatic: On the ninth of the tenth month, rebels reached the eleventh Wute station; dispatches were cut and south-station Mongols fled."

sentences.zh: 十一月戊申，福濟及參贊大臣榮全奏：「十月九日，賊千餘人由東南至西南山溝來撲東西南三門，東溝又來賊數千。

translations.literal: On the twenty-eighth of the eleventh month wushen, Fujì and Assistant Commissioner Rongquan memorialized: "On the ninth of the tenth month, over a thousand bandits from the southeast ravine attacked the east, south, and west gates; thousands more came from the east ravine.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-eighth of the eleventh month, Fujì and Rongquan reported: "On the ninth of the tenth month over a thousand bandits attacked three gates and thousands more came from the east ravine.

sentences.zh: 初更，賊四面放火，毀柵而登，城池失陷。

translations.literal: At the first watch, bandits set fires on all sides, broke the palisade and entered; the city fell.
translations.idiomatic: At the first watch, bandits set fires on all sides, broke the palisade, and took the city.

sentences.zh: 二十三日，賊由西南竄去。

translations.literal: On the twenty-third, bandits fled southwest.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-third, bandits fled southwest.

sentences.zh: 福濟遇救尚存，榮全奔向西北，於閏十月四日折回，定邊將軍印信遺失，榮全親兵護出伊犁將軍印信，暫時借用。」

translations.literal: Fujì was rescued alive; Rongquan fled northwest and returned on the fourth of the intercalary tenth month; the Frontier General's seal was lost; Rongquan's guards brought out the Ili General's seal for temporary use."
translations.idiomatic: Fujì was rescued; Rongquan fled northwest and returned on the fourth of the intercalary tenth month; the Frontier General's seal was lost and the Ili General's seal was used temporarily."

sentences.zh: 命福濟、榮全革職留任，諭杜嘎爾統察哈爾馬隊及已調吉林、黑龍江官兵赴烏城進剿。

translations.literal: Fujì and Rongquan were dismissed but kept in post; Dugar was ordered to lead Chahar cavalry and Jilin and Heilongjiang troops to Urga for suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Fujì and Rongquan were dismissed but kept in post; Dugar was ordered to lead Chahar, Jilin, and Heilongjiang troops to Urga.

sentences.zh: 尋回匪西竄金山卡倫，晉丕勒多爾濟回烏里雅蘇臺。

translations.literal: Soon rebels fled west to the Jinshan picket; Jinbil Dorji returned to Urga.
translations.idiomatic: Soon rebels fled west to the Jinshan picket; Jinbil Dorji returned to Urga.

sentences.zh: 諭整飭台站，疏通道路。

translations.literal: Relay stations were ordered rectified and roads cleared.
translations.idiomatic: Relay stations were ordered rectified and roads cleared.

sentences.zh: 十二月，諭晉丕勒多爾濟將張廷岳撤回官兵分佈防守推河等處，福濟妥設霍呢齊及推河糧台。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, Jinbil Dorji was ordered to distribute Zhang Tingyue's withdrawn troops to defend the Tui River region; Fujì was to properly establish grain depots at Honiqi and the Tui River.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Jinbil Dorji was to deploy Zhang Tingyue's withdrawn troops along the Tui River; Fujì was to establish grain depots at Honiqi and the Tui River.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，晉丕勒多爾濟奏飭賽、紮兩部落揀兵分紮烏城台站，並防各旗遊牧。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Jinbil Dorji memorialized ordering Sayin and Jasaghtu leagues to select troops for Urga relay stations and guard banner pastures.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Jinbil Dorji ordered Sayin and Jasaghtu leagues to post troops at Urga relay stations and guard pastures.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，允福濟等請，設烏城駐班台站扎薩克二員、管台二員。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Fujì's request was approved to establish two rotating jasaghs and two station managers at Urga.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Fujì won approval for two rotating jasaghs and two station managers at Urga.

sentences.zh: 諭福濟迅將哈爾呢敦等台趕緊預備，催綏遠城所遣達爾濟一軍前進。

translations.literal: Fujì was urged to prepare Harnidon and other stations promptly and press Darji's army from Suiyuancheng forward.
translations.idiomatic: Fujì was urged to prepare Harnidon stations and press Darji's army from Suiyuancheng forward.

sentences.zh: 是月，喇嘛棍噶紮拉參一軍自科布多援烏城。

translations.literal: That month, Lama Gungajala's army from Kobdo aided Urga.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Lama Gungajala's army from Kobdo aided Urga.

sentences.zh: 十年正月，諭嚴催晉丕勒多爾濟設復烏城以南台站。

translations.literal: In the first month of the tenth year, Jinbil Dorji was urgently ordered to restore relay stations south of Urga.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the tenth year, Jinbil Dorji was urgently ordered to restore relay stations south of Urga.

sentences.zh: 晉丕勒多爾濟劾福濟謬妄貽誤，自顧身命，將倉庫存項酬謝賊匪，眷屬皆系自盡，非為賊所害。

translations.literal: Jinbil Dorji impeached Fujì for reckless error, self-preservation, paying rebels from treasury stores, and families committing suicide rather than being killed by bandits.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbil Dorji impeached Fujì for reckless errors, paying rebels from treasury stores, and claiming families committed suicide.

sentences.zh: 福濟亦劾蒙古官員規避差使，請捏病告假規避，或飭傳故意遲行及始終不到者，均革職任，無職任者銷爵，仍令來營，從之。

translations.literal: Fujì also impeached Mongol officials evading duty through feigned illness or delay; all with office were dismissed but kept in post, those without rank stripped of titles yet ordered to camp; approved.
translations.idiomatic: Fujì also impeached Mongol officials evading duty; dismissals and title stripping were approved.

sentences.zh: 設霍呢齊台轉運總局，福濟飭貢果爾帶察哈爾馬隊駐守之。

translations.literal: A Honiqi transport headquarters was established; Fujì ordered Gongguer with Chahar cavalry to garrison it.
translations.idiomatic: A Honiqi transport headquarters was established under Gongguer with Chahar cavalry.

sentences.zh: 榮全奏：「親往催辦烏城以南二十台，行抵推河，見水台氈房駝馬漸集。

translations.literal: Rongquan memorialized: "Going personally to expedite the twenty stations south of Urga, reaching the Tui River, water-station yurts and camels were gradually gathering.
translations.idiomatic: Rongquan reported: "Going personally to expedite the twenty stations south of Urga; at the Tui River, yurts and camels were gathering.

sentences.zh: 推河至哈爾呢敦五台照舊佈置，略有規模。

translations.literal: The five stations from Tui River to Harnidon were arranged as before with some order.
translations.idiomatic: The five stations from Tui River to Harnidon were arranged with some order.

sentences.zh: 請給自備駝馬幫台之蒙古台吉丁戶一半錢糧。」

translations.literal: Half pay in silver is requested for Mongol taiji households supplying their own camels for relay duty."
translations.idiomatic: Half pay was requested for taiji households supplying their own relay camels."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 以回匪復圖再擾烏城，諭福濟等整頓台站，杜嘎爾軍毋得逗留。

translations.literal: Because rebels again threatened Urga, Fujì and others were ordered to rectify relay stations and Dugar's army must not linger.
translations.idiomatic: With rebels again threatening Urga, Fujì was ordered to rectify relay stations and Dugar must not linger.

sentences.zh: 二月，諭福濟等妥為佈置哈爾呢敦、額爾德尼昭、推河三處防守，並以達爾濟一軍行抵哈爾呢敦阻滯，飭督令各台站妥為供支，毋誤戎機。

translations.literal: In the second month, Fujì and others were ordered to arrange defense at Harnidon, Erdeni Juu, and Tui River; Darji's army stalled at Harnidon and stations must supply without delaying operations.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Fujì was ordered to defend Harnidon, Erdeni Juu, and the Tui River; stations must supply Darji without delay.

sentences.zh: 三月，以烏屬各台尚未備齊，致滯師行，諭切責福濟，並令傳知蒙古王公等率屬守禦，予烏城殉難蒙兵恤。

translations.literal: In the third month, because Urga stations were not ready and delayed the army, Fujì was severely rebuked; Mongol princes were told to defend; condolence was granted for Mongol soldiers who died at Urga.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, Fujì was rebuked for unreadiness at Urga stations; Mongol martyrs were mourned.

sentences.zh: 杜嘎爾奏派蘇彰阿帶黑龍江兵五百赴烏城，並調貢果爾一軍赴前敵各路。

translations.literal: Dugar memorialized dispatching Su Zhang'a with five hundred Heilongjiang troops to Urga and moving Gongguer's army to various fronts.
translations.idiomatic: Dugar dispatched Su Zhang'a with five hundred Heilongjiang troops to Urga and moved Gongguer's army to the front.

sentences.zh: 諭杜嘎爾赴察爾呢敦等處防剿。

translations.literal: Dugar was ordered to defend and suppress at Charnidon and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Dugar was ordered to defend and suppress at Charnidon and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 四月，予賽盟台吉車登丕勒吉雅捐銀面獎。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, Sayin league Taiji Chodempiljiya received face reward for silver donation.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, Sayin league Taiji Chodempiljiya received a face reward for donating silver.

sentences.zh: 杜嘎爾進駐貢鄂博地方。

translations.literal: Dugar advanced and encamped at Gun'obo.
translations.idiomatic: Dugar advanced and encamped at Gun'obo.

sentences.zh: 諭福濟等飭蒙古台站應付駝馬等項。

translations.literal: Fujì and others were ordered to require Mongol relay stations to supply camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Fujì was ordered to require relay stations to supply camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 晉丕勒多爾濟以請歸遊牧，罷烏里雅蘇臺參贊大臣，下院嚴議，以紮盟中左翼左旗貝勒多木沁紮木楚代之。

translations.literal: Jinbil Dorji, requesting return to pastoral life, was dismissed as Urga assistant commissioner and severely disciplined; Jasaghtu league Beile Domjin Zamchu replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: Jinbil Dorji was dismissed as assistant commissioner for requesting return to pastoral life; Beile Domjin Zamchu replaced him.

sentences.zh: 福濟亦革任，以金順為烏里雅蘇臺將軍，奎昌署之。

translations.literal: Fujì was also dismissed; Jin Shun became Urga general with Kuichang acting.
translations.idiomatic: Fujì was dismissed; Jin Shun became Urga general with Kuichang acting.

sentences.zh: 回匪復擾是部阿米爾密特遊牧，焚掠固爾班賽汗等處。

translations.literal: Rebels again disturbed this division's Amirmit pastures, burning and plundering Gurban Saihan and elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: Rebels again raided Amirmit pastures, burning Gurban Saihan and elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 諭杜嘎爾會奎昌等迅速追剿。

translations.literal: Dugar was ordered to join Kuichang in rapid pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: Dugar was ordered to join Kuichang in rapid pursuit.

sentences.zh: 五月，回匪竄薩哈爾呢敦附近之薩巴爾圖河、推河一帶，杜嘎爾遣納魯肯一軍駐翁吉驛防之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, rebels fled to the Saba'ertu River and Tui River region near Saharnidon; Dugar sent Naruken's army to garrison Ongi post.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, rebels reached the Saba'ertu and Tui River region; Dugar sent Naruken to garrison Ongi post.

sentences.zh: 六月，回匪竄擾霍爾哈順、霍呢齊二台。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, rebels disturbed Holkhashun and Honiqi stations.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, rebels disturbed Holkhashun and Honiqi stations.

sentences.zh: 諭慶春飭達爾濟於推河等處防守，杜嘎爾撥隊扼要駐紮，保護糧路。

translations.literal: Qingchun was ordered to have Darji defend the Tui River region; Dugar was to post troops at key points protecting grain routes.
translations.idiomatic: Qingchun was told to have Darji defend the Tui River; Dugar was to protect grain routes.

sentences.zh: 福濟等奏烏城調到吉林、黑龍江、察哈爾馬隊三千二百五十名，發圖、車、賽、紮四盟採買駝馬等銀各一萬兩。

translations.literal: Fujì and others memorialized three thousand two hundred fifty Jilin, Heilongjiang, and Chahar cavalry reached Urga; ten thousand taels each was issued to Tümen, Sechen, Sayin, and Jasaghtu leagues to purchase camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Fujì reported 3,250 Jilin, Heilongjiang, and Chahar cavalry at Urga and ten thousand taels each to four leagues for camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 八月，回匪復竄入阿米爾密特旗，至巴彥罕山，逼近翁吉河。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, rebels again entered Amirmit banner, reaching Bayanhan Mountain and approaching the Ongi River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, rebels again entered Amirmit banner, reaching Bayanhan Mountain near the Ongi River.

sentences.zh: 福濟等飭賽盟速派蒙兵五百名赴南台哈爾呢敦堵截。

translations.literal: Fujì and others ordered Sayin league to dispatch five hundred Mongol troops to block at south-station Harnidon.
translations.idiomatic: Fujì ordered Sayin league to send five hundred Mongols to block at south-station Harnidon.

sentences.zh: 九月，達爾濟一軍剿竄翁吉河之匪，殄之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Darji's army suppressed rebels fleeing to the Ongi River and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Darji destroyed rebels on the Ongi River.

sentences.zh: 杜嘎爾遣福珠哩率兵剿匪于阿米爾密特旗之那林渾第等處，殄之。

translations.literal: Dugar sent Fuzhuli's troops to destroy bandits at Nalin Hundi and elsewhere in Amirmit banner.
translations.idiomatic: Dugar sent Fuzhuli to destroy bandits at Nalin Hundi in Amirmit banner.

sentences.zh: 是旗附近肅清。

translations.literal: That banner's vicinity was cleared.
translations.idiomatic: That banner's vicinity was cleared.

sentences.zh: 達爾濟亦敗賊於喀雅喀拉烏蘇地方。

translations.literal: Darji also defeated bandits at Kayakara Usu.
translations.idiomatic: Darji also defeated bandits at Kayakara Usu.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，肅州回匪復竄擾是部阿米爾密特旗遊牧西南之濟爾哈朗圖地方。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year, Suzhou rebels again disturbed Amirmit banner pastures southwest at Jirhalangtu.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year, Suzhou rebels again raided Amirmit pastures at Jirhalangtu.

sentences.zh: 諭金順、奎昌等各設法保護所屬台站。

translations.literal: Jin Shun and Kuichang were each ordered to protect their relay stations.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Shun and Kuichang were ordered to protect relay stations.

sentences.zh: 杜嘎爾奏派富珠哩一軍扼紮哈爾呢敦一帶。

translations.literal: Dugar memorialized dispatching Fuzhuli's army to hold the Harnidon region.
translations.idiomatic: Dugar posted Fuzhuli's army at Harnidon.

sentences.zh: 四月，回匪竄擾白讬羅蓋及金山卡倫遊牧，奎昌等遣馬隊追剿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month, rebels disturbed pastures at Baitoluogai and the Jinshan picket; Kuichang and others sent cavalry in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, rebels hit Baitoluogai and the Jinshan picket; Kuichang sent cavalry in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 九月，連敗之於沙爾魯爾頓及庫爾庫嚕地方，匪自阿育爾公旗竄紮哈沁。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, consecutive defeats at Sharlu'erdun and Kurkulu; bandits fled from Ayur public banner to Zhahaxin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, consecutive defeats at Sharlu'erdun and Kurkulu; bandits fled from Ayur public banner to Zhahaxin.

sentences.zh: 十二年二月，烏裏雅蘇台將軍長順等以回匪屢擾賽、紮兩盟牧，暫令紮盟公車德恩敦多布多爾濟旗移於邊界相當之賽音諾顏部落右翼右後旗副將軍王格裏克紮木楚、扎薩克瑪尼巴拉等旗遊牧，賽盟扎薩克阿米爾密特旗移於本部賽音諾顏旗親王車林端多布等旗遊牧。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twelfth year, Urga General Changshun and others, because rebels repeatedly disturbed Sayin and Jasaghtu pastures, temporarily moved Jasaghtu league Gong Chörindondobdorji's banner to pastures of Sayin league right-wing rear-banner Deputy General Wang Grik Zamchu and Jasagh Manibala; Sayin league Jasagh Amirmit's banner moved to pastures of Sayin league Qinwang Chörindondob and others.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twelfth year, Changshun temporarily relocated Jasaghtu and Sayin banners away from the border after repeated rebel raids.

sentences.zh: 兩盟南界金山卡倫，亦令暫撤，俾作清野之計。

translations.literal: The two leagues' southern Jinshan picket was also temporarily withdrawn for a scorched-earth plan.
translations.idiomatic: The southern Jinshan picket was also withdrawn for a scorched-earth plan.

sentences.zh: 奏入，得旨，下所司知之。

translations.literal: Memorial received; relevant offices informed.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved and ministries notified.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月，烏城解嚴，長順等撥察哈爾新兵五百，令佐領依楞額統赴科布多，裁烏城賽、紮兩盟防兵五百，侍衛豐升阿統察哈爾馬隊仍駐紮巴罕河。

translations.literal: In the first month of the thirteenth year, with Urga's emergency lifted, Changshun assigned five hundred new Chahar troops under Company Captain Yileng'e to Kobdo, cut five hundred Sayin and Jasaghtu garrison troops at Urga; Bodyguard Fengsheng'a's Chahar cavalry remained at Zabahan River.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the thirteenth year, Urga's emergency lifted; Changshun sent five hundred Chahar troops to Kobdo and cut five hundred Sayin and Jasaghtu garrison troops.

sentences.zh: 光緒六年，以改議俄約，調賽、紮兩盟蒙兵二千名駐烏里雅蘇臺。

translations.literal: In Guangxu 6, because the Russian treaty was under revision, two thousand Sayin and Jasaghtu Mongol troops were posted at Urga.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 6, two thousand Sayin and Jasaghtu troops were posted at Urga during Russian treaty revision.

sentences.zh: 七月，以將軍春福等奏輔國公額爾奇博爾豁地方作為官屯。

translations.literal: In the seventh month, on General Chunfu's memorial, Assistant State Guardian Duke Erqi Borho land was designated official colonization.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, Erqi Borho land was designated official colonization, per General Chunfu.

sentences.zh: 九月，予賽盟扎薩克濟爾哈朗報效屯地獎。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Sayin league Jasagh Jirhalang was rewarded for contributing colonization land.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Jasagh Jirhalang was rewarded for contributing colonization land.

sentences.zh: 七年六月，以俄約成，撤駐烏城之賽盟蒙兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the seventh year, with the Russian treaty concluded, Sayin league Mongol garrison at Urga was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Guangxu 7, Sayin league garrison at Urga was withdrawn after the Russian treaty.

sentences.zh: 將軍杜嘎爾奏暫停辦博爾豁屯田。

translations.literal: General Dugar memorialized temporarily suspending Borho colonization.
translations.idiomatic: General Dugar suspended Borho colonization temporarily.

sentences.zh: 十一年九月，復設金山卡倫。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the eleventh year, the Jinshan picket was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Guangxu 11, the Jinshan picket was re-established.

sentences.zh: 十三年，署烏里雅蘇臺將軍祥麟等奏：「管理推河、紮克等台吉巴扎爾等報所屬都特庫圖勒等三台鼠災，請將都特庫圖勒台暫移在諾們汗沙畢遊牧內拜達里克河邊之敖爾楚克哈克圖地方，紮克、和博勒庫根兩台向前移在賽盟右翼右後旗郡王吹蘇倫紮布旗屬之紮綏額奇叟吉、哈拉布拉克等地方。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Acting Urga General Xianglin and others memorialized: "Taiji Bazhar managing Tui River and Zhak stations reported rat disaster at Dutu Tule and three other stations; Dutu Tule station should temporarily move to Aortuk Khaktu on the Baidarik River within Nomun Khan shabi pastures; Zhak and Hobolekugen stations should move forward to Jasuo Erqi Suji and Halaburag in Sayin league right-wing rear-banner Junwang Chisulunjab's territory.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 13, Xianglin reported: "Rat disaster at three stations; temporary relocations were proposed within Nomun Khan shabi and Chisulunjab's banner.

sentences.zh: 體察鼠災定息，青草暢茂，再飭各歸原台當差。」

translations.literal: When rat disaster subsides and grass grows lush, all should return to original stations for duty."
translations.idiomatic: When rats subsided and grass recovered, stations should return to original posts."

sentences.zh: 允之。

translations.literal: Approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 十九年，烏里雅蘇臺參贊大臣車林多爾濟病免，以那木濟勒端多布代之。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year, Urga Assistant Commissioner Chörindorji was dismissed for illness; Namjildondob replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 19, Assistant Commissioner Chörindorji was dismissed for illness; Namjildondob replaced him.

sentences.zh: 二十一年十二月，修烏里雅蘇臺。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the twenty-first year, Urga was repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Guangxu 21, Urga was repaired.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，修烏里雅蘇臺河橋及河堤。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Urga river bridge and embankment were repaired.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 23, Urga's river bridge and embankment were repaired.

sentences.zh: 二十五年九月，將軍崇歡奏查閱邊卡供給，每台有加至百五十兩之事，此次免去。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-fifth year, General Chonghuan memorialized that border picket supplies had risen to 150 taels per station; this increase was waived.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of Guangxu 25, Chonghuan waived increased border picket supplies of 150 taels per station.

sentences.zh: 查閱南二十台駝馬兩廠，專查五十五座台卡供給應付，概從刪減。

translations.literal: Inspection of the southern twenty-station camel and horse depots, covering fifty-five station picket supplies, was generally reduced.
translations.idiomatic: Inspection of southern twenty-station camel depots and fifty-five picket supplies was generally reduced.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，崇歡奏以古城一帶蝗災，改採購戍守官兵日需米麵於歸化城。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Chonghuan memorialized that because of locust disaster around Gucheng, daily grain for garrison troops would be purchased from Guihuacheng instead.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26, Chonghuan shifted garrison grain purchases to Guihuacheng because of locusts around Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 是年以拳匪肇釁，邊防戒嚴，將軍連順等調賽、紮兩盟及烏梁海兵擇要防守，各王、公、扎薩克等挑選壯丁，籌幫軍食，均能嚴約屬下，勿欺淩俄商，保全大局。

translations.literal: That year the Boxer crisis raised border alerts; General Lianshun mobilized Sayin, Jasaghtu, and Uriankhai troops for key defense; princes selected strong men and organized rations, strictly restraining followers from harassing Russian merchants, preserving the overall situation.
translations.idiomatic: In 1900, Lianshun mobilized Sayin, Jasaghtu, and Uriankhai troops; princes organized defense without harassing Russian merchants.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，請將奏入予賽盟盟長扎薩克郡王吹蘇倫紮布、親王那木囊蘇倫、副將軍扎薩克鎮國公剛珠爾紮布、副盟長扎薩克郡王固嚕固木紮布等獎有差，特予參贊大臣那木濟勒端多布黃馬褂。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, memorialized rewards were granted to Sayin league chief Jasagh Junwang Chisulunjab, Qinwang Namnang Sülün, Deputy General Jasagh State Guardian Duke Gangjürjab, Deputy Chief Jasagh Junwang Gulugumjab, and others; Assistant Commissioner Namjildondob especially received a yellow riding jacket.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28, Chisulunjab, Namnang Sülün, Gangjürjab, Gulugumjab, and others were rewarded; Namjildondob received a yellow riding jacket.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，設烏城中、俄通商事務局。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, the Urga Sino-Russian Commercial Affairs Bureau was established.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 29, the Urga Sino-Russian Commercial Affairs Bureau was established.

sentences.zh: 三十年八月，連順等以賽、紮兩盟呈報去冬今春雪災，牲畜倒斃。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the thirtieth year, Lianshun and others reported Sayin and Jasaghtu leagues' snow disaster last winter and this spring with livestock deaths.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of Guangxu 30, Lianshun reported snow disasters in Sayin and Jasaghtu leagues with livestock deaths.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，是部中左末旗親王那彥圖請裁佐領所遺差戶。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, this division's middle-left rear-banner Qinwang Nayan Tu requested abolishing relay households left vacant by company captains.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 31, Qinwang Nayan Tu requested abolishing vacant relay households from company captains.

sentences.zh: 護將軍奎煥飭由本盟各旗分派，按旗接充。

translations.literal: Acting General Kuihuan ordered allocation among league banners by banner rotation.
translations.idiomatic: Acting General Kuihuan ordered banners to rotate filling relay households.

sentences.zh: 入夏亢旱，駝馬疲瘦，請緩查閱台站，允之。

translations.literal: Summer drought left camels and horses weak and thin; delayed relay inspection was requested and granted.
translations.idiomatic: Summer drought weakened camels and horses; delayed relay inspection was granted.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，賽盟盟長吹蘇倫紮布卒，將軍奎煥等請于參贊大臣貝勒車登索諾木、親王那木囊蘇倫二員內簡一人為盟長。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year, Sayin league chief Chisulunjab died; Acting General Kuihuan requested choosing one of Assistant Commissioner Beile Chodemsonom or Qinwang Namnang Sülün as league chief.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 32, league chief Chisulunjab died; Kuihuan asked to choose between Beile Chodemsonom and Qinwang Namnang Sülün.

sentences.zh: 得旨，授那木囊蘇倫盟長。

translations.literal: Edict received: Namnang Sülün was appointed league chief.
translations.idiomatic: Namnang Sülün was appointed league chief.

sentences.zh: 定例，盟長由理籓院請簡，此出將軍保奏，非恆格也。

translations.literal: By regulation league chiefs are selected by the Lifan Yuan; this came from the general's recommendation, not the usual rule.
translations.idiomatic: League chiefs are usually selected by the Lifan Yuan; this came from the general's recommendation, not usual practice.

sentences.zh: 那木濟勒端多布之後，是部中左旗貝勒車登索諾木、中右旗郡王庫魯固木紮布相繼為烏里雅蘇臺參贊大臣。

translations.literal: After Namjildondob, this division's middle-left-banner Beile Chodemsonom and middle-right-banner Junwang Khurugumjab successively served as Urga assistant commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: After Namjildondob, Beile Chodemsonom and Junwang Khurugumjab served as Urga assistant commissioners.

sentences.zh: 三十四年六月，御史常徽劾車登索諾木「捏報災情。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the thirty-fourth year, Censor Chang Hui impeached Chodemsonom: "False disaster reports.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Guangxu 34, Censor Chang Hui impeached Chodemsonom: "False disaster reports.

sentences.zh: 本盟應派差使，不遵奏章赴邊。

translations.literal: League assignments due at the border were not sent per memorial regulations.
translations.idiomatic: League border assignments were not sent per regulations.

sentences.zh: 防守之差，以賄為定，蒙情不服，咸有戒心。

translations.literal: Defense assignments were fixed by bribes; Mongols were discontented and wary.
translations.idiomatic: Defense assignments were fixed by bribes; Mongols were discontented.

sentences.zh: 如牧廠未報地界，任令開荒。

translations.literal: Pasture boundaries unreported allowed reclamation at will.
translations.idiomatic: Unreported pasture boundaries allowed reclamation at will.

sentences.zh: 駝馬捏報倒斃。
