translations.literal: Camels and horses were falsely reported dead.
translations.idiomatic: Camels and horses were falsely reported dead.

sentences.zh: 孳生以多報少，弊混不可枚舉」。

translations.literal: Breeding was over-reported as under-reported; abuses were too many to list."
translations.idiomatic: Breeding was over-reported as under-reported; abuses were too many to list."

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，將車堃岫查覆，多為寬解，惟謂車登索諾木於本旗充當各差，或有互調他旗，以遠易近，避重就輕。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 1, General Che Kuixiu investigated and mostly exonerated, but said Chodemsonom in fulfilling duties in his banner sometimes swapped banners to swap distant for near and avoid heavy for light.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 1, Che Kuixiu mostly exonerated Chodemsonom but noted he swapped banners to avoid heavy duties.

sentences.zh: 管理旗務之扎薩克齊阿莫朦混自專，請革之，而為車登索諾木請免議。

translations.literal: Jasagh clerk Amo monopolized banner affairs confusedly; dismissal was requested, while Chodemsonom was recommended exempt from discipline.
translations.idiomatic: Jasagh clerk Amo was recommended for dismissal; Chodemsonom was recommended exempt from discipline.

sentences.zh: 二年，是部親王那木囊蘇倫、那彥圖為資政院欽選議員。

translations.literal: In the second year, this division's Qinwang Namnang Sülün and Nayan Tu were imperially selected Advisory Council members.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2, Qinwang Namnang Sülün and Nayan Tu were imperially selected Advisory Council members.

sentences.zh: 三年，庫倫獨立，是部王公附之，將軍奎芳被迫去職。

translations.literal: In the third year, with Khüree independent, this division's princes joined; General Kuifang was forced out.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3, with Khüree independent, princes joined and General Kuifang was forced out.

sentences.zh: 是部額駙策淩之後，親王拉旺多爾濟、車登巴咱爾、達爾瑪、那彥圖多至御前大臣、領侍衛內大臣，為外扎薩克諸部所莫及。

translations.literal: Descendants of Efu Tsewang—Qinwang Lawang Dorji, Chodenbazar, Darma, and Nayan Tu—often became imperial attendants and chief bodyguard ministers, unmatched among outer jasagh divisions.
translations.idiomatic: Efu Tsewang's descendants often became imperial attendants and chief bodyguard ministers, unmatched among outer jasaghs.

sentences.zh: 是部地兼耕牧，有礦，有鹽池，向稱饒富。

translations.literal: This division combines farming and herding, has mines and salt lakes, and was always abundantly rich.
translations.idiomatic: This division combines farming and herding, with mines and salt lakes, and was always abundantly rich.

sentences.zh: 共有佐領三十一。

translations.literal: There are thirty-one company captains in all.
translations.idiomatic: There are thirty-one company captains in all.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克圖汗部，稱喀爾喀西路，至京師四千餘里。

translations.literal: The Jasaghtu Khan banner, called the Khalkha western route, is over 4,000 li from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Jasaghtu Khan banner—designated the Khalkha western route—lies over 4,000 li from the capital.

sentences.zh: 東界翁錦、西爾哈勒珠特，西界喀喇烏蘇、額埒克諾爾，南界阿爾察喀喇托輝，北界推河。

translations.literal: It is bounded on the east by Ongjin and Xirhalzhut, on the west by Kara Usu and Elek Nuur, on the south by Altchaqara Tohui, and on the north by the Tui River.
translations.idiomatic: It is bounded on the east by Ongjin and Xirhalzhut, on the west by Kara Usu and Elek Nuur, on the south by Altchaqara Tohui, and on the north by the Tui River.

sentences.zh: 元太祖十六世孫格埒森紮紮賚爾琿台吉有子七，分掌喀爾喀左、右翼。

translations.literal: Gerenje Zasaqer Khung-taiji, sixteenth-generation descendant of Genghis Khan, had seven sons who divided rule of Khalkha left and right wings.
translations.idiomatic: Gerenje Zasaqer Khung-taiji had seven sons who divided rule of Khalkha left and right wings.

sentences.zh: 左翼牧圖拉河界，右翼仍留居杭愛山。

translations.literal: The left wing pastured on the Tula River border; the right wing remained on the Khangai Mountains.
translations.idiomatic: The left wing pastured on the Tula River; the right wing remained on the Khangai Mountains.

sentences.zh: 其長子阿什海達爾漢琿台吉、次子諾顏泰哈坦巴圖爾、第四子德勒登昆都倫、第七子鄂特歡諾顏同掌之。

translations.literal: The eldest Ashi Khudar Khung-taiji, second Noyan Tai Qatan Batu, fourth Deleken Qondulen, and seventh Etegen Noyan ruled together.
translations.idiomatic: Ashi Khudar Khung-taiji, Noyan Tai Qatan Batu, Deleken Qondulen, and Etegen Noyan ruled together.

sentences.zh: 今扎薩克圖汗部十九扎薩克，自厄魯特一旗外，皆其裔。

translations.literal: Today's nineteen Jasaghtu Khan jasaghs, except one Oirat banner, are all their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: Today's nineteen Jasaghtu Khan jasaghs, except one Oirat banner, are all their descendants.

sentences.zh: 阿什海達爾漢琿台吉子二：長巴延達喇，子賚瑚爾汗，為原封扎薩克圖汗策旺紮布及扎薩克貝勒卓特巴，台吉喇布坦、額爾德尼袞布三旗祖；

translations.literal: Ashi Khudar Khung-taiji had two sons: the elder Bayan Dara's son Zasaqer Khan was ancestor of original Jasaghtu Khan Tsewangjab and Jasagh Beile Chotba, Taiji Labtan, and Erdeni Günbo's three banners;
translations.idiomatic: Ashi Khudar Khung-taiji's line founded Jasaghtu Khan Tsewangjab's and three other banners;

sentences.zh: 次圖捫達喇岱青，子碩壘烏巴什，號琿台吉，為扎薩克貝勒根敦，輔國公沙克紮、齊巴克紮布，台吉納瑪琳藏布、達什朋素克五旗祖。

translations.literal: the second Tümen Dara Daiqing's son Sholoi Ubashi, titled Khung-taiji, was ancestor of Jasagh Beile Gendün, Assistant State Guardian Duke Shakja and Chibakjab, and Taiji Namalinzangbo and Dashpensik's five banners.
translations.idiomatic: Sholoi Ubashi founded five banners including Jasagh Beile Gendün's.

sentences.zh: 諾顏泰哈坦巴圖爾生土伯特哈坦巴圖爾，子二：長崆奎，號車臣濟農，為扎薩克郡王朋素克喇布坦、貝子博貝、輔國公索諾木伊斯劄布，台吉烏爾占、哈瑪爾岱青五旗祖；

translations.literal: Noyan Tai Qatan Batu begot Tübet Qatan Batu with two sons: the elder Khongkui, titled Sechen Jinong, was ancestor of Jasagh Junwang Pensik Labtan, Beizi Boboi, Assistant State Guardian Duke Sonam Isjab, and Taiji Urjan and Hamardaiqing's five banners;
translations.idiomatic: Khongkui, titled Sechen Jinong, founded five banners including Jasagh Junwang Pensik Labtan's;

sentences.zh: 次賽因巴特瑪，號哈坦巴圖爾，為扎薩克輔國公袞占、台吉伊達木紮布二旗祖。

translations.literal: the second Sain Batma, titled Qatan Batu, was ancestor of Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Günjan and Taiji Idamjab's two banners.
translations.idiomatic: Sain Batma founded two banners including Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Günjan's.

sentences.zh: 德勒登昆都倫生鍾圖岱，號巴圖爾，為扎薩克台吉諾爾布一旗祖。

translations.literal: Deleken Qondulen begot Jongtode, titled Batu, ancestor of Jasagh Taiji Norbu's one banner.
translations.idiomatic: Deleken Qondulen's son Jongtode founded Jasagh Taiji Norbu's banner.

sentences.zh: 鄂特歡諾顏生青達瑪尼默濟克，號車臣諾顏，為扎薩克輔國公通謨克、台吉普爾普車淩二旗祖。

translations.literal: Etegen Noyan begot Qingdam Nemjik, titled Sechen Noyan, ancestor of Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Tungmuk and Taiji Purpu Chörin's two banners.
translations.idiomatic: Etegen Noyan's son Qingdam Nemjik founded two banners.

sentences.zh: 初，賚瑚爾為喀爾喀右翼長，所部以汗稱，傳子素巴第，始號扎薩克圖汗，與其族土謝圖汗袞布、車臣汗碩壘同時稱三汗。

translations.literal: Initially Zasaqer was Khalkha right-wing chief; his division was called khan; his son Subedei first took the title Jasaghtu Khan, simultaneously one of the Three Khans with Tüshiyetu Khan Günbo and Sechen Khan Sholoi.
translations.idiomatic: Zasaqer's son Subedei first took the title Jasaghtu Khan with Tüshiyetu Khan Günbo and Sechen Khan Sholoi.

sentences.zh: 碩壘通好最先，袞布次之，素巴第最後。

translations.literal: Sholoi sought friendship first, Günbo second, Subedei last.
translations.idiomatic: Sholoi sought friendship first, Günbo second, Subedei last.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，以其部謀掠歸化城，上統師征，所部遁，素巴第遣使謝罪，並貢馬及獨峰駝、無尾羊。

translations.literal: In Chongde 3, because his division plotted to raid Guihuacheng, the emperor led troops; the division fled; Subedei sent envoys apologizing and tribute horses, Bactrian camels, and tailless sheep.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3, Subedei apologized after his division fled from a campaign over a Guihuacheng raid plot.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「朕以兵討有罪，以德撫無罪，惟行正義，故上天垂佑，蒙古、察哈爾諸部皆以畀朕。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "We punish the guilty by arms and soothe the innocent by virtue, acting justly, so Heaven favors us and Mongol and Chahar divisions are given to Us.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "We punish the guilty and soothe the innocent; Heaven has given Us Mongol and Chahar divisions.

sentences.zh: 爾等皆其所屬，當即相率歸誠，不則亦惟謹守爾界。

translations.literal: You all belong to them; submit at once, or strictly keep your borders.
translations.idiomatic: Submit at once, or strictly keep your borders.

sentences.zh: 乃反興兵構怨，謀肆侵掠，豈以遠處西北，即為征討不及之區耶？

translations.literal: Yet you raise troops and enmity, plotting plunder—do you think the distant northwest is beyond campaign reach?
translations.idiomatic: Yet you raise troops and plot plunder—do you think the northwest is beyond our reach?

sentences.zh: 今與爾約，嗣後慎勿復入歸化城界，重貽罪戾。」

translations.literal: We now covenant with you: hereafter do not enter Guihuacheng borders again and incur guilt."
translations.idiomatic: We covenant: do not enter Guihuacheng borders again."

sentences.zh: 五年，復賜敕誡諭。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an admonishing letter was again bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, an admonishing letter was again bestowed.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，素巴第聞詔責碩壘、袞布等納蘇尼特叛人騰機思及掠巴林罪，欲代為解，偕同族俄木布額爾德尼上書乞好。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 4, Subedei, hearing edicts rebuking Sholoi and Günbo for harboring Sunid rebel Tenggis and raiding Baarin, wished to intercede; with kinsman Ombo Erdeni he sent a letter seeking friendship.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4, Subedei with Ombo Erdeni sent a letter seeking friendship after rebukes over Tenggis and Baarin.

sentences.zh: 上因其書不稱名，詞近悖慢，切責之。

translations.literal: Because the letter used no personal name and language was near insolent, severe rebuke was issued.
translations.idiomatic: Because the letter lacked a personal name and was insolent, severe rebuke followed.

sentences.zh: 七年，俄木布額爾德尼等詭稱行獵，私入歸化城界掠牧產，遣官飭歸所掠。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Ombo Erdeni and others feigned hunting and privately entered Guihuacheng borders to plunder livestock; officials were sent ordering return of plunder.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Ombo Erdeni plundered Guihuacheng borders under pretense of hunting; plunder was ordered returned.

sentences.zh: 會素巴第卒，子諾爾布嗣，稱畢錫哷勒圖汗，遣使入貢。

translations.literal: When Subedei died, his son Norbu succeeded as Bishbaliktu Khan and sent tribute envoys.
translations.idiomatic: Subedei died; his son Norbu succeeded as Bishbaliktu Khan and sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 諭曰：「朕本欲許爾等和好，故命察歸所掠以贖前罪。

translations.literal: An edict stated: "We wished to grant you peace and ordered investigation and return of plunder to atone for past guilt.
translations.idiomatic: An edict stated: "We wished peace and ordered return of plunder to atone.

sentences.zh: 今爾等反以朕留爾逃人為詞，是何心耶？

translations.literal: Now you instead cite Our retention of your fugitives—what is your intent?
translations.idiomatic: Now you cite retention of fugitives—what is your intent?

sentences.zh: 朕統一四海，爾等彈丸小國，勿恃荒遠，勿聽奸詞，致隕爾緒。」

translations.literal: We unify the four seas; you are tiny states—do not rely on remoteness or wicked counsel and destroy your lineages."
translations.idiomatic: We unify the four seas; do not rely on remoteness or wicked counsel."

sentences.zh: 十二年，諾爾布偕俄木布額爾德尼各遣子來朝謝罪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Norbu and Ombo Erdeni each sent sons to court to apologize.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Norbu and Ombo Erdeni sent sons to apologize.

sentences.zh: 十四年，復偕同族車臣濟農昆都倫陀音奉表乞好。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, again with kinsman Sechen Jinong Qondulen Toyin they submitted memorials seeking friendship.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, they again sought friendship with Sechen Jinong Qondulen Toyin.

sentences.zh: 詔宥前罪。

translations.literal: An edict pardoned past offenses.
translations.idiomatic: Past offenses were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十六年，遣大臣齎服物諭賚之。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, a minister was dispatched with robes as gifts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, a minister brought robes as gifts.

sentences.zh: 先是喀爾喀左右翼設八扎薩克，諾爾布及俄木布額爾德尼、車臣濟農昆都倫陀音各領右翼扎薩克之一。

translations.literal: Previously eight jasaghs were established for Khalkha wings; Norbu, Ombo Erdeni, and Sechen Jinong Qondulen Toyin each led one right-wing jasagh.
translations.idiomatic: Eight jasaghs were established; Norbu, Ombo Erdeni, and Qondulen Toyin each led a right-wing jasagh.

sentences.zh: 諾爾布卒，子旺舒克襲，仍號扎薩克圖汗。

translations.literal: Norbu died; his son Wangshuk succeeded, still titled Jasaghtu Khan.
translations.idiomatic: Norbu died; Wangshuk succeeded as Jasaghtu Khan.

sentences.zh: 俄木布額爾德尼卒，子額璘沁襲，號羅卜藏台吉。

translations.literal: Ombo Erdeni died; his son Erinchen succeeded, titled Lobzang Taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Ombo Erdeni died; Erinchen succeeded as Lobzang Taiji.

sentences.zh: 康熙元年，額璘沁以私憾襲殺旺舒克，奔就厄魯特。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 1, Erinchen killed Wangshuk over a private grudge and fled to the Oirats.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1, Erinchen killed Wangshuk and fled to the Oirats.

sentences.zh: 其叔父袞布伊勒登避難來歸，封扎薩克貝勒，駐牧喜峰口外察罕和朔圖。

translations.literal: His uncle Günbo Ilden took refuge and submitted, enfeoffed Jasagh Beile, pasturing outside Xifengkou at Chaqan Hoshtu.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Günbo Ilden submitted, was enfeoffed Jasagh Beile, and pastured at Chaqan Hoshtu.

sentences.zh: 詳喀爾喀左翼部總傳。

translations.literal: See the Khalkha left-wing general biography for details.
translations.idiomatic: See the Khalkha left-wing general biography for details.

sentences.zh: 九年，命旺舒克弟成袞襲扎薩克圖汗號，輯其眾。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, Wangshuk's brother Chenggun was ordered to inherit the Jasaghtu Khan title and gather the people.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, Chenggun inherited the Jasaghtu Khan title.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，成袞以額璘沁之亂，屬眾潰，多往依左翼土謝圖汗察琿多爾濟，屢索不獲，與構釁。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, because of Erinchen's turmoil Chenggun's followers scattered, many relying on left-wing Tüshiyetu Khan Caqur Dorji; repeated demands failed and conflict arose.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year, Chenggun's followers scattered to Caqur Dorji and conflict arose.

sentences.zh: 命阿齊圖格隆等諭解之。

translations.literal: Aqitu Geren and others were ordered to mediate.
translations.idiomatic: Aqitu Geren and others were ordered to mediate.

sentences.zh: 會成袞卒，厄魯特噶爾丹謀掠喀爾喀，誘成袞子沙喇攻察琿多爾濟。

translations.literal: When Chenggun died, Oirat Galdan plotted to raid Khalkha and incited Chenggun's son Shara to attack Caqur Dorji.
translations.idiomatic: When Chenggun died, Galdan incited his son Shara to attack Caqur Dorji.

sentences.zh: 沙喇因會噶爾丹於固爾班赫格爾，台吉德克德赫等從往。

translations.literal: Shara met Galdan at Gurban Hegel; Taiji Dekdege and others followed.
translations.idiomatic: Shara met Galdan at Gurban Hegel; Taiji Dekdege followed.

sentences.zh: 察琿多爾濟惡之，追殺沙喇及德克德赫。

translations.literal: Caqur Dorji hated this and pursued, killing Shara and Dekdege.
translations.idiomatic: Caqur Dorji pursued and killed Shara and Dekdege.

sentences.zh: 二十七年，噶爾丹以兵三萬掠喀爾喀，至杭愛山，所部大潰。

translations.literal: In the twenty-seventh year, Galdan raided Khalkha with thirty thousand troops to the Khangai Mountains; the division was routed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-seventh year, Galdan routed the division at the Khangai Mountains.

sentences.zh: 沙喇弟策旺劄布偕同族色淩阿海等相繼來歸，詔附牧烏喇特諸部。

translations.literal: Shara's brother Tsewangjab with kinsman Seren Akhai and others successively submitted; ordered to pasture near Urad banners.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewangjab and Seren Akhai submitted and pastured near Urad banners.

sentences.zh: 三十年，駕幸多倫諾爾會閱，以所部屢經變亂被芟夷，詔封色淩阿海等王、貝子、台吉有差，各授扎薩克，令集所屬編佐領撫輯之。

translations.literal: In the thirtieth year, at the Dolon Nor review, because the division had suffered repeated turmoil and decimation, Seren Akhai and others were enfeoffed as princes and taiji, granted jasagh, and ordered to gather followers, organize companies, and pacify.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirtieth year at Dolon Nor, Seren Akhai and others were enfeoffed and ordered to reorganize the division.

sentences.zh: 而以成袞子策旺紮布為扎薩克圖汗，特封和碩親王，統其眾。

translations.literal: Chenggun's son Tsewangjab was made Jasaghtu Khan, specially enfeoffed Hoshoi Qinwang, commanding all.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewangjab became Jasaghtu Khan and Hoshoi Qinwang.

sentences.zh: 自是始稱扎薩克圖汗部。

translations.literal: From this it was first called the Jasaghtu Khan division.
translations.idiomatic: From this it was first called the Jasaghtu Khan division.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，定所部為喀爾喀西路。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year, the division was fixed as the Khalkha western route.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-first year, the division was designated the Khalkha western route.

sentences.zh: 三十六年，詔歸杭愛山遊牧。

translations.literal: In the thirty-sixth year, an edict ordered return to Khangai Mountain pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-sixth year, they were ordered back to Khangai pastures.

sentences.zh: 四十年，賜牧產贍之。

translations.literal: In the fortieth year, livestock was bestowed for support.
translations.idiomatic: In the fortieth year, livestock was bestowed for support.

sentences.zh: 尋命策旺紮布仍襲扎薩克圖汗號。

translations.literal: Soon Tsewangjab was again ordered to inherit the Jasaghtu Khan title.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Tsewangjab again inherited the Jasaghtu Khan title.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，遣額駙策淩等赴阿爾台勘所部與準噶爾界。

translations.literal: In Yongzheng 4, Efu Tsewang and others were sent to survey the Altai border with the Zunghars.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4, Efu Tsewang surveyed the Altai-Zunghar border.

sentences.zh: 九年，大軍剿噶爾丹策淩，詔所部扎薩克等內徙遊牧。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, with the great army suppressing Galdan Tseren, division jasaghs were ordered to move pastures inland.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, jasaghs were ordered to move pastures inland during the Galdan Tseren campaign.

sentences.zh: 十年，以準噶爾敗遁，諭曰：「去歲朕降旨令爾等徙居內地，並不感悅遵行，屢次催促，始勉強遷移。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, with the Zunghars defeated and fled, an edict stated: "Last year We ordered you inland; you were not grateful and obeyed willingly, needing repeated urging before reluctant migration.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, an edict stated: "Last year We ordered you inland; you were not grateful and obeyed willingly, needing repeated urging before reluctant migration.

sentences.zh: 今幸大軍於蘇克阿勒達呼及額爾德尼昭兩敗賊眾，爾等始得安居，否則豈能保護牲畜乎？

translations.literal: Now fortunately the great army defeated the enemy at Suk Alatahu and Erdeni Juu and you can live in peace—otherwise could you have protected your livestock?
translations.idiomatic: The army's victories at Suk Alatahu and Erdeni Juu let them live in peace.

sentences.zh: 朕思爾等本屬一體，豈有甘居庸懦受人庇廕之理。

translations.literal: We consider you all one body; how could you willingly remain weak and live under others' protection?
translations.idiomatic: You are one body with Us; do not remain weak under others' protection.

sentences.zh: 嗣後各宜激烈奮發，不惟永享升平，亦且垂光史冊矣。」

translations.literal: Hereafter each should strive fiercely—not only enjoy peace but also shine in history."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter strive fiercely to shine in history."

sentences.zh: 先是扎薩克圖汗策旺紮布以從征退縮罪削爵，詔郡王朋素克喇布坦子格哷克延丕勒襲汗號。

translations.literal: Previously Jasaghtu Khan Tsewangjab was stripped for shrinking in campaign; Junwang Pensik Labtan's son Galdanjanbil was ordered to inherit the khan title.
translations.idiomatic: Tsewangjab was stripped for shrinking in campaign; Galdanjanbil inherited the khan title.

sentences.zh: 十二年，調兵駐防察罕廋爾。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, troops were posted at Chaqan Nur.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, troops garrisoned Chaqan Nur.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，選兵赴鄂爾坤防秋。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 1, soldiers were selected for autumn defense at the Ergün.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1, soldiers were sent for autumn defense at the Ergün.

sentences.zh: 二年，定邊大將軍平郡王福彭奏：「喀爾喀四部防秋兵皆駐鄂爾坤，扎薩克圖汗部駐牧紮克拜達哩克西南，距鄂爾坤尤邇。

translations.literal: In the second year, Frontier General Ping Junwang Fupeng memorialized: "All four Khalkha divisions' autumn troops garrison the Ergün; the Jasaghtu Khan division pastures southwest of Zhab Baidarik, closest to the Ergün.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, Fupeng proposed: "Jasaghtu Khan troops should garrison locally near the Ergün.

sentences.zh: 請即令在彼駐防，徵調無難即至。」

translations.literal: Request they garrison there for easy mobilization."
translations.idiomatic: They should garrison there for easy mobilization."

sentences.zh: 詔如所請。

translations.literal: Approved as requested.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 五年，諭曰：「前以軍務方興，恐爾部遊牧被賊侵擾，悉令內徙。

translations.literal: In the fifth year, an edict stated: "Previously with war active, fearing your pastures would be raided, all were moved inland.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, an edict stated: "Previously, with war active, fearing your pastures would be raided, all were moved inland.

sentences.zh: 今噶爾丹策淩謹遵朕旨，奏稱不敢越阿爾台遊牧，甚屬恭順。

translations.literal: Now Galdan Tseren respectfully follows Our orders, reporting he dares not pasture beyond the Altai—very obedient.
translations.idiomatic: Galdan Tseren reported he would not pasture beyond the Altai.

sentences.zh: 朕亦降旨令爾部遊牧毋逾紮布堪、齊克慎、哈薩克圖、庫克嶺等處。

translations.literal: We also ordered your pastures not to exceed Zhabkan, Chiksen, Qasaktu, and Kukling.
translations.idiomatic: Pastures were limited to Zhabkan, Chiksen, Qasaktu, and Kukling.

sentences.zh: 爾等當遍諭所屬，永遠遵行。

translations.literal: You must instruct followers to obey forever.
translations.idiomatic: Followers must obey forever.

sentences.zh: 儻有違令生事者，嚴行治罪。

translations.literal: Any who violate orders and cause trouble will be severely punished.
translations.idiomatic: Violators will be severely punished.

sentences.zh: 況今雖許準噶爾和好，罷息干戈，而平日不可不訓習武備，爾等其留意，毋忽！」

translations.literal: Though Zunghar peace now pauses war, daily drill must not be neglected—take heed!"
translations.idiomatic: Though peace pauses war, drill must not be neglected!"

sentences.zh: 六年，命參贊大臣副都統慶泰察閱防秋兵於哈裏勒邁。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, Assistant Commissioner Qingtai inspected autumn troops at Harilemai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, Qingtai inspected autumn troops at Harilemai.

sentences.zh: 十三年，選駝五百運歸化城米赴塔密爾軍營。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, five hundred camels carried Guihuacheng grain to the Tamir camp.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, five hundred camels carried grain to the Tamir camp.

sentences.zh: 十六年，敕禁所部越境與準噶爾及回眾私市。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, private border trade with Zunghars and Muslims was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, private border trade with Zunghars and Muslims was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 十七年，選兵千駐防錫喇烏蘇。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, a thousand soldiers garrisoned Xila Usu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, a thousand soldiers garrisoned Xila Usu.

sentences.zh: 二十年，隨大軍進剿達瓦齊。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, they joined the great army advancing against Dawachi.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, they joined the advance against Dawachi.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以其部和托輝特郡王青袞咱卜叛，誅之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year, the division's Khoit Junwang Qinggunjab rebelled and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year, Khoit Junwang Qinggunjab rebelled and was executed.

sentences.zh: 尋諭扎薩克圖汗部曰：「前因青袞咱卜負恩背叛，散佈流言，眾喀爾喀間有煽動。

translations.literal: Soon the Jasaghtu Khan division was told: "Because Qinggunjab betrayed grace and spread rumors, Khalkha was somewhat stirred.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they were told: "Because Qinggunjab betrayed grace and spread rumors, Khalkha was somewhat stirred.

sentences.zh: 經朕訓諭，爾等旋知悔悟，各奉職守。

translations.literal: After Our instruction you quickly repented and kept your posts.
translations.idiomatic: After instruction they repented and kept their posts.

sentences.zh: 今逆賊就誅，黨附人等應分別治罪，以彰國憲。

translations.literal: Now the rebel is executed; followers should be punished separately to uphold law.
translations.idiomatic: The rebel is executed; followers should be punished to uphold law.

sentences.zh: 但爾等為國家臣僕百餘年，誤聽浮言，致幹罪戾，並非有心附賊，免其查究。

translations.literal: But you have served the state over a century, misled by rumors without intent to join rebels—investigation is waived.
translations.idiomatic: Investigation is waived for those misled without intent to join rebels.

sentences.zh: 嗣後益宜仰體朕恩，湔滌前愆，約束所屬，各安本業，綏靜邊隅，長享太平之福。」

translations.literal: Hereafter honor Our grace, wash away past faults, restrain followers, keep to livelihoods, pacify the frontier, and enjoy lasting peace."
translations.idiomatic: Honor Our grace, restrain followers, and enjoy lasting peace."

sentences.zh: 先是扎薩克圖汗部編佐領，蕩平准、回之役，是部扎薩克郡王品級貝勒青袞咱卜、貝勒連登紮布皆以叛誅，而輔國公旺布多爾濟積俘青袞咱卜及准部叛賊呢瑪功，晉襲貝勒，予郡王品級。

translations.literal: Previously the Jasaghtu Khan division organized companies; in pacifying Zunghars and Muslims, Jasagh Junwang-rank Beile Qinggunjab and Beile Liandondjab were executed for rebellion, while Assistant State Guardian Duke Wangbudorji, capturing Qinggunjab and Zunghar rebel Nima, was promoted to beile with junwang rank.
translations.idiomatic: Qinggunjab and Liandondjab were executed; Wangbudorji was promoted for capturing them.

sentences.zh: 一等台吉扎薩克朗袞紮布積取庫車援賊及克庫車功，晉至鎮國公。

translations.literal: First-Class Taiji Jasagh Langgunjab, capturing Kucha relief rebels and taking Kucha, was promoted to State Guardian Duke.
translations.idiomatic: Langgunjab was promoted to State Guardian Duke for taking Kucha.

sentences.zh: 二等台吉諾爾布以不從叛賊策登紮布，授扎薩克一等台吉。

translations.literal: Second-Class Taiji Norbu, refusing rebel Tsedondjab, was granted Jasagh First-Class Taiji.
translations.idiomatic: Norbu was granted Jasagh First-Class Taiji for refusing rebel Tsedondjab.

sentences.zh: 死事於阿里固特之二等台吉齊巴克紮布，追封輔國公，並授其子巴圖濟爾噶勒扎薩克。

translations.literal: Second-Class Taiji Chibakjab, who died at Aligut, was posthumously enfeoffed Assistant State Guardian Duke; his son Batujirgal was granted jasagh.
translations.idiomatic: Chibakjab was posthumously enfeoffed; his son Batujirgal received jasagh.

sentences.zh: 其扎薩克一等台吉噶爾丹達爾紮，以率其屬戶口自准部特莫爾圖諾爾遊牧復歸，授一等台吉，其後授其子拉克沁噶喇扎薩克，編佐領隸是部。

translations.literal: Jasagh First-Class Taiji Galdandarja, leading followers back from Temurt Nuur pastures in the Zunghar region, received First-Class Taiji; later his son Lakchin Gar was granted jasagh and a company under this division.
translations.idiomatic: Galdandarja led followers back from Zunghar pastures; his son received jasagh.

sentences.zh: 先是扎薩克圖汗部編佐領分十旗，後增八旗，附厄魯特一旗。

translations.literal: Initially the Jasaghtu Khan division had ten banners with companies, later eight added, plus one attached Oirat banner.
translations.idiomatic: The division began with ten banners, later adding eight plus one Oirat banner.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克十有九，盟於紮克畢賴色欽畢都哩雅諾爾，設正副盟長各一，副將軍、參贊各一。

translations.literal: Nineteen jasaghs leagued at Zhab Bilaisen Chindu Liyanor with chief and deputy league heads, deputy general, and assistant commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Nineteen jasaghs leagued at Zhab Bilaisen Chindu Liyanor.

sentences.zh: 爵二十有二：扎薩克圖汗兼多羅郡王一；

translations.literal: Titles number twenty-two: one Jasaghtu Khan also Duoluo Junwang;
translations.idiomatic: Titles number twenty-two: one Jasaghtu Khan also Duoluo Junwang;

sentences.zh: 附公品級三等台吉一，由輔國公降襲；

translations.literal: one attached gong-rank Third-Class Taiji, demoted from Assistant State Guardian Duke;
translations.idiomatic: one attached gong-rank Third-Class Taiji, demoted from Assistant State Guardian Duke;

sentences.zh: 郡王品級扎薩克多羅貝勒一；

translations.literal: one junwang-rank Jasagh Duoluo Beile;
translations.idiomatic: one junwang-rank Jasagh Duoluo Beile;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克鎮國公二，一由貝勒降襲，一由扎薩克台吉晉襲；

translations.literal: two Jasagh State Guardian Dukes, one demoted from beile, one promoted from Jasagh Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: two Jasagh State Guardian Dukes;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克輔國公六，一由貝子降襲；

translations.literal: six Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Dukes, one demoted from beizi;
translations.idiomatic: six Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Dukes;

sentences.zh: 附輔國公一；

translations.literal: one attached Assistant State Guardian Duke;
translations.idiomatic: one attached Assistant State Guardian Duke;

sentences.zh: 扎薩克一等台吉八；

translations.literal: eight Jasagh First-Class Taiji;
translations.idiomatic: eight Jasagh First-Class Taiji;

sentences.zh: 附輔國公一；

translations.literal: one attached Assistant State Guardian Duke;
translations.idiomatic: one attached Assistant State Guardian Duke;

sentences.zh: 厄魯特扎薩克一等台吉一。

translations.literal: one Oirat Jasagh First-Class Taiji.
translations.idiomatic: one Oirat Jasagh First-Class Taiji.

sentences.zh: 乾隆四十五年，以是部扎薩克巴哈圖爾侵佔杜爾伯特遊牧，嚴飭查辦，促令交還。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 45, because Jasagh Baatur occupied Dorbed pastures, strict investigation was ordered and return compelled.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 45, Jasagh Baatur was ordered to return occupied Dorbed pastures.

sentences.zh: 嘉慶七年十月，收扎薩克圖汗布尼喇特納等進馬五百匹。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of Jiaqing 7, five hundred horses from Jasaghtu Khan Binitana and others were received.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiaqing 7, five hundred horses from Jasaghtu Khan Binitana were received.

sentences.zh: 道光六年，回疆軍興，是部捐駝馬助軍需。

translations.literal: In Daoguang 6, with Xinjiang war underway, the division donated camels and horses for military needs.
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 6, the division donated camels and horses for the Xinjiang war.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，定扎薩克圖汗盟支差章程，王、公、台吉等將所屬喀木齊罕阿拉巴圖等牲畜分作二分，一分牲畜津貼佐領等出差；

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Jasaghtu Khan league corvée regulations were fixed: princes and taiji divided Kamji Khan Alabat livestock in half, one half subsidizing company captains' travel;
translations.idiomatic: In Daoguang 25, corvée regulations divided Kamji Khan Alabat livestock for company captains.

sentences.zh: 扎薩克台吉喀木齊罕阿拉巴圖等所有牲畜，依佐領等一律按戶扣除大牲畜一雙，餘次牲畜，均與應派佐領下人等正項差務一律出派，其貧苦台吉佐領下喀木齊罕阿拉巴圖等各均相監之。

translations.literal: Jasagh Taiji Kamji Khan Alabat livestock was deducted one large livestock pair per household like company captains; remaining livestock shared corvée equally; poor taiji and captain households were mutually supervised.
translations.idiomatic: Livestock deductions and corvée were equalized with mutual supervision of poor households.

sentences.zh: 咸豐三年，是部汗、王、公、扎薩克等以軍興捐助軍需，溫旨卻之。

translations.literal: In Xianfeng 3, the division's khan, princes, and jasaghs offered military donations; warm edicts declined.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianfeng 3, military donation offers were declined.

sentences.zh: 同治三年，回匪陷烏魯木齊等城，古城諸城被圍，調是部蒙兵援之。

translations.literal: In Tongzhi 3, rebels took Ürümqi cities and besieged Gucheng; division Mongol troops were mobilized to aid.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 3, division troops were sent to aid besieged Gucheng.

sentences.zh: 五年十一月，李雲麟奏紮盟蒙兵抵呼圖古蘭台，劫掠變亂。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year, Li Yunlin reported Jasaghtu troops reached Hutugulan station and mutinied with plunder.
translations.idiomatic: In Tongzhi 5, Jasaghtu troops mutinied and plundered at Hutugulan.

sentences.zh: 尋潰歸。

translations.literal: Soon they fled back in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Soon they fled back in rout.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，肅州回匪擾是部境。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year, Suzhou rebels disturbed this division's borders.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Tongzhi 9, Suzhou rebels disturbed the division's borders.

sentences.zh: 十月，竄聚博提哈拉烏蘇、庫努克等處殺掠。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, they gathered at Botihala Usu and Kunuk killing and plundering.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, rebels gathered at Botihala Usu and Kunuk.

sentences.zh: 十一月，匪于陷烏城後，竄金山卡倫察罕博克多地方。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, after taking Urga, bandits fled to Jinshan picket Chaqan Bokdo.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, bandits fled to Jinshan picket Chaqan Bokdo after taking Urga.

sentences.zh: 十一年十月，奎昌等奏移鞥克巴雅爾所部察哈爾馬隊駐紮盟察罕淖爾地方防回匪犯烏城。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of the eleventh year, Kuichang reported moving Engbayar's Chahar cavalry to Jasaghtu league Chaqan Nuur against rebels threatening Urga.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year, Chahar cavalry was moved to Chaqan Nuur against rebels threatening Urga.

sentences.zh: 九月，回匪竄是部輔國公車德恩敦多布多爾濟遊牧。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, rebels raided Assistant State Guardian Duke Chörindondobdorji's pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, rebels raided Chörindondobdorji's pastures.

sentences.zh: 車德恩敦多布多爾濟自備軍裝軍火糧餉，督台吉官兵，于十六、十七日再挫匪於景色圖及巴彥察汗地方，匪向西遁。

translations.literal: Chörindondobdorji supplied his own arms, ammunition, and rations, commanding taiji troops to defeat bandits at Jingse Tu and Bayan Chahan on the sixteenth and seventeenth; bandits fled west.
translations.idiomatic: Chörindondobdorji defeated bandits at Jingse Tu and Bayan Chahan; bandits fled west.

sentences.zh: 事聞，予貝子銜。

translations.literal: On report, beizi rank was granted.
translations.idiomatic: He received beizi rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月，擾科城之回匪竄聚於紮部南境，奎昌派達爾濟帶隊攻剿。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, rebels disturbing Kobdo gathered on Jasaghtu division's southern border; Kuichang dispatched Darji to attack.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, Kuichang dispatched Darji against rebels on the southern border.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月，奎昌等奏回匪於十一月竄紮盟所屬之那瑪勒吉幹昭地方，官軍於是月十一日進攻敗之，匪即北竄。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year, Kuichang reported rebels in November at Namaljigan Zhao; government troops attacked on the eleventh and defeated them; bandits fled north.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, troops defeated rebels at Namaljigan Zhao.

sentences.zh: 追剿至十二日，匪又向察罕布林噶奔竄，山勢險隘，負固相持。

translations.literal: Pursuit on the twelfth found bandits fleeing toward Chaqan Bulinga; rugged mountains made stalemate.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuit to the twelfth reached Chaqan Bulinga where mountains made stalemate.

sentences.zh: 達爾濟趕帶馬隊前進，匪又越山遁聚巴里坤、紮盟交界地方。

translations.literal: Darji advanced with cavalry; bandits crossed mountains to gather at the Barkul-Jasaghtu border.
translations.idiomatic: Darji advanced; bandits crossed to the Barkul-Jasaghtu border.

sentences.zh: 二月，烏里雅蘇臺將軍長順等以紮盟牧南各旗毗連肅州，屢被回匪擾害，奏暫移公棍楚克紮布、右翼前扎薩克桑青齊蘇隆、右翼後末瑪呢達拉等旗於本部扎薩克圖汗及右翼中參贊公密帕散佈、中右翼末旗達什拉布坦、扎薩克車德恩多爾濟等旗遊牧，扎薩克圖汗旗移本部落右翼左公銜扎薩克班紮班咱爾紮布、右翼末次扎薩克達散巴拉等旗遊牧。

translations.literal: In the second month, Urga General Changshun temporarily moved southern Jasaghtu banners away from the Suzhou border to other Jasaghtu and Sayin banners' pastures.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, Changshun temporarily relocated southern Jasaghtu banners away from the Suzhou border.

sentences.zh: 俟賊匪肅清，即令各歸舊牧。

translations.literal: When bandits were cleared, all would return to old pastures.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits were cleared, banners would return to old pastures.

sentences.zh: 下所司知之。

translations.literal: Memorial received; relevant offices informed.
translations.idiomatic: The ministries were notified.

sentences.zh: 十月，回匪竄擾圖謝公遊牧，旋擾察幹河及莫爾根地方。

translations.literal: In the tenth month, rebels disturbed Tüshe Gong's pastures, then the Chagan River and Morgen region.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, rebels disturbed Tüshe Gong's pastures and the Chagan River.

sentences.zh: 長順等遣卓淩阿剿匪于圖謝公遊牧之庫布奇爾果羅地方，勝之，救出蒙古男婦子女一百九十餘名。

translations.literal: Changshun sent Zhuoling'a to defeat bandits at Kubchir Gol in Tüshe Gong's pastures, rescuing over 190 Mongol men, women, and children.
translations.idiomatic: Zhuoling'a defeated bandits at Kubchir Gol and rescued over 190 Mongols.

sentences.zh: 科布多所遣防禦喜莫得等率兵敗匪于阿育爾公旗庫倫喇嘛地方，救出被脅蒙民男婦三四百名。

translations.literal: Kobdo Defense Ximode's troops defeated bandits at Ayur public banner Khüree Lama, rescuing three to four hundred coerced Mongols.
translations.idiomatic: Ximode defeated bandits at Khüree Lama and rescued three to four hundred Mongols.

sentences.zh: 會棟呢特多爾濟軍敗之於烏蘭壩，匪向鞥克扎薩克旗以南逾山逃遁。

translations.literal: Dongnit Dorji's army defeated them at Ulanba; bandits fled south over mountains past Eng jasagh banner.
translations.idiomatic: Dongnit Dorji defeated them at Ulanba; bandits fled south.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月，予扎薩克圖汗等捐助烏裏雅蘇台城獎。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirteenth year, Jasaghtu Khan and others were rewarded for donating to Urga city.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Jasaghtu Khan was rewarded for Urga city donations.

sentences.zh: 光緒初，烏魯木齊諸城克復，是部始解嚴。

translations.literal: In early Guangxu, with Ürümqi cities recovered, the division's emergency was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: In early Guangxu, with Ürümqi recovered, the division's emergency was lifted.

sentences.zh: 七年，徵是盟兵戍科布多。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, league troops were conscripted to garrison Kobdo.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 7, league troops garrisoned Kobdo.

sentences.zh: 俄約成，撤去。

translations.literal: When the Russian treaty concluded, they were withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: When the Russian treaty concluded, they were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，是部以甘肅回匪滋擾，文報改由台路，撤回邊界遊牧牲畜，為堅壁清野之計。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, with Gansu Muslim unrest, dispatches used relay routes and border livestock were withdrawn for scorched-earth planning.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 21, border livestock were withdrawn for scorched-earth planning during Gansu unrest.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，烏裏雅蘇台將軍崇歡等劾盟長扎薩克鎮國公阿育爾色德丹占紮木楚假公攤派，請革職，允之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year, Urga General Chonghuan impeached league chief Jasagh State Guardian Duke Ayur Sed Danjamchu for false public assessments; dismissal approved.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 23, league chief Danjamchu was dismissed for false assessments.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，是部與賽音諾顏部王、公、扎薩克等輸昭信股票銀，並請報效，仍予獎。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year, the division and Sayin Noyan princes contributed Zhaoxin stock silver and offered further donations; rewards were still granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 24, Zhaoxin contributions were rewarded despite declined stock acceptance.

sentences.zh: 二十五年，是部扎薩克蘊多爾濟旗與科布多之紮哈沁爭界，志銳等奏所爭一為巴爾嚕克鄂博，一為鞥吉爾圖鄂博，一為田德克庫與喀拉占和碩界線，請飭理籓院秉公剖斷，允之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year, Jasagh Yundorji's banner disputed borders with Kobdo Zhahaxin at Barluke Oboo, Engjirtu Oboo, and Tiendeku-Karajan Hosho line; Zhirui asked the Lifan Yuan to adjudicate fairly; approved.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 25, border disputes with Zhahaxin were referred to the Lifan Yuan.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪肇釁，邊防戒嚴，是盟王、公、扎薩克等於徵兵籌餉均得出力。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, the Boxer crisis raised border alerts; league princes contributed to troop levies and supplies.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 26, league princes contributed during the Boxer crisis.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，予扎薩克圖汗索特那木拉布坦、副將軍扎薩克輔國公洛布桑端多布獎有差。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, Jasaghtu Khan Sodnam Rabtan and Deputy General Jasagh Assistant State Guardian Duke Lobsang Dondob received graded rewards.
translations.idiomatic: In Guangxu 28, Sodnam Rabtan and Lobsang Dondob were rewarded.

sentences.zh: 宣統二年，索特那木拉布坦為資政院欽選議員。

translations.literal: In Xuantong 2, Sodnam Rabtan was an imperially selected Advisory Council member.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 2, Sodnam Rabtan was an Advisory Council member.

sentences.zh: 三年，庫倫獨立，脅是部汗、王等附之。

translations.literal: In the third year, with Khüree independent, the division's khan and princes were coerced to join.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuantong 3, Khüree independence coerced the khan and princes to join.

sentences.zh: 是部有礦，有鹽。

translations.literal: This division has mines and salt.
translations.idiomatic: This division has mines and salt.

sentences.zh: 佐領有二十一。

translations.literal: There are twenty-one company captains.
translations.idiomatic: There are twenty-one company captains.
